apps.name: 999 Seconds! Survivors
apps.short_description:
Reject boring stat stacking!
We've restructured the gameplay with limited talent resources—talent combinations are just as important as character selection! With 200+ items and 40+ pieces of equipment, what insane builds can you create?
—Depth! Difficulty! And high replay value!
A party-builder rogue like, build your party to survive the monsters guarding the crystal. Master the turn-based combat system and break your limits to see how far you can take your party.

apps.short_description: A cozy first-person tidying game with a touch of magic. Sort books, potion bottles and curious keepsakes in a witch's two-floor cottage. Earn moon dust, learn spells that put whole batches away, and enjoy turning a cluttered home into an orderly one at your own pace.

apps.name: A.M.C.A.: Monitor
apps.short_description: A survival horror game where you defend yourself from threats while looking out for anomalies.

apps.name: Abyss Hunter: Lust Awakening

apps.name: Abyssal Starfeast

apps.name: Acting Out
apps.short_description: Make movies with your friends! Acting Out is an online co-op multiplayer game where you film movie scenes. Choose scripts from different genres and cast your actors, then its lights, camera, action! Hit your marks, deliver award-winning performances, then watch your masterpiece on the big screen!

apps.name: Advancing Legion
apps.short_description: This is a relaxing idle auto-battler game.Starting as a lone hero, gradually recruit powerful subordinates to form a mighty legion, upgrade powerful abilities, and then conquer the entire world.

apps.name: Aetheris Core

apps.name: After Dark Pinas - Check in

Live in your Lola's house, do chores, tumakas sa gabi, and encounter Filipino supernatural moments that leads to a Horrific Check In Episode!

apps.name: After Hours: Library
apps.short_description: Survive a haunted library's overnight shift by balancing authentic librarian duties with stealth as a relentless supernatural entity hunts you. Uncover hidden secrets, survive until morning, and discover what waits between the shelves.

apps.name: AfterCursor
apps.short_description: Your cursor leaves copies behind. Now they hunt you. Collect folders, dodge phantom cursors, and chase high scores in an eerie desktop arcade game. Uncover a 50-level story between emails, or test your reflexes in Endless, Maze, Waves, and Relay.

apps.name: AI Digital Human Lab
apps.short_description: Meet Luna, a lifelike AI companion who lives on your PC: talk by voice or text and she answers in her own voice, with 74 expressions and natural gestures, all on-device. Scan a QR code and your own AI agent (Muse, Claude, any MCP app) can direct her: lights, camera, outfits, dance, songs.

apps.name: AI 位面旅者：无限世界
apps.short_description: 《AI 位面旅者：无限世界》是一款由 AI 实时驱动的团队冒险 RPG。你带着队伍在位面之间穿梭：探索区域、完成任务、打怪、升级、招募同伴；也可以在信标塔手填世界观、区域、角色与部队，造一个完全属于自己的位面。剧情、敌人、事件全部由 AI 现场生成，没有两次冒险是一样的。每个角色都有自己的记忆与打算，会按自己的目标行动；你不在的时候，区域里的角色仍在自行流动。角色、装备、技能、血统分 D 到 SSS 品级，敌人与友军部队是成建制的单位；回合制战斗可手动指挥每一次出手。买断制，需自备 AI 服务商 API Key 驱动剧情。

apps.name: Airborne Ranger: FightOut
apps.short_description: Gear up in Airborne Ranger: Fightout, a thrilling tactical-action game. Play solo or jump in 4-player co-op as you take on missions behind enemy lines—eliminate targets, gather intel, sabotage infrastructure and rescue hostages. Rely on skill, strategy, and courage to survive and make it out alive!

apps.name: Alderfolk
apps.short_description: Found a village and grow it into a living valley, shared by foxes, otters, badgers, hares, humans, elves and dwarves. Run farms, mills and bakeries, raise heirs, hold festivals and meet neighbouring villages. A cosy settlement builder, rich in detail, in a painted storybook style.

apps.name: Alien Invasyndrome
apps.short_description: Sneak around, evade and wait for the right time to strike! Breed hot girls and make it your erotic nest~

apps.name: All in Place

apps.name: AlpineFall

apps.name: Amadeus: A Riddle for Thee ~ Episode 2 ~ Reharm
apps.short_description: Play as Solea, a young Witch who travels on behalf of her friend Amadeus to the place they first met... Welcome to the lonely moors of Augur Pyne. A linear narrative Visual Novel + Adventure Game. Episode 2 of 5.

apps.name: Amarillo's Desktop Pets
apps.short_description: A physics-powered 3D desktop companion engine where crazy ragdoll physics meet living, reactive characters. Import VRM characters, or create your own, and let them live on your desktop.

apps.name: Amazing Slot Survivor (A.S.S.)
apps.short_description: Spin the slot machine and see how powerful you'll become! Luck shapes your arsenal, but only skill keeps you alive in this high-stakes bullet heaven roguelite. Master unique weapons and destroy the Spawners summoning endless hordes, and push your luck to the limit.

apps.name: Ambulante Simulator
apps.short_description: Become a beach vendor in Copacabana! Fill your cooler, shout your sales pitch into a real microphone and sell water, mate tea and Globo biscuits to thirsty beachgoers. Up to 6 friends on the same beach, proximity voice chat, and the biggest profit wins.

apps.name: Ancient

apps.name: Ancient Wars: Sparta HD
apps.short_description: Relive the epic battles between Spartans, Persians, and Egyptians in Ancient Wars: Sparta HD. Enjoy HD graphics, asymmetric civilizations, enhanced campaigns, new maps, smarter AI, and a revamped multiplayer mode. Forge your empire, master warfare, and make history in the Ancient World!

apps.name: Ann's Parlor
apps.short_description: Awakened from years of slumber, the witch Ann returns to her old cabin, where visitors arrive seeking love, truth, or glimpses of fate. Through crystal-ball readings, you interpret their stories and guide their paths—every choice reshaping their destinies and the secrets that await within.

apps.name: ANOMALITH
apps.short_description: “ANOMALITH” is a survival third-person shooter set in Japan, steeped in the atmosphere of liminal spaces and Showa-era retro aesthetics. To search for her missing friend, a girl steps into a world writhing with anomalies.

apps.name: Another Ark
apps.short_description: Embark on an strategy RPG adventure in the land of Macca.  Tackle a variety of maps large and small.  Listen to the original soundtrack, and learn the mechanics to tackle difficult challenges.

apps.name: Ant Now?
apps.short_description: Eight players, four colonies, one backyard. You play as a duo: one commands the nest from the war room below, the other defends the anthill outside. Build your colony, hold the line and storm the other nests. In the end, only one queen survives.

apps.name: Ant Tribe
apps.short_description: Expand your chamber, strengthen your tribe, and put every ant to work, each with its own role — to deliver an endless feast to your Queen!

apps.name: Apoc Tank: Rush Forward
apps.short_description: Drive your tank through zombie hordes! Backpack-like + roguelike bullet-heaven shooter. Merge weapons, upgrade tanks, collect energy cores & sets, research tech. 5 difficulties from easy to inferno.

apps.name: ARC-9
apps.short_description: Boot up as ARC-9 in this breakneck cyber-runner FPS! Never stop moving as you dash through bullet hells, tear apart rogue machines, and stack game-breaking augments in endless roguelite runs. Die, evolve, and push to the core. Who are you beneath this mechanical shell?

apps.name: Architect of Ruin
apps.short_description: Architect of Ruin is a completely hand drawn sword and sorcery colony simulation game. Farm, hunt, build, and survive as you rebuild an ancient temple under the gaze of a vengeful god.

apps.name: Archives of Disorder - Pasture Without Light
apps.short_description: Twelve years after humanity went blind in one second, survivors live by gentle rules in Haven Seven. Rations always arrive. Names on the list quietly disappear, and sound engineer Elias Ward finds the list has been altered. A narrative adventure about sight, memory and choice.

apps.name: Ardent Arcana
apps.short_description: Solo or with up to three friends online, take on the beasts of French folklore in this co-op dungeon roguelite. Wield 14 weapons, master the 22 Major Arcana and fight your way down five procedural dungeons to the boss waiting at the bottom.

apps.name: Arisen Force: Vonimir
apps.short_description: Gather allies, fight the shadows, and uncover the secrets of Vonimir. In a land of pixel beauty and epic battles, your legend begins.

apps.name: Armed Supremacy
apps.short_description: Build your base and command a modern army in a large-scale RTS. Fight across land, sea and air, flank enemy armor and develop your forces through research and combat. Enable zombie hordes and hold your defenses through the night.

apps.name: Art Attack
apps.short_description: Art Attack is an action roguelike with a unique paint based combat system, and a distaste for GenAI.

apps.name: ART NOIRE: Paris
apps.short_description: ART NOIRE: Paris is an atmospheric ring-based puzzle game that combines classic film noir aesthetics with the romantic elegance of 1960s Paris. Rotate concentric rings, align the details, and restore beautiful illustrations.

apps.name: ASCENT: MASKLINGS
apps.short_description: Fight through a shifting rift in a 3D action roguelite. Choose Lumi, Bram, or Nox; master their distinct melee, shield, and rune abilities; shape each five-room expedition with routes and blessings; and face the Swarm Heart alongside AI companions.

apps.name: Ashen Wild
apps.short_description: Ashen Wild is a group-first online fantasy RPG, where dangerous travel, camp-based expeditions, distinct classes, and tradable loot make people matter. Bring alternate characters while a party forms; press farther when other players arrive.

apps.name: Ashigaru
apps.short_description: Ashigaru Tactics is a turn-based hex tactical combat sandbox game, set in Sengoku-era Japan. Assemble a squad of mercenaries and fight, survive, and kill in a land ravaged by clan wars, bandit incursions, and whispers of Yokai emerging.

apps.name: ASMBL
apps.short_description:
Build. Program. Pilot. Compete. 
ASMBL is a multiplayer VR sandbox simulator where you easily snap building blocks to build anything imaginable. Build and pilot planes, trains, cars, and mechs. Put your creativity to the test as you and your friends solve problems and compete together.

apps.name: Astral 4X : Interstellar Simulation
apps.short_description: A deep-space 4X simulation. Explore a procedurally generated universe, colonize worlds, build a realistic economy, and lead your civilization toward galactic domination. Brave ecological and economic crises, face famines, wars, and disasters, and ensure your survival!

apps.name: Astro Loopers
apps.short_description: What if you could rewind time — and team up with your past self? Astro Loopers is a Sokoban-style puzzle game set in a cosmic universe, where every move echoes through time. Your past characters repeat their actions as time loops stack up — coordinate them to solve increasingly mind-bending stages.

apps.name: Astrolobe OS
apps.short_description: Explore an orbital workspace where the computer is part of the world. Enter Astrolobe OS, manage files and media, move between the physical workstation and desktop, and play Grapple Grid from orbit above Earth.

apps.name: ATK：画境小镇
apps.short_description: ATK: Painting Realm Town is a casual and fun auto-battler that integrates tavern chess strategic gameplay, in-depth character development, and random equipment collection. Players can unlock more than twenty distinctive characters with entirely unique styles and personalities.

apps.name: Automotive Empire
apps.short_description: Start with one kart in a small garage. Expand your team from karting to the pinnacle of motorsport. Compete against 172 teams in 21 championships. Design every part, build and expand your campus. Enter the road car and racing parts markets and face another level of competition.

apps.name: AVALON:XIII
apps.short_description: Build your playstyle with nearly 100 upgradeable cards, hero progression, equipment and potions. Time your cards, blocks and counters in real-time combat. Explore dungeons, then develop Ash City through idle gathering, crafting and building upgrades.

apps.name: Ayalga
apps.short_description: Fermín's crew went down the mine, and at noon the cage came up empty. Your turn: that's what the new guy is for. A horde-survival roguelite with a story and an ending: ten floors of creatures from Asturian legend, a boss on every one, and the Diañu laughing at you all the way down.

apps.name: B.C. Piezophile
apps.short_description:
B.C. Piezophile is a first-person action horror game set deep underwater. It
features a foreign ocean brimming with ambivalent environments, hazardous
anomalies and baroque ecosystems. Stranded in the hadal zone, the player must
ascend over 6,150 AeC before they can dream of rescue.

apps.name: BABA YAGA: Whispers of the BOOM
apps.short_description: A dark action game where silence kills. Enter a surreal forest inspired by Slavic mythology. Here, time flows to the rhythm of the moon, and undead horrors leap from the darkness. Craft runes and survive explosive battles with demons among the fractal trees. One, two, three… Baba Yaga watches thee!

apps.name: BACKBITE
apps.short_description: Snake, but as a duel. Two snakes, one board and five powers to sabotage each other. And dying first doesn't mean losing: the one who ate more wins, not the one who survived.

apps.name: Backrooms:Betrayal
apps.short_description: Maintain reality or watch it collapse. Backrooms: Betrayal is a co-op liminal horror game where the environment is the antagonist. Stabilize shifting sectors against a tide of entropy, but watch your team. Every failure has an explanation, but not every explanation is innocent.

apps.name: Backseat Champions
apps.short_description: Manage your driver in short, tactical races. Rapidly choose from dozens of upgrades each race. Use tire compounds to shape your strategy. Machine-learned drivers make every race unpredictable. Can you become the Champion?

apps.name: Bancho the Chef
apps.short_description:
<Bancho the Chef> is a cooking simulation + adventure game that follows Bancho from <Dave the Diver> during his youth on the road to becoming a sushi master.
Travel through cities across Asia and experience the joy of cooking firsthand as you follow Bancho’s journey and learn unique local cuisines!

apps.name: Band Stage
apps.short_description: Step onto a vibrant, colorful stage and unleash your musical magic with a variety of instruments. Featuring a curated collection of classic hits, our soundtrack spans Pop, Rock, Classical, Electronic, and beyond—guaranteed to hit every note of your musical imagination.

apps.name: Bandwagon
apps.short_description: An open-world survivors-lite adventure about building a band and restoring joy to a grumpy world. Assemble unique musical troupes, roam the land fighting off grumps, and complete quests for a growing cast of quirky characters.

apps.name: Barry the Antivirus
apps.short_description: Your computer is under attack, and the antivirus is a very angry bear. Slingshot Barry into waves of viruses, bounce off the walls, collect coins, and upgrade your way through an endless pixel-art invasion on a desktop straight out of the '90s.

apps.name: Bashnya
apps.short_description: A big apartment block. Eight residents. One escape pod. Bashnya is a top-down action roguelike where everyone seeks a way out — and finds their doom.

apps.name: Bazookat
apps.short_description: A 2D Precision Platformer, where a stylish cat uses a bazooka to rocket jump to solve puzzles! Enjoy blowing stuff up, and reaching new heights!

apps.name: Beast Hunt
apps.short_description: Hunt the Beast through deadly caves in this first-person survival horror game. Read the clues, map your route, and manage light, air, and sanity. Scavenge strange powers, evade giant spiders, and trust your deductions when it's time to take the shot.

apps.name: Because It's There
apps.short_description: An engineering/survival game where you summit the tallest mountain in a vast, uncharted world. For the journey, carefully construct flying wooden bases with realistic structural failures. Brave thunderstorms, freezing temperatures, bears and wolves. Answer the call of the untamed wilderness.

apps.name: Bedrotting Simulator
apps.short_description: Lock the doors. Reply to her texts. Don't stumble onto the wrong account. Track down your missing friend, salvage your relationship, and survive the nights alone—assuming your mind doesn't break first.

apps.name: Before the Song Falls
apps.short_description: In 1131, the land lies shattered and the nation is in ruin. Lead displaced people to rebuild their homes, develop production, stockpile supplies, and resist powerful enemies. Survive the chaos of war and protect the countless lives behind you.

apps.name: Better Days Pending
apps.short_description: A courier’s struggle for a better life. Ride your e-bike, deliver food, buy weapons and survive an absurd open world. Explore towns, tune the radio and chase rising payouts through day and night in this single-player first-person action game.

apps.name: Better Together
apps.short_description: A 2 to 6 player co-op psychological horror. Become neighbors with your friends in an underground experiment. Complete the studies, get paid by doing tasks, while the Institute notes your routine. Betray your friends before they do. In the end you'll know exactly who your friends really are.

apps.name: Better World
apps.short_description: Seven evenings in one house. A tired father, five kids, a wife who counts his pills. Take one every evening and everything is lovely — until the walls start writing back. A short PS1-style psychological horror story. Two endings. What did you do, Arthur?

apps.name: Beyond The Cradle
apps.short_description:
Grow a civilisation across a persistent galaxy that keeps running while you are away.
Research, colonise and automate your worlds, make peace and trade with rival empires,
and reach beyond your cradle.

apps.name: Beyond The Mist
apps.short_description: M. Webb, the I.S.C. requests your immediate presence. Our previous keeper has vanished without explanation. A replacement is needed at once for the offshore lighthouse under our care. Report to the local office of the company as soon as possible. Do not be late.

apps.name: Black Market Space Station Shop Simulator
apps.short_description: Newly released from prison, you've been sent to a distant space station to manage a general store. This is your last chance at redemption and the authorities are watching. Can you keep your nose clean and still earn a profit in this trading simulator?

apps.name: Blackboard Ponies
apps.short_description:
A game about a small pony in a blackboard world wreaking havoc and bringing color to everyone's lives. 

In this puzzle platformer play as a student's rebellious fantasy pony, kicking its way through the blackboard and releasing colors from the environment, making the world seem less hopeless.

apps.name: Blackstar Ranger
apps.short_description: Blackstar Ranger is a high-octane and immersive first-person space shooter. From the seat of your advanced fighter, you will complete contracts for BLACKSTAR, the most esteemed Private Military Faction in the solar system. With 6DOF capability, you will battle threats throughout the system.

apps.name: Blade of the Soulway
apps.short_description: “Blade of the Soulway” is a card-based RPG with a gripping storyline, featuring card collection, character building, equipment crafting, and dungeon exploration. Its unique material gathering and crafting system makes character builds even more diverse.

apps.name: Blades of Mirage
apps.short_description: Face mythical legends in a Southeast Asia-inspired world action-adventure soulslike. Build your playstyle through combination of weapon and runes, choose your best experience then explore ancient realm of brightlands, confront corrupted guardians, and solve intricate puzzles to uncover the truth

apps.name: Blawkade
apps.short_description: ANOMALY DETECTED. You are the anomaly. Race through 28 sectors in a fast paced 2D puzzle-platformer. Dodge blocks, collect power-ups, and phase through obstacles to reach each transporter before you're erased. Escape solo or with friends.

apps.name: Blend Hunter: Smoothie Bullet Heaven
apps.short_description: 112 smoothie weapons. Six slots. Discover powerful combos, mow down hordes, and take on towering Bounty Bosses in this colorful 3D bullet heaven. Turn fruit into firepower and build your own recipe for destruction.

apps.name: BLIGHTFALL
apps.short_description: ※ FEED THE SHRINES [▰▰▰▱▱] ※ BLIGHTFALL is a fast-moving 1–4 player FPS roguelike. Hold the zone, dash-reap the wounded, stack loot into broken builds, breach the rift, and kill what answers. ⟦ TIME FEEDS THEM // KILL FASTER ⟧

apps.name: Blind Frontiers
apps.short_description: Take the road to the elusive Golden City. Blind Frontiers is a narrative road trip blending RPG and survival, where the destination matters less than the state of mind you arrive in. Drive through collapsing worlds at the wheel of your one makeshift companion: your truck.

apps.name: Blind Seek
apps.short_description: Blind Seek is a chaotic multiplayer hide-and-seek party game where the hiders are invisible, but definitely not silent. Complete tasks, grab ridiculous power-ups, and escape before the seeker hears your footsteps or catches you yapping in voice chat with you friends!

apps.name: Block Mercs
apps.short_description: Block Mercs is a turn-based mercenary company RPG. Recruit fighters, pay wages, manage food and gear, and take contracts across a grim low-poly world. Lost limbs need steel or stranger grafts. Reputation follows you, and so do old grudges. Combat is one line in the ledger; surviving is the book.

apps.name: Bluff or Bust
apps.short_description: Bluff or Bust is a multiplayer social deduction game inspired by Persian Gol ya Pooch, where players hide and track a Goal ball using observation, intelligence, and reading body language.

apps.name: Board Game Creator
apps.short_description: Create and play games with your friends locally and online. Use phones, tablets, or laptops to control a shared canvas to recreate virtually any board game or card game experience.

apps.name: Boardroom & Chassis
apps.short_description: Build a car empire from a single factory. Design, manufacture, and sell cars across decades of history while three rivals fight you for every customer. Compete fair - or play dirty with corporate espionage, sabotage, and the stock market. Can you build an industry giant?

apps.name: Bolt of Whalington
apps.short_description: A Metroidvania built around discovery and curiosity. Play as Bolt, a Siamese cat exploring a flying castle where you might melt walls with soap, become a rat to talk to enemies, or even rewrite the world’s rules. Explore, experiment, and uncover Whalington’s secrets. Curiosity doesn’t kill this cat.

apps.name: BONEWOOD
apps.short_description: Cut through waves of orcs, undead and other wretched enemies of the realm! Gather your units and equip them with powerful gear, place your traps, level up your hero and unlock new talents. Discover mad builds and insane synergies that will help you defend endlessly! Play solo or co-op!

apps.name: Book of Infinity: 1001 Nights
apps.short_description: Can you survive an evil King who kills a bride every night by telling stories? A story-crafting game based on a unique narrative system — Become the storyteller Scheherazade from Persian folklore, weave tales to the King through typing, and guide his words to forge magical weapons for your revenge!

apps.name: Boomimals
apps.short_description: Battle your friends as chaotic animal tanks in fast-paced local or online PvP! Collect game-breaking upgrade cards, bounce bullets around unpredictable arenas, and outsmart your opponents in booming 2–4 player matches.

apps.name: Bore Bore
apps.short_description: Descend to the center of the Earth and survive beneath toxic skies. Watch out for the creatures. Manage your air, water, and food. Build vehicles to dig deeper. Grow potatoes, gather resources, and design robots to defend and automate your world — the control is in your hands.

apps.name: Bossinator TD
apps.short_description: Build towers, then grab your weapon and jump into the fight! Bossinator TD mixes classic tower defense with hands-on hero action. Hold the line against hordes, flying beasts, Elites and towering Bosses across multiple worlds — your way.

apps.name: Botinator
apps.short_description: Descend into the depths of the facility to uncover the cause behind the madness. Blow robotic creatures into pieces and fight through mind bending environmental challenges. Use various physics based mechanics to force your way through a lethal mixture of combat and puzzles.

apps.name: Box Them Cats
apps.short_description: Box Them Cats is a cozy drag-and-drop puzzle game. Grab wandering cats, sort them into the right-sized boxes, recycle the sneaky trash bags, and take on clients’ challenges to earn goddess blessings.

apps.name: Brand of Betrayal
apps.short_description: In this NTR RPG, play as Rein on a mission to defeat the Demon King. With your wife and two childhood friends, fight enemies, explore, and grow stronger as you unlock steamy events. Power comes at a cost though, and you will not be the one to pay it. How far will your team go to achieve its goal?

apps.name: Bravest!2
apps.short_description: The sequel to “Bravest!,” the classic front-view RPG that was a hit during the feature phone era!

apps.name: BREACHPOINT
apps.short_description: Frag out like you're a teenager again. BREACHPOINT is a fast paced arena FPS featuring both classic modes and an Endless Singleplayer/Co-Op progression mode against hordes of enemies and bosses. Play Online or in LAN!

apps.name: Bread and Iron
apps.short_description: A brutal medieval survival sandbox blending crafting, base building, and combat as players struggle against harsh environments and dangerous creatures.

apps.name: Breaking the silent lies
apps.short_description: The man has to relive his trauma from the past to save his idol but the truth is more than meets the eye.

apps.name: Brick Buddies
apps.short_description: Pick up a brick and build a little world. Follow the instructions, add stickers, and collect new models in this cozy brick-building game. Unwind on your own or grow your collection with friends.

apps.name: BrickAmp
apps.short_description: Two brick-breakers in one: AMPED runs fast and loud, ZEN reshapes the same 100 levels onto a slower, calmer board. Charge the Smash meter to blow out whole clusters of bricks in one hit — and play it all to your own music, or whatever's already playing.

apps.name: British Pub Simulator
apps.short_description: Take ownership of a derelict pub in 1980s Britain and turn it into a proper local. Pull pints, stock the cellar, serve the punters, furnish and decorate the place, enjoy classic pub games and build the boozer your way.

apps.name: Broke to Broker
apps.short_description: Start at 22 with $3,000, a rented room and an empty calendar. Win clients, close sales, post videos that find buyers for years, buy homes of your own, maybe found an agency. A real estate career sim about the one thing money can't buy back: your time.

apps.name: Broken Cycle
apps.short_description: Broken Cycle is a dark-fantasy auto-battler RPG that lets you build a team of up to 5 mercenaries and send them to clear dungeons automatically while you engineer their battle tactics and loot, craft, and enchant their gear.

apps.name: BrosLand
apps.short_description: Two brothers go to spend the holidays at their older brother's house. The next morning, he's gone! His AI assistant, Xiron, is here to help find him. BrosLand is a local co-op platformer about doing together what neither can do alone.

apps.name: Brothel Virgin - The Crimson Reverie
apps.short_description: Your first night in a brothel. Nervous? Excited? You’ve got one night to pick your companion — or unlock a hidden VIP experience. Animated scenes, wild choices, and more secrets than you can handle.

apps.name: Brute Tusk : Feral
apps.short_description: Play as a feral boar and fight the animals of the wild. Charge, bite, and dodge through every clash. Eat what you kill, evolve mid-run, and grow into a deadlier beast.

apps.name: Bubble Love
apps.short_description:
「身為優質男性，控制所有女人是理所當然的。」
反傳統，開局即後宮，戀愛（？）文字遊戲。
developers: Bipolar Madnesser 躁狂抑鬱瘋狂者
publishers: Bipolar Madnesser 躁狂抑鬱瘋狂者

apps.name: Buddy System
apps.short_description: Buddy System is a 1-8 player co-op camping horror game about a pack of Marshfellows who made some bad decisions. Keep the fire lit, survive four increasingly cursed campsites, and if your buddy stops being useful, roast them. The last Marshfellow standing wins.

apps.name: Burger Flipper
apps.short_description:
You play as a young man who works as a “Burger Flipper” and who struggles with the ordinary
problems of life.
But his life drastically changes when he meets one little fluffy and rude friend.
Will you discover the truth behind his secrets?

apps.name: Burnknowe Golf Club
apps.short_description: A cosy golf club tycoon in a painted Scottish landscape. Design the course, sculpt the ground, keep the greens perfect and your members happy, and grow your club from a handful of holes into a destination worth the trip.

apps.name: Bush League Baseball
apps.short_description: Arcade baseball with real rules and terrible players, in full 3D: bobblehead ballplayers, eight ballparks and Chuck Baseball, a booth announcer who loves every error. Found your own club, build its ballpark, and trade club codes with friends. One or two players.

apps.name: Bye Bye Bonnie
apps.short_description: Bye Bye Bonnie is a co-op journey for up to 4 players set in a dystopian wasteland. Tee-up a giant talking skull to defy physics, conquer dungeons, help strange NPCs, and find lost siblings. Upgrade your skull to ascend The Tower. Mother is waiting...

apps.name: Cable Arrange
apps.short_description: One outlet. A whole room to power. Connect cables, power strips, and extension cords to bring every appliance to life in this cozy puzzle game.

apps.name: Call From The Deep
apps.short_description: Call From The Deep is a gripping first-person co-op horror experience. Crew a submarine with up to 8 friends and descend into a haunted abyss. Patch the leaks, fend off nightmares, and hold the hull together as you dive ever deeper — for fortune and glory, or be lost to the tide.

apps.name: Calvary and Swords
apps.short_description: Build a settlement, raise an army, and fight alongside your troops in a medieval sandbox. Customize your character, develop your skills, and command infantry, archers, and cavalry. Play solo against AI or join friends for a co-op experience.

apps.name: Camp Manager Simulator
apps.short_description: Ever dreamed of running your own campground? Turn a quiet lakeside campsite into a thriving resort! Rent out tents, caravans, and bungalows. Unlock fishing, offer ATV and canoe rentals, hire staff, and keep every camper happy.

apps.name: Cannon War
apps.short_description: Cannon War is a pixel-art tower-defense strategy game spanning Ancient, Modern, and Future Warfare. Build towers and barricades to reshape enemy routes, combine weapons and targeting strategies, expand your permanent arsenal, and defend your headquarters through a multi-era campaign.

apps.name: Cappy & Tappy: Temples of Peril
apps.short_description: Follow Cappy & Tappy through their block-stacking, platforming, worldwide adventure! Stack massive blocks as Tappy to help Cappy explore, survive and escape. Play with a friend or juggle both roles solo to escape crumbling temples packed with devious traps, colossal bosses, and mysterious idols.

apps.name: Capy of Gods
apps.short_description: A vertical-climbing action roguelike: scale a massive tower as a capybara while your weapons fire on their own, bullet-heaven style. Level up, shape your build, take on quests, and unlock weapons and characters. Every run generates a brand-new tower.

apps.name: Cargo Order
apps.short_description:
Sort and trade cargo in this turn-based strategy game.
Make every slot count: stack cargo by color and sell full columns to cities that need it.
Donate boosters to cities to reshape supply and boost profits.
Meet your targets within the turn limit, then see how far you can go in Endless Mode!

apps.name: Carmilla : Crimson Moon
apps.short_description: A dark yuri horror visual novel inspired by a classic gothic novella. When the enigmatic Carmilla arrives, Laura is swept into a fever dream of obsession. Is this stranger the cure for her loneliness or a herald of corruption? And what caused the mysterious deaths of two girls in the nearby village?

apps.name: Castlebound
apps.short_description: Fight hordes of evil monsters and defend your castle in this 1-4 player action platformer with Roguelike elements!

apps.name: CastleMiner Z : Resurrection
apps.short_description: The cult survival shooter returns. Rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5, CastleMiner Z: Resurrection brings next-gen visuals, brutal combat, and infinite worlds to explore. Mine, craft, build, and survive against the undead, dragons, and the deadly unknown.

apps.name: Cat Ball Arena
apps.short_description: Cats on skateboards compete in chaotic ball matches across challenging arenas full of traps and hazards. Unlock powerful abilities, master increasingly absurd stages, and outscore your foes in this fast-paced pixel-art party game.

apps.name: CatBall
apps.short_description: CatBall is a physics-based roguelite builder: arm your cat, toss it into battle, watch it roll, crash, and swing on its own, and switch weapons at the right moment to send enemies flying.

apps.name: Caveblazers Together
apps.short_description: Caveblazers Together is an online multiplayer mod for Caveblazers - team up with up to 3 friends on your adventures!

apps.name: Celesthral
apps.short_description: Master the art of instant character swaps and high-speed support parries to defy the celestial conspiracy. As the wind god Fei Lian, unite with Jiang Ziya to lead an alliance of demons and men, shatter the chains of destiny, and embark on a god-slaying odyssey for true freedom.

apps.name: Champions of Miyandir
apps.short_description: A turn-based card game for up to 4 players that emphasizes deck construction and free-for-all multiplayer interaction, set in the fantasy world of Miyandir. Each card is beautifully crafted with hand-drawn artwork. Build your own decks and challenge your friends.

apps.name: Chaos Coin
apps.short_description: Your coins are your actions in this roguelike coinbuilder. Slot sequences of coins to shove, evade, and attack in turn-based combat. Fight in pairs using coins unique to each character. Upgrade and replace individual coin faces to build complex combos. Chaos is coming, so use your heads (and tails)!

apps.name: Chaos Movers
apps.short_description: Team up with up to 8 chaotic movers, complete ridiculous moving contracts, and chase secret personal goals. Work together, protect fragile cargo, or secretly sabotage the job in this funny physics-based co-op party game.

apps.name: Chess:Arcade
apps.short_description: Learn chess by playing it. Master the rules, openings, endgames and tactics, then put your skills to the test in Arcade mode, against eight computer opponents, or against friends. Real chess, unchanged — just more approachable, playful and alive.

apps.name: Chill Gyaru
apps.short_description:
Byrd mirrors whatever you're doing. Study and she studies beside you; slack off
and she slacks off too. A desktop-companion idle game about looking after a gyaru
who lives in the corner of your screen — and saving up the deposit to keep her home.

apps.name: ChromaBreak
apps.short_description: ChromaBreak is a high-speed rhythm action bullet-hell sidescroller. Graze deadly neon hazards, trigger shockwave parries, switch color polarities, and defeat colossal geometric bosses to claim their weapons in heart-pounding solo or local 2-player co-op combat.

apps.name: Chronicle of Gods
apps.short_description: You are one god in a pantheon of rivals. On living worlds of wandering peoples, rising cities and warring realms, gods compete for faith and mortals toil. Older than any realm, the Chronicle remembers the deeds of mortals and gods alike. Can anyone prove which were yours?

apps.name: Chronicle of Heroes
apps.short_description: Build, Quest, Defend! Build a city and recruit heroes to quest for power and glory, and to defend against ever increasing waves of darkness. Can you grow mighty enough to stand against the coming storm?

apps.name: CityZen
apps.short_description: Build a city from humble beginnings into an industrial metropolis. Manage supply chains, meet your citizens’ needs, and keep essential services running in a deep economic simulation that rewards good planning without demanding perfection.

apps.name: Clawsome
apps.short_description: Help Clawby find unique friends in this wholesome adventure! Collect cute figurines with the help of Clawby to create colorful dioramas in this cozy claw machine game.

apps.name: CLETTER Homophone Word Spelling
apps.short_description: CLETTER Homophone Word Spelling pictures English sounds. 7-color coding (colorful phonics) shows patterns. Spell right → words pop. Each level: tap letters, robot carries them, showing growth + 12 achievements. Switch CN/EN UI. Charts spot weak words & progress. PC numpad adds fun.

apps.name: Click the Star
apps.short_description: A relaxing incremental clicker with idle helpers. Click the star, open pods and collect keepsakes. Spend stardust on upgrades, unlock auto-clicking helpers, chain reactions and charged bursts, then carry permanent skills into your next run.

apps.name: Closing Time at the Wooden Toy Shop
apps.short_description: Close up a cozy toy shop by sorting up to 11,520 scattered toys. Fill the shelves, earn upgrades, and use handy abilities. Take a break at Plinko or the coin pusher, or collect wooden animals from the claw machine.

apps.name: Code RAPID
apps.short_description: Code RAPID is a Third-Person Action Mecha game with the focus on real-time high-mobility movement. Fight on the Ondarean front to uncover mysteries of a forgotten planet. Complete missions to earn weapons and parts to build a mech that truly suits your playstyle with deep customization systems.

apps.name: Combat Arena Tactics
apps.short_description: Draft your army and face your opponent in this strategic 1v1 board game. Like chess, we can choose between blitz, rapid, or longer classical matches. What is your ELO going to be?

apps.name: Combo Devils
apps.short_description: Combo Devils is an evolution of the platform-fighting genre. Stylish combat, and a cooperative extraction roguelite mode offers content for all player skill levels. An experience that balances accessibility with a high execution ceiling for a dedicated core player base to grow around.

apps.name: ConEX
apps.short_description: A twin-stick shooter roguelite with a destination. Mow down thousands of zombies to deliver a package, then make it back to your van alive. Build your loadout mid-run, upgrade your gear between shifts, and turn every handcrafted pixel-art route into a bloodbath.

apps.name: Conquest of Empires 3
apps.short_description: Conquest of Empires 3 builds a strategy-first world of multi-civilization warfare, where cunning is the only passport, and every player can rely on their intellect to carve out their own empire in an epic sandbox.

apps.name: Contested Space: Core Defender
apps.short_description: The first pack opening defense game you can play with friends! Crack booster packs to build your fleet, defend your core, and aim your own cannon while your stations fire. 1-4 player online co-op, short runs, hundreds of unlocks. Set in the Contested Space universe.

apps.name: CoreVR
apps.short_description: Welcome to CoreVR! The new Social VR experience for you and your friends. Explore community-created worlds, use custom avatars, and create your own content with Unity. Enjoy VR and desktop mode and endless fun.

apps.name: Corrupted Worlds
apps.short_description: Corrupted Worlds is a sci-fi puzzle adventure that tasks you with navigating a dying solar system full of perils. Survive, solve intricate puzzles, and scavenge for vital resources. Uncover ancient artifacts to reveal the past and saveguard life in the universe.

apps.name: Cosplaying in Costalia: The Tororo Sisters!
apps.short_description: When Souta’s cosplay-filled camera gets broken, the Yamakake sisters volunteer to be cosplay models for him. After gratefully accepting and whipping up a flurry of cosplay outfits for the girls, they head to Costalia, a cosplayer’s paradise. But will their photo shoots go off without a hitch?

apps.name: CottageCore
apps.short_description: Build freely, shape cottages and towers, and welcome a village into your glade. Organize village life and prepare homes and supplies for winter. A cozy building game about making a place of your own and caring for the people who live there.

apps.name: Cozy Burg
apps.short_description: A cozy hex city builder with real people and real jobs. You have to earn every resident: they want nature nearby, a job they can get to, and a street worth living on. You build it from a small hand of cards. Make it beautiful, make it work.

apps.name: Cozy Cups VR
apps.short_description: Enjoy the career of a barista. Manage your own custom cafe, customize your interior design, and make the entire city your customer!

apps.name: Cozy~Fishing Kitten
apps.short_description: Dive into a cozy, idle fishing experience! Cast your line from a little corner on your desktop. Customize your cute avatar and background, then feed and collect adorable cats of all breeds. Unlock beautiful scenes and jump into multiplayer and sneak in some "chill-time" with friends!

apps.name: Crate Up
apps.short_description: Release the hook at the right moment and stack crates as high as you can. A hand-drawn, one-button stacking game where the tower sways, combos set off fireworks and music, and the climb takes you from a forest clearing all the way into deep space.

apps.name: Crawling Desktop Pet
apps.short_description: Raise a procedural pet on your Windows desktop. Hatch eggs, feed and evolve pets, collect Crystals, unlock toys and scenes, and shape each body part to create a companion of your own. Switch between windowed and transparent desktop modes, enable click-through, or invite friends online.

apps.name: Cresata
apps.short_description:
From the ashes. In the name of vengeance. A revenant shall rise. 
Following a treacherous rebellion, Phaedon of Arsica is imprisoned and left for dead. Freed by a twist of fate, he now hunts down those who betrayed him and his homeland.

apps.name: CRIME COAST
apps.short_description: Chase dangerous money, drive your dream car, and get close to women with secrets—CRIME COAST is an illustrated narrative RPG where business, favors, and gunfire can open the way to a life on your own terms.

apps.name: Crimson Harvest
apps.short_description: Plant, water, and harvest crops in a PS1-inspired farming horror game. Sell crops to buy seeds and upgrades, or sacrifice them for the Harvest at the week's end all while trying to survive unique horrifying creatures that emerge with each passing day.

apps.name: Crimswell
apps.short_description: turn a run-down bar into a full-blown criminal operation. Craft drinks unlike anything else, take shady deals, and expand with illegal properties. Survive the heat from cops and rival crews while you rule the streets of Crimswell. Play solo or with up to 8 friends.

apps.name: CROPSES
apps.short_description: Cropses is a first-person farming and tower defense game where you grow crops, gather resources, and build defenses to protect your settlement from waves of zombies emerging from the fog. Sell your harvest, upgrade your defenses, and survive long enough to repair your broken-down truck and escape!

apps.name: CrossWords
apps.short_description: Not just a game, CrossWords is a tool to build and save complex custom crosswords. Insert your own words to craft dedicated puzzles, let the auto helper algorithm finish the rest, and compete on global leaderboards.

apps.name: Crown of Jerusalem
apps.short_description: A historical strategy game of the Crusader states and their Muslim and Byzantine rivals, 1098–1191. Play as Baldwin IV, Saladin or another ruler across five scenarios: govern cities, fight duels and pitched battles, and decide history's turning points, from Montgisard to Hattin.

apps.name: Crowned Sun
apps.short_description: An isometric action MMORPG of androids and erased cities. Wake in Cradle-19 as a Ninth Generation Wanderer, fight machines with blade and Drone, shape your build with Plug-in Chips, and remember the places the world was made to forget.

apps.name: Crowns & Colossi
apps.short_description: Choose among 13 distinct fantasy kingdoms: appoint ministers, balance the treasury and maneuver on the world map, then command legions in turn-based battles with war-strategy cards and towering giants. Roguelike runs, branching stories and multiple endings.

apps.name: Crownspat
apps.short_description: Lead your kingdom against three rivals in a lighthearted real-time strategy game. Command troops, claim territory, build villages and defenses, manage taxes and resources, and outmaneuver your enemies across colorful isometric battlefields.

apps.name: Cthulhu Descends
apps.short_description: Survive eldritch hordes in this pixel-art action roguelite. Combine chain lightning, drones and black holes with hero talents and relics to forge powerful builds. Battle through 15 waves, face an ancient god, and push further in Endless Mode and the Boss Tower.

apps.name: Cubes&Cards
apps.short_description: Cubes & Cards is a Rougelike Platform Fighter; Fight your friends and gain power from over 30 cards to choose from! With 3 characters with unique playstyles, the possibilities are endless!

apps.name: Cubic Earth
apps.short_description: Explore all of Earth in stunning detail, down to street level! From New York to London and beyond, there are millions of real places to uncover.

apps.name: CultGame
apps.short_description: Create your own cult, perform forbidden rituals, and crusade against the filthy non-believers. It's time to play god. CultGame is a cult simulator RPG where you start your own cult in a procedurally generated fantasy world with haunting ASCII art.

apps.name: Cups and Curses
apps.short_description: A cozy magic coffee shop sim. Invent drinks from ingredients whose effects you discover by using them, plan your board around the morning forecast, and offer them to the people at your counter. No timer and no fail state. Regulars come back, sit down, and tell you things.

apps.name: Curse of Baghdad
apps.short_description: A top-down military shooter with a rich story about brotherhood when surviving an unknown curse. Face the odds and escape with your life from this unprecedented threat that lurks in the shadows of Baghdad, Iraq.

apps.name: CyberMate
apps.short_description: Chat with lifelike AI companions in real time! Ultra-low latency, natural voice conversations with instant interruptions and lip-sync. 100% local, no internet or API fees. Just 6GB VRAM recommended. Customize voices and create avatars from your own photos.

apps.name: CyberSprawl: Aquarium
apps.short_description: Build your neon aquarium. Fish, hatch and breed biological, cyborg and robotic creatures. Decorate and manage multiple habitats, sell fish to local NPC buyers, and bring your favorites into Neon Clash beta practice battles in this single-player idle collection game.

apps.name: DABANGGU
apps.short_description: DABANGGU revives Korea’s classic 1970s–80s alleyway team tag. Race through iconic Korean neighborhoods, disguise yourself as street props, evade the taggers, and stage a dramatic jailbreak for your team—solo with BOTs or online with up to 15 players.

apps.name: DaiDee 大弟
apps.short_description: DaiDee 大弟 turns Hong Kong Big Two into a solo run for survival. Split 13 cards into unbeatable combos, chain plays to stoke the Flow, and unleash bombs that seize the table. Between rounds, stack Style cards that rewrite the rules. Miss the target and the run is over. Play it smart, play it loud.

apps.name: Dancing with Ghosts
apps.short_description: Dancing with Ghosts is an uplifting narrative game about learning to live after loss. Befriend a cheery ghost and earn the good karma that recovers her memories by dancing, making roti, and helping your neighbors around a lively Thai river village, finding healing in every connection you make.

apps.name: Dark Fracture
apps.short_description: Dark Fracture is a psychological horror experience in which you explore an ever-changing world where reality and nightmares collide. Walk on the edge of madness in the shoes of a tormented soul as you descend into the darkest depths of the human psyche, and question everything you see.

apps.name: Dark Rail
apps.short_description: Turn-based management roguelike. Command the Inquisition and rule an industrial city on the empire’s edge. Use your train to meet prisoner shipment quotas by hunting heretics and slaying magical beasts. Produce supplies, contain revolt, and sacrifice prisoners to stop the madness.

apps.name: Dark Samurai
apps.short_description: Dark Samurai is a roguelike horde survival game with online co-op multiplayer and persistent progression, set in feudal Japan overrun by demons.

apps.name: Dawn's Wake
apps.short_description: Awaken as a memory-stripped supreme master in a twisted jianghu. Shatter the world's cursed formations, master strategic wuxia combat where one right technique turns the tide, and reclaim your lost throne — while idle progress and a living martial world carry on even when your sword rests.

apps.name: DAYON
apps.short_description: DAYON is a sandbox online open-world game set in a near-future city enclosed by a massive wall. Life, ownership, combat, and exploration exist within one persistent world. Build your own life and stories in a city that changes with real-world time.

apps.name: DD33
apps.short_description: Five dice, five enemy lanes, and a perfectly sensible plan that has yet to survive its first roll. Build poker-style combos, combine cards, and upgrade your dice in a 33-round turn-based roguelike. Luck matters. Leaving it in charge is another matter entirely.

apps.name: Dead Faces
apps.short_description: Dead Faces is a mind bending psychological horror. Unravel Jack's disturbing mind, the faces from his past and the ultimate truth behind his actions. You must remember their faces.

apps.name: DEAD ON FILE
apps.short_description: Detroit, 1998. Investigate crimes through an old police OS: examine documents, connect clues and test alibis. Choose whom to accuse, a motive and evidence for court. Your theory could put an innocent person behind bars. Will you spot the evidence that proves it wrong?

apps.name: DEAD OR ALIVE Xtreme Venus Vacation
Death 1879
apps.short_description: A single-player, first-person mystery set in 1879. Play as Death, explore a village, speak with its inhabitants, gather information and consult your Book as you investigate its secrets.

apps.name: Death In Your Dice
apps.short_description: Roll the dice… or cities die. Learn lethal rules, twist outcomes, accept the cost. One bad throw calls the bombs. Win to delay death. Lose to become a murderer. Every choice reshapes your ending. Fate is loaded. Your turn is encoded?

apps.name: Decay Constant
apps.short_description: Warning. Surveillance and detection systems inactive. Multiple subject containment failure. Facility compromised. I wonder what’ll happen to you? SURREAL SINGLE PLAYER ACTION ORIENTED HALF-LIFE 2 MOD

apps.name: Decayed Cases: Archive 22
apps.short_description: The peaceful, familiar everyday life is completely turned upside down by the chaos that has erupted at the base. The silence of the archive is dissapear, leaving nothing but survival. Will I ever get to tell the story of everything I’ve been through, or will I, too, become a part of the archive?

apps.name: Decromancy
apps.short_description: Take a perilous journey into the Scottish wilderness in seek of immortality, deal in essence with a nebulous druid known as the Peddler to add to your collection of cards, flavorful foods, and legendary items in this morbidly funny dark fantasy rogue-lite card game.

apps.name: Demon Castle Guard
apps.short_description: You are the Demon Lord, and every woman in the land wants to move into your castle. The rejected ones show up with armies for a "hostile job interview." Merge slimes, hold the gate, and pass them all. A cheeky pixel-art tower defense comedy with adult content.

apps.name: Demon Egg
apps.short_description: The roguelike tower defense card game where one card wins the run: Hatch. Grow your economy to afford it sooner, power up your main spell or overwhelm enemies with a swarm. Shape your build through a randomized skill tree and defend your egg until you can pay the price to hatch.

apps.name: Derby Life: Ranch & Race
apps.short_description: Derby Life: Ranch & Race is where great racehorses are made, not born. Breed, raise, and train your own on a living open-world ranch, then saddle up and race the World Tour. Roam, fish, explore, compete. Your ranch, your horse, your glory.

apps.name: Desktop Goofy Guys
apps.short_description: Tiny goofy guys have moved onto your desktop and they're not leaving. They haul coins to your dock, play with toys, and get absolutely obliterated by your death ray. Click-through, always there, always up to something.

apps.name: Desktop Truck Simulator
apps.short_description: Desktop Truck Simulator is a cozy, semi-idle trucking companion that runs quietly in the corner of your screen. Deliver charming cargo, collect lo-fi cassette tapes, take polaroid photos, collect trinkets, rest and socialize at roadside stops in a slow-burn world that respects your time.

apps.name: Destroy the Flag
apps.short_description: Destroy the Flag is a chaotic multiplayer bomb-battler — they get launched, frozen, and hurled across the map instead. Blast your way to the enemy flag before they blast you first, and survive absurd random events like meteor strikes, bouncing dodgeballs, and rogue ice cubes.

apps.name: Die Severed
apps.short_description: Die Severed is a gambling roguelike where each lost round costs you one finger. Stack your dice bag with weighted dice, collect run defining abilities, and push your luck to pay your debt and walk out in one piece. More or less.

apps.name: Dinosaur Shakespeare 3: They Are On The Moon Now And It Escalated Quickly - Bloodcore Edition
apps.short_description: The Saurian Alliance is threatened by The Theropod Empire. That's scary. Our heroes, a ragtag group of dinosaurs from all walks of life (and one that is definitely not a Corgi-Iguanodon hybrid), must band together to fight back against the dark side of The Moon(tm).

apps.name: Dirtborn: Colony Rising
apps.short_description: Ants are fascinating insects, and they have taught mankind what the power of teamwork can accomplish.  Develop your own colony of ants, dig every tunnel, and protect your queen from the numerous enemies you'll encounter!  No two games will ever be the same and online PvP ensures fun to the thorax!

apps.name: Dirtville
apps.short_description: Welcome to small, sunny and abandoned Balkan town where something is quietly wrong. Upgrade your character, abilities and tools in a cozy place where cleaning and digging is how you investigate the world. Dirtville is a mix of satisfying casual mechanics and story-based exploration.

apps.name: Divine Ember
apps.short_description: A hand-drawn cavern adventure. Walk the Green Caverns until your map remembers them, swear vows for tuniks, and wear amulets that change how you fight and find the way out.

apps.name: Divine Frequency
apps.short_description: A fever dream experience about the total collapse of reality as it lingers between states of erasure and transcendence.

apps.name: Doodle Knight
apps.short_description: 2D Drawing Puzzle Platformer

apps.name: Dookie Clicker: The Big Pfft
apps.short_description: Dookie Clicker: The Big Pfft is a toilet-humour clicker set in a bubbling sewer laboratory. Click to make dookie, build ten ridiculous factories from the Whoopie Cushion to the Methane Volcano, snatch random power-ups and grow your stinkiest empire yet.

apps.name: Doomgard
apps.short_description: Awaken in a forgotten, mist-shrouded wilderness with no memory of your past or your death. Gather resources, craft tools, build shelter, uncover ancient secrets, and try to survive in a world that seems to already know you.

apps.name: Doomsday Survivor 末日幸存者
apps.short_description: 《Doomsday Survivor 末日幸存者》 is a shooting game with a post-apocalyptic theme. Players will face the threats of zombies and rebels. They need to defend against zombie attacks, go out to explore, collect supplies and avoid the attacks of zombies and rebels.

apps.name: Dread Bids
apps.short_description: A first-person horror auction. Bid against three desperate rivals on cursed relics, read their nerves and snipe before the hammer falls, then survive whatever you bought. Every night, the poorest guest does not go home.

apps.name: DREADMOOR
apps.short_description: DREADMOOR is a dark first-person fishing adventure game set in a submerged world, rotting from a past catastrophe. Fish in murky waters, upgrade your boat, craft survival gear, and fight monstrous creatures that lurk under the water and on the land.

apps.name: Dreamsend: Wintersong
apps.short_description: Experience a new approach to turn-based tactical combat in this 2.5D cyberpunk fantasy Strategy RPG. Empower your roster with abilities and items inspired by genre classics and MOBAs. Face unforgiving battles and grand multiphase bossfights to shape the fate of Veichne, the land of eternal winters.

apps.name: Drive To The Top
apps.short_description: Jump, Swing and Boost your way to get to the finish as fast as you can! Try beating the level in both single player and 2-player co-op. How fast can you beat the game?

apps.name: DriveGear
apps.short_description: DriveGear is a single-player spin-combat action roguelite. Battle through each district in a city-wide tournament.  Route your optimal path, take on contracts, tune your build, battle rivals, and earn your way to the Crown Arena.

apps.name: Dungeon Descent
apps.short_description: Dungeon Descent is an incremental dungeon crawler where you fight enemies, acquire loot, and descend into increasingly more difficult floors of the dungeon.

apps.name: Dungeon Munchies 2 餐癮地城：貳度救業
apps.short_description: Who in their right mind would even WANT to eat cosmic monsters? Find out in this side-scrollin', action-fightin', level-grindin', treasure-lootin', dungeon-munchin' grubapalooza!

apps.name: Dungeon Packer
apps.short_description: Dungeon Packer is the inventory management roguelike. Strategically place items in your backpack to trigger synergies between them and score enough points to defeat monsters. Discover crazy synergies, optimize your inventory, and enjoy the journey in this hypnotically satisfying game!

apps.name: Dungeons & Desserts
apps.short_description: Dungeons & Desserts is a roguelite dungeon crawler where you also run a cosy bakery. Journey through candy-themed realms, gather rare ingredients and craft mouth-watering desserts to sell across your counter, cafe and relic room, all while a greedy landlord keeps raising your rent.

apps.name: Dungeons & Dragons: Long Rest Tavern
apps.short_description: Tired of going on adventures? Build and run the finest tavern in the coziest corner of the Dungeons & Dragons universe. Let heroes face danger, while you turn their tales into your fortune. Every legend needs a long rest.

apps.name: Dwelltris
apps.short_description: A new take on the classic block-spinning, line-clearning, high-scoring game involving tetrominoes!

apps.name: Dying Patience
apps.short_description: For years, you cared for your mother until her illness began to destroy your life. Her weak voice, her exhausted appearance, her fading consciousness... Are you willing to keep enduring this?

apps.name: Eastfold Club Manager
apps.short_description:
Relive the golden days of football manager games in the 90’s.

Take control of a low league team in Europe or an established super club.

Control the squad, your staff, finances, transfers.

Get talent from abroad and grow your youth to superstars.

apps.name: Eaves
apps.short_description: An old painter lived out his days in the mountains, painting. His scrolls, left untended, slowly faded—until a charming little painting spirit was born among them, heir to all he knew. With her help, wield pixel stickers as your brush: mend the faded scrolls, paint new ones, bring his world to life.

apps.name: Ebon Age Tactics
apps.short_description: Turn-based tactics in a world without magic, at the moment magic arrives. Resources are shared between units — spend the party's movement and mana where the fighting is, and make every action worthwhile.

apps.name: Echo Punk
apps.short_description: Echo Punk is a roguelite top-down looter shooter with fast-paced combat, tactical upgrades, and endless replayability. Blast through waves of enemies, collect resources, and upgrade your build -- or die trying.

apps.name: Elevator Button Simulator
apps.short_description: Step into an elevator, press the buttons, and travel between floors. A simulator built around a small part of everyday life. Enjoy watching the elevator respond to each press.

apps.name: Elixir Shop Together
apps.short_description: Need a break? Open your own fantasy potion shop with your friends! Gather ingredients, process them, brew potions, and cure the troubles of customers visiting your shop. Add Elixir Shop Together to your Wishlist and prepare to step into a magical world with your friends!

apps.name: Elroy Goes Bugzerk
apps.short_description: The 90s point-and-click classic returns! Help Elroy and Blue find the legendary Technoloptera to win the 10th Annual Insectathon. Outsmart arch-rival Gordon Smugs, solve brain-teasing puzzles, and learn real science in this fully animated interactive adventure story.

apps.name: Elroy Hits the Pavement
apps.short_description: Blue has been dog-napped! Join Elroy and Syd in this comedic, fully animated, point-and-click adventure to rescue Elroy's dog and recover their stolen science project before summer school. Solve clever puzzles using lasers, codes, and battery power, and shape the story in this 90s classic!

apps.name: Elroy's Costume Closet
apps.short_description: The 1996 Headbone Interactive classic is back! Help Elroy and Syd save the Camelian Theater in this retro restored dress-up game. Mix wild outfits to unlock 75+ funny, fully voiced short animated skits. A retro revival packed with original 90s magic, optimized for modern desktops!

apps.name: Elroy: King of the Jungle
apps.short_description: A Brand-New 30-Year-Old Game. This 90's animated point-and-click adventure is finally released! Crash-land in a dangerous jungle with Elroy, his sidekick Blue AND Elroy’s annoying little brother Slim. Solve puzzles, survive crazy calamities, and navigate challenges to bring everyone home safe.

apps.name: Elven Watcher
apps.short_description: To protect the future of the Elven race and to avenge those who have perished, wage war upon the foul Undead!

apps.name: Emanet - Kalanların Hikayesi
apps.short_description: Datça, 1987. Run a seaside left-luggage counter: compare claim tickets, items and the ledger, catch the lies and decide who walks away with what. By night, chase Elif, who vanished seven years ago, through crayon-drawn dreams that regain their colour as you draw near.

apps.name: Emoji : Tidy Up
apps.short_description: Sort, match, and organize a colorful world of emojis! Discover 2,100 adorable emoji characters, solve relaxing sorting puzzles, and turn chaos into perfect order. Enjoy a cozy and satisfying experience where every move brings joy. Create your own tidy emoji collection!

apps.name: Endless Tower
apps.short_description: Climb an endless tower, keep your momentum, and time each jump to reach the next platform. No enemies — just your reflexes and your own record. The tower regenerates every run, so every climb is a chance to beat your best.

apps.name: Epic Seven
apps.short_description:
PLAY THE ANIMATION! A playable anime in your hands, Epic Seven.
A turn-based Hero collection RPG alive with stunning 2D visuals. Collect unique Heroes in the Seventh World and plan your path to victory through elemental effects and skill combinations.
Challenge Heirs worldwide in World Arena PvP.

apps.name: Epoch Forge
apps.short_description: A 2D colony simulator and sandbox where you make a name for yourself in a dying world. You can type freely to anyone, and they remember what you did. Mine, build, wire logic circuits, appease five silent gods, and push the limits of reality. No ending, no win screen. Pace yourself.

apps.name: Eris One Stand
apps.short_description: Join the Pook Star Legion in this shoot ’em up roguelike and battle through waves of enemies. Dodge incoming fire and choose your upgrades to transform your ship throughout each run as you fight to reclaim the Kryos Crystals stolen from the Pooks.

apps.name: Escape from Track 7
apps.short_description: The last train is gone, and Track 7 won't let you leave. Watch for anomalies: if something is wrong, turn back; if not, keep walking. One mistake and you start over. A short spot-the-anomaly horror in an eerily real Japanese station, from a series with over 100,000 copies sold.

apps.name: Eternal Conquest
apps.short_description: A competitive multiplayer action RPG where players battle for dominance in a dynamic world, earning powerful rewards and ranking through challenging PvE encounters.

apps.name: Everforge Legacy
apps.short_description: Everforge Legacy is a classic action RPG solo experience, built for players who remember when a world felt like it had secrets worth finding

apps.name: Everybody MAHJONG!
apps.short_description: Learn, customize, and play 8 traditional Mahjong rulesets, including Japanese Riichi to Hong Kong and Taiwanese. Features interactive tutorials for beginners, house-rule customization, and solo play or online multiplayer. This is Everybody MAHJONG!

apps.name: Evoplasm
apps.short_description: Evolve and fight in this creature building Roguelike. Grow a creature by attaching new cells, add mutations to create powerful synergies, fight real-time tactical battles against weird enemies, and strategically choose a path across multiple campaign acts. Inspired by games like Spore and FTL.

apps.name: Expendabots
apps.short_description: Expendabots is a 1–4 player co-op horror-extraction game where expendable robots explore ever-changing islands and terrifying dungeons. Outmatched and vulnerable, you’ll need to stay quiet, hide from hostile creatures, survive the horrors, and extract with your squad before the island is lost.

apps.name: Explore the Universe 2175
apps.short_description: MEGABOT arrives in 12 minutes. Discover an ancient alien defense network, blast-mine through asteroids in physics-driven combat, enhance your ship, discover allies, and friendly NPCs then hold the line when the machine armada comes for you. A roguelite space survival game in a galaxy at war.

apps.name: Exterminauts
apps.short_description: Exterminauts is a co-op third-person PvE shooter using weaponized power tools and mad-science gadgets to exterminate alien pests. Take on MegaCorp contracts amid energy supremacy clashes, while aliens' thirst for Polymorphic Plasma disrupts plans. Punch In. Clean Up. Get Paid.

apps.name: Extreme Paddle Board
apps.short_description: Stand up, paddle hard and try not to fall in. Race stand-up paddle boards down wild rivers round the world, through rapids, over waterfalls and off kickers, with friends bumping you into the water. Wobble, wipe out, climb back on, win.

apps.name: Fallen Memory
apps.short_description: Nathan, who has no memory of his past, wakes up in a dark house he doesn’t recognize. Every door that opens forces us to confront our past. In this psychological horror game, you must uncover the truth behind your lost memories while facing dark secrets and mental collapse.

apps.name: FALLENMAGE Received: Hypnosis's Curse
apps.short_description: An adult RPG focusing on hypnosis and mind break. Explore the town and talk to marked NPCs to easily trigger events. With complex combat removed, you can fully focus on pleasure. Featuring 100+ CGs and Live2D animations, witness a rational mage girl fall into a trap and succumb to lust!

apps.name: False Feed
apps.short_description: Compare four surveillance feeds and find the one that contradicts the other three. Pause, rewind, and examine the same event from different perspectives in this deduction game. Work through 18 recordings across six work sites at your own pace.

apps.name: Fangtopia
apps.short_description: Sink your teeth into Fangtopia, a cozy and relaxing tile puzzle game where you assemble landscapes to craft a monsterrific paradise for friendly ghouls and ghosts. Design a carefree, scare-free world of gentle chills.

apps.name: Farm Of Hope
apps.short_description:
Build a hopeful farm in rural Africa.
Grow crops, dig wells, help villages survive drought, and transform dry land into a thriving community inspired by real humanitarian stories.

apps.name: Farm Story Life
apps.short_description: Grow crops, care for adorable animals, customize your farm, and build your dream countryside home in this relaxing casual single-player farming adventure.

apps.name: Farmbotic
apps.short_description: Get ready to venture into the world of Farmbotic. Prepare to automate the farm work with the help of your trusty bots. Explore and fight your way through the mines. Optimize the transportation of your resources and help the villagers with their tasks. All that alone or with friends!

apps.name: Fatespun
apps.short_description:
Choose a hero, plot a route through a haunted kingdom, and build a formation of cards that fights
for you. A dark romantic card roguelite where every choice on the map and at the table shapes the
run.

apps.name: Father, Son and Holy Guns
apps.short_description: Holy Guns is a fast-paced roguelite multiplayer game set in a bizarre world where faith fuels firepower and every run tests your sanity!

apps.name: Femboy Futa Casino
apps.short_description: Deal cards, uncover secrets, and choose who to trust at The Velvet Ace. An adult visual novel featuring femboy and futanari characters, six romance routes, 10 minigames, and multiple endings. Can you save a casino drowning in debt and find someone worth staying for?

apps.name: Fiak
apps.short_description: Four nights of survival in a realistic, immersive horror experience. Alone in your house, you face a malicious entity determined to get inside. This is not a walking simulator: every decision affects your survival. One mistake is fatal.

apps.name: File Corruption
apps.short_description: After 30 years, the automated robots at a sorting facility suddenly break down. You take a temporary job at the center until they are fixed. Survive five nights in the horror game FILE CORRUPTION, and stay alert!

apps.name: Fire and Brim Co.
apps.short_description: Embark on a wild and wacky adventure in this top-down action RPG! Take on the role of Ned, a disgruntled demon employee seeking to restore Hell's former glory. Fight your way through the corporate ladder of Fire and Brim Co., to confront its leaders and its evil CEO Satan!

apps.name: FIRE. HOLD. REPEAT.
apps.short_description: The only desktop companion shooter on Steam. Your soldier holds the line right on your desktop. Every click and every keystroke fires a shot – fend off endless enemy waves, loot weapons and upgrade your gear while you go about your day.

apps.name: First Layer: 3D Printing Simulator
apps.short_description: Build and run your own 3D printing workshop! Prepare models, run your printers, and complete orders. Manage filament stock, plan production, and sell your products. Invest in new printers, expand your workshop, and grow your business layer by layer.

apps.name: Fish Market Tidy Up
apps.short_description: Fish Market Tidy Up is a cozy single-player organizing simulator where you sort different species of fish scattered throughout a fish store. Return every fish to its proper place, organize collections by type, unlock helpful abilities, and restore perfect order as efficiently as possible.

apps.name: FishyFox
apps.short_description: Take Dad’s favorite rod on a cozy fishing adventure across lake, river, and ocean. Guide your hook, reel in trophy catches, upgrade your gear, and enter tournaments. Keep your favorite fish in aquariums you can decorate, and fill your journal as you discover new species.

apps.name: Fitz's Aim Trainer
apps.short_description: An FPS aim trainer that runs natively on Mac and Windows. 30 default excercises along  custom excercise creation. There is a ranked benchmark mode ranging from Mortal to Omnipotent, global leaderboards and custom excercise sharing. Made by one person who just wanted an aim trainer for Mac.

apps.name: Five Blades Deep
apps.short_description: A deck-building roguelike. Pick one of five heroes and fight down through six themed dungeons, playing your hand in ATB battles. Win new cards from every fight, make the best ones permanent at every boss, and bring the five scattered Blades home to end the Demon for good.

apps.name: Flakeparty
apps.short_description: Build the perfect cereal bowl and score insane amounts of points in this relaxing roguelike deckbuilder. Trigger delicious combos, collect quirky cereals, earn toys by playing rule-twisting minigames and eat tasty snacks to help along the way as you reach the highest points!

apps.name: Fleets of Valor
apps.short_description: Fleets of Valor is a single-player WWII naval real-time tactics game. Command ships, aircraft and submarines from a tactical map, then take direct control in third-person view during combat. Maneuver fleets, launch carrier strikes, escort bombers and engage in dogfights.

apps.name: FlipBAKA
apps.short_description: Flip floor panels and launch enemies — and friends — off the island! Top-down arcade party action: explore and power up in Dungeon Mode, play 8 solo stages and a boss, co-op, or 8-player online PvP. Just one more round! Dungeon demo has online co-op. Downloads planned to end with Steam Next Fest.

apps.name: Flying Pigs
apps.short_description:
Your plane is on fire, you're wounded, but don't give up! You are the last hope to end World War II!
Six pilots with a devastating arsenal! Face the hell of the skies in single-player or co-op, survive breathtaking battlefields, and obliterate colossal bosses in this fast-paced shooter!

apps.name: Fog Keeper
apps.short_description: "Fog Keeper" is a tower-defense survival game. You will establish defenses on a fog-shrouded alien world, gather resources, research technologies, hold the Energy Tower against the monster hordes that surge in every night, and uncover the true secrets hidden within.

apps.name: Follow Suit
apps.short_description: Playing card games (Spades, Hearts, Solitaire, Freecell, more coming) with your friends, vs bots, or solo. Make a table, share a code or link, and play between any devices. Bots fill empty seats, choose rule sets or adjust individual options.

apps.name: Forgefall
apps.short_description: Forgefall is an active incremental game where your lantern cuts through a scrolling forest. Break trees, rocks, goblins, and chests, aim the resources they drop, build processors, and buy permanent upgrades that make each run more productive.

apps.name: Fornani
apps.short_description: Explore an ancient island that drifts amongst the raging clouds of a gas giant. Collect various guns and items, solve puzzles, and shoot any thugs or monsters that get in your way. Meet the locals and aid them in their quest to take down Skycorps while they aid you with yours: finding your brother.

apps.name: Forum Mortuorum
apps.short_description: Take the reins of a Roman gladiator school. Hire and equip your team, freely combining powerful gear effects to create overpowered panoplies. Accept challenges wisely: once in the arena, your gladiators must fend for themselves until they find glory or death!

apps.name: Fox Spirit Sweethearts: Complete Edition
apps.short_description: A high school romance visual novel. Weeks after you free three foxes from a trap, the same three walk into your classroom as transfer students. Spend your afternoons with the kitsune passing as your classmates, and stand with them when the forest is marked for clearing. 39 chapters.

apps.name: From Ruins
apps.short_description: A new-gen detective adventure combining deduction gameplay with a gripping story full of twists and turns. Gather clues, establish connections, and solve a series of increasingly challenging cases. Will you uncover the feud that began at the end of the world?

apps.name: Fuji Flip
apps.short_description:
Flip two cards. Hear the word. Match the pair.
 Fuji Flip is a memory card game for language learners: every card shows a picture and a word and says it out loud,
 so you pick up real Japanese, Spanish and French words while you play.

apps.name: Fully Funded
apps.short_description: Practice for a prop firm evaluation with your friends. One shared account, the same kinds of rules (daily loss limit, trailing drawdown, profit targets), pro-style charts with indicators and drawing tools, and a room full of things to throw when someone blows it.

apps.name: Furmageddon
apps.short_description:
Haha! I'm in! I hacked the devs' Steam page! 🦝
Rizzo here. Get ready for a 1-4 player online co-op roguelite bullet heaven. Pick your Furmate, build crazy loadouts and see how long you can survive solo or team up with friends to take on hordes of monsters. What could possibly go wrong?

apps.name: G.E.M. Grab & Exit
apps.short_description: Hand-Drawn Twin-Stick Shooter in space where one must survive the robotic ships onslaught and extract with the loot to exchange for ship upgrades.

apps.name: GeForce 8800 GTX Anniversary
apps.short_description: Relive one of the most iconic graphics cards in history with this semi-interactive high-end cinematic experience of unprecedented visual detail, showcasing the latest NVIDIA RTX graphical features, exclusively for NVIDIA GPUs.

apps.name: General Tactics: An Shi Rebellion
apps.short_description: In November 755, An Lushan launched a rebellion against the Tang Empire. You will be appointed as the acting Military Governor of Shuofang. Conquer territories on a free-roaming world map, build your armies, develop cities, and navigate various events as you fight to quell the rebellion.

apps.name: GENNADIYYY
apps.short_description:
A third-person comedy puzzle game about a vlogger. Gennady is trying to get through an ordinary evening: get some bread,

feed his guests using whatever is in the fridge, and record a calm video.
