apps.name: Get Outta My Gut
apps.short_description: A roguelite tower defense game where you protect your body from invading germs. Draft turret cards, build strong defenses, and supply them with blood to protect your heart. Fight through 10 organs and evolve your immune system between runs.

apps.name: Glacis
apps.short_description: You can't block the enemy's road, but you can move the earth. Raise the ground to bend their path, put your guns on the heights, and hold the same corridor through three wars, from towed guns and dive bombers to helicopter assaults and drone swarms.

apps.name: Gloosh!
apps.short_description: Run, jump and dash through a momentum-driven 3D platformer with incremental progression. Record runs, let clones earn income, buy upgrades and return faster. Refine your routes, collect stars and chase better course times in Gloosh!

apps.name: Golgothian
apps.short_description: Build a three-hero party in a dark-fantasy roguelike deckbuilder. Queue actions, read enemy intent, trigger class combos, equip survivors, and choose routes through doomed dungeon runs alone or in co-op.

apps.name: Gonggi: Recess
apps.short_description: Recess. Five gonggi stones on your desk. Scatter, toss, pick up and catch them with a physics-driven hand. Play from Onesies to the Flip on your own or against your seatmate or a Steam friend, and between rounds get up to doodle on the chalkboard and play the reed organ.

apps.name: Gore and Grace
apps.short_description: Gore and Grace is a single-player 2D top-down action RPG. Slay vicious monsters, scavenge gear to survive, and build your skills against elite foes. Death is the norm — every fall brings you closer to victory. Between gore and grace, earn your glory and title.

apps.name: Grass-n-Gnomes
apps.short_description: Play as a lawnmower with the mission to cut and trim lawns of magical grass across different biomes, infested with colorful Gnomes.

apps.name: Grave Mistakes
apps.short_description: Manage and supervise the Good Mourning™ Funeral Home in 2-4 player co-op. Grieving families need your attention: prepare bodies for their final viewing, deliver a passionate eulogy, and steal a couple limbs along the way. Dinner has to come from somewhere.

apps.name: Gravitus
apps.short_description: Enter a massive battlefield where two teams clash over resources, strategy, and firepower. Start as infantry, pilot hover tanks or flying pods, and unleash laser-based combat in a sci-fi warzone reminiscent of classic space battles.

apps.name: Gravity Goblins
apps.short_description: A gravity-bending roguelite collectathon where you ascend an ever-shifting tower. Manipulate geometry to your whims, snag some coins, and play the night away at the local arcade! You'll need all the upgrades and trinkets you can gather to discover the secret buried at the top of The Old Stipe...

apps.name: Greaselord
apps.short_description: Build the biggest fast food empire in the world and defend it against three rival chains before the health authorities ban you. Your goal: 80% of the world market across 169 countries, with one of 14 main dishes.

apps.name: Grench Boss
apps.short_description: One goblin wants to become the greenskin boss with a single stolen wrench. Hopeless, right? Well, that goblin is you now. Build walls and turrets, swing your wrench sometimes, and beat the pirate rats. Steal their ship, make it stronger, and let's go back proudly to the tribe who kicked me out!

apps.name: Grr Grr Gnomes
apps.short_description: A co-op adventure about tiny gnomes on a very big ocean. Sail from island to island, scavenge for supplies, fight strange creatures, survive whatever goes horribly wrong, and keep your ship moving toward one goal, finding the way home...

apps.name: Gumball Hero
apps.short_description: A fast-paced 3D action roguelike where you play as a gumball machine, shooting bouncing candy to survive waves of enemies. Build your loadout, combine powerful gumballs, and reclaim your mall before it’s too late.

apps.name: GummyGom Delivery
apps.short_description: Carry cargo together on a shared board with your jelly bear teammates! Each movement affects the board’s balance, and a single mistake can bring everything crashing down.

apps.name: Gym Tidy: Re-rack Your Weights
apps.short_description: Gym Tidy: Re-rack Your Weights is a gym-themed organizing game supporting up to 4 players online. Clean up the fitness space and get some exercise along the way. Some heavy dumbbells cannot be lifted right from the start.

apps.name: Hack And Slash Fury 2: Lancelot Betrayal
apps.short_description: Destroy the dark warriors with your sword at the rythm of heavy metal and see epic cinematics while you master the complex combat system to humilliate your rivals online or offline, here you will find fun, satire, and war created and combined like never before by his developer.

apps.name: Hair Removal Salon Simulator
apps.short_description: Ready your laser, rev up those trimmers, and run your own hair removal salon! Utilize cutting-edge salon tech, leaving clients hair-free and feeling fresh. Manage their pain levels, launch ludicrous sales pitches, and sink profits into gear upgrades and employees. Become a grooming powerhouse!

apps.name: Half-Life Legacy
apps.short_description: Relive Half-Life 1 with bug fixes, enhanced controller support, Steam Achievements, bunny-hopping, Steam Workshop support, and more, in the ultimate restoration.
developers: FOUNDATION Project - The Phoenix Project Software SVG

apps.name: HALF-LIFE: CROSS PRODUCT
apps.short_description: The multiplayer component of HALF-LIFE: CROSS PRODUCT, an ambitious game whose campaign has been in development since 2020. Experience fast, extensively customizable combat with dynamic modes, expanded weaponry, advanced movement, and years of evolving content.
developers: CONFLUX Project - The Phoenix Project Software SVG
Adrenaline Gamer Team (MP original codebase development)

apps.name: Halloween Shop Simulator
apps.short_description: Manage a Halloween shop in a town full of monsters. Furnish your home, adopt a weird pet, explore the streets and discover a nightlife full of secrets, smugglers and spooky surprises.

apps.name: Halloweenies Candy Run
apps.short_description:
Trick-or-treat with up to 4 players. Loot the houses on procedurally generated streets.
Find rare physics based candy and bank it before the Candy KPI catches up with you.
Buy weapons and abilities to help your odds against the horde. Your friends can hear proximity chat, but so can the hunters.

apps.name: Hands of the Sovereign
apps.short_description:
It's time to duel on Fardea Island! Encounter a colourful cast of rivals! Challenge your host: Lord Blackthorn!
Assemble your own personal deck, and do battle upon a grid-based battlefield.

apps.name: Hapervil
apps.short_description: Play as Amaya and Wil, navigating a forsaken orphanage where secrets lurk in the dark. Solve puzzles, uncover hidden truths, and survive a psychological horror tale where innocence twists into nightmare and shadows patiently wait to strike.

apps.name: HAPPY PROPAGANDA
apps.short_description: Approve or censor live chat in Happy Propaganda. Balance viewer anger and the host's well-being, choose broadcast topics, and talk off-air. Five days of choices lead to multiple endings.

apps.name: Heatwarped
apps.short_description: Ratfield sits atop an underground racing scene. Conquer the streets by warping the odds in your favor. Customize your ride to the max, meet up with other racers from your pda's racing forum to compete, and build respect.

apps.name: HEAVENBREAK
apps.short_description: A fast-paced third-person roguelite shooter. Hold the line against relentless waves, upgrade your weapons, and create devastating builds with each run.

apps.name: Heavy in the Hand
apps.short_description: Cock the hammer, pull the trigger, count to six. Release the cylinder, eject the shells, count to six again. You hold death in your hand, and death is heavy. Descend to the abyss, shoot the horrors you can comprehend, and survive the horrors you cannot.

apps.name: HEME
apps.short_description: A short 2D side-scrolling narrative game about love and a bond that others may never understand.

apps.name: Hermit Computer
apps.short_description: Hermit Computer is a horror-puzzle game set in 2001. Deep within the Hermit Kingdom, you play as an outsider tasked with extracting critical intelligence using a secretive state-controlled computer operating system.

apps.name: Hero Slayers
apps.short_description:
Hero Slayers is a roguelite turn-based strategy RPG.
You must shape the fate of Lucy, who finds herself trapped in a crisis from which there's no easy escape due to a single misstep.
Even if you fail, make different choices next time—so that you may reach a better ending.

apps.name: Heroll: IF
apps.short_description: Roll the dice, survive the chaos, and rebuild a broken world in this roguelite board-game RPG. Battle through unpredictable loops, recruit adorable pets, face wild events, and grow stronger with every roll.

apps.name: HexaFootball
apps.short_description: HexaFootball is a turn-based football strategy game where chess-like decisions replace reflexes. Build your team, manage action points, and outthink your opponent on a hex grid. Every pass, every move, and every match is a battle of pure tactics.

apps.name: Heya! Sumo Manager
apps.short_description: Heya! Sumo Manager allows you to manage a sumo stable and develop the skills of your rikishi on their road to Yokozuna! Climb from Jonokuchi to Sekitori by organizing the diet, training and tactics of your wrestlers and see them compete in 3D matches.

apps.name: Hidden in Plain Cake
apps.short_description: Sculpt, slice, and paint real cake into perfect copies of everyday objects — then invite your friends online to spot the fake. Every cut reveals the sponge layers inside. Fool them, or get sliced open trying.

apps.name: Hide & Chisel
apps.short_description: Carve your body out of marble, and stand as still as a statue! Hide & Chisel is a hide-and-seek game where you carve a block of stone into any shape you can think of. Hide from the Curator and his hammer!

apps.name: Hideout Heist
apps.short_description: A co-op horror heist for 1–4 players. Break into a store after dark, grab fragile physics loot and haul it out before the night shift gets you. Hide in the shadows, outsmart guards and worse, and make the quota. The building is different every night. The fun is the same - brand best.

apps.name: High Stakes Chess
apps.short_description: A fusion of poker and chess where cards determine the pieces you bring into battle. Bet on each hand, place your pieces, then fight it out on the chessboard.

apps.name: Hiroka Toudou's Whore-o-ic Tale
apps.short_description: Whore or hero? Body, soul, pride, future... sacrifice it all to become a hero! Protect the city till there's nothing left of you in the ultimate hero-breaking RPG experience!

apps.name: HO HO HO SOKOBAN
apps.short_description: A cozy Christmas-themed Sokoban puzzle game where Santa must push presents into the right places. Solve 50 handcrafted pixel art levels full of festive charm.

apps.name: Hold My Wand
apps.short_description: Co-op potion brewing for 1–4 players. Gather ingredients, use magic to modify them by tracing spells by hand, fight off enemies, and complete the order. Drink potions for massive power buffs — spiraling your shift into drunken ragdoll chaos.

apps.name: Home Sweet Bunker: Bunker Tycoon
apps.short_description: A darkly funny bunker management sim. Build down, admit survivors at the gate and pray none of them is infected. Every night something new tests your layout: diggers from below, crawlers in the vents, spores in the air, screamers drawn to your generators.

apps.name: HOMEBODiES
apps.short_description: Explore and capture beautiful online environments with your friends.

apps.name: HopelessSchool
apps.short_description: 1–4 co-op top-down survival. A medical accident sparks a global disaster reaching Ivy High School. Eight students with unique skills leave the safe room, dodging or fighting the living dead while scavenging supplies and clues, hoping to last until rescue. The "truths" lead to 6 endings.

apps.name: Horny Slots: Spin to Sin
apps.short_description: At this casino, every winning spin fuels not only the thrill of the game, but the interest of the local girls. Place your bets, land winning combinations, and see how far luck takes you – the better you play, the bolder their desires and the more they reveal themselves to you.

apps.name: Hot Mic
apps.short_description: Your friends have heard your Roman emperor a hundred times. Nobody's ready for your cockerel.🐔 Hot Mic is an online party game played with your voice, for 2 to 8 players. Set your mic ablaze!🔥

apps.name: House Of Echoes
apps.short_description: Its eyes are piercing into your soul from the darkness with ever growing anger. It won't leave you alone until you solve the puzzles and uncover your traumatic past. Can you work out all of the unique puzzles and find out what happened before it all fades into nothingness?

apps.name: How to Use
apps.short_description: No instructions. No hints. Just you, mysterious controls, and over 15,000 possible combinations. Experiment your way through this unique puzzle experience.

apps.name: Hueless
apps.short_description: The hueless horde is invisible except for their glowing eyes. Wound them and they bleed into full sight. Wizard with a gun. Sling fire, shock, frost, wind, earth, water and gravity or powerful weaponry. Destroyable environments also my dude

apps.name: Human Resources
apps.short_description:
Race through fast-paced levels while killing clones in increasingly absurd ways!

Unlock all the medals, get promoted, beat your friends times, and discover the secrets of the Human Resources department.

apps.name: HYPERDROP: A Pachinko Roguelite
apps.short_description: Build impossible scoring machines in HYPERDROP, a hypnotizing physics-based pachinko roguelite bursting with satisfying chain reactions and game-breaking combos.

apps.name: HyperFatal
apps.short_description: AIR STRAFE, ROCKET JUMP, and SURF your way through dimensions in this HYPER-intensive skill-based movement shooter of old. The onslaught of foes in your way are invading worlds, and the only way to stop them is to show you will be FATAL.

apps.name: I Saw a Flying Saucer
apps.short_description: An interactive fiction about a man who lost his wife and goes in search of a UFO that shouldn't exist.

apps.name: I Swear I Parked Here
apps.short_description: You swear you parked right here. Now find your car among thousands of identical ones. Start with an old-fashioned key, upgrade to a remote with growing range, take your time and conquer lots with 1,000 to 50,000 cars, and beyond.

apps.name: I'm No Gambling God
apps.short_description: Witness the birth of a new God of Gamblers! A casino sim + strategy-building online co-op game for 1-4 players. Team up, share goals, build synergies, and beat 5-minute floors to win big. Can you become the God of Gamblers?

apps.name: Ice Cream Shop Simulator
apps.short_description: Run a seaside ice cream shop solo or in co-op with up to 6 players. Make ice cream, serve unpredictable customers, earn money, unlock new equipment, and expand and customize your shop as each day gets more chaotic.

apps.name: iceman
apps.short_description: A hand-drawn papercut desktop pet with blind-box collecting and Pomodoro focus. A fridge-bellied grandpa and a big-mouthed cow cat live in your screen corner

apps.name: Idle Hoops
apps.short_description: An incremental idle basketball game. Shoot hoops, sign a roster that ends with an actual goat, and let your team keep scoring while you're away. Win championships, hang your retired jersey in the rafters, and work your way up from the driveway to a court in outer space.

apps.name: Idle Necronomics
apps.short_description: Incremental Idle Souls Gambling Investing Clicker. You are the Necromancer. Reap the living, turn their Souls into supernatural capital, and build an undead operation that keeps the harvest going around the clock.

apps.name: Idyll
apps.short_description: A 3D voxel fantasy colony sim with online co-op. Build a settlement block-by-block, mine deep for rare resources, craft powerful gear, and defend your colonists from monsters and rival factions.

apps.name: Immune Commander
apps.short_description: You are a dendritic cell. Rally neutrophils, charge into bacteria, carry antigen to the lymph node and craft antibodies. A roguelike blend of RTS and tower defense that follows one patient's immune system from age 2 to 72 — built on real immunology.

apps.name: In Two The Paint
apps.short_description: An asymmetric co-op puzzle game where two players are trapped in separate worlds. Explore a 3D mansion in first person and a 2D world of paintings through point-and-click gameplay. Work together to solve puzzles, but with only your voices to communicate. Can you break free from your family’s fate?

apps.name: Incremental Heist
apps.short_description: Destroy and steal everything in your own pawn shop, then claim it all on insurance! Play as a jailbroken dapper cleaning bot, upgrade your crew, and turn increasingly spectacular destruction into increasingly ridiculous payouts.

apps.name: IncrementalOS
apps.short_description: An incremental love letter to the 90s desktop. Start with a blank desktop and one icon, unlock programs, systems and minigames, make more money, and build your way up to a system worth bragging about.

apps.name: INK MAZE
apps.short_description: Chart your own path through a fog-shrouded dungeon in INK MAZE! Design cryptic treasure maps to solve puzzles, outsmart traps, and collect loot hidden within the mist. But when you reach the depths of the maze, will you still be able to decipher the symbols you charted long ago?

apps.name: Inkturn
apps.short_description: A compact puzzle game about guiding two inkfish one at a time to collect every star. Each star switches control to the other. Think ahead and leave the right trail. It blocks one inkfish but helps the other.

apps.name: Intergalactic Puzzle Touchdown
apps.short_description: Intergalactic Puzzle Touchdown is a first-of-its-kind asymmetric turn-based PvP puzzle game fusing the familiar mechanics of classic match-3 games with the excitement of gridiron football. Match tiles to earn yards, dodge your opponent's blockers, and create Big Plays to light up the scoreboard!

apps.name: Intersingles
apps.short_description:
A competitive fps for your best friend group.
Up to 6 players can compete in the round-robin singles(1v1) format match. Play against your best friends or players around the globe.

apps.name: Into The Unwell
apps.short_description: Whack-and-slash your inner demons in this third-person roguelite, set in a rubber hose fuelled fever dream! Play 1-3 players as one of several flawed and heavily medicated misfits.
developers: She Was Such A Good Horse

apps.name: Irish Sport Manager
apps.short_description: A management sim for the Gaelic games: football, hurling, camogie and ladies' football. Take a county, pick your fifteen from the clubs inside it, and answer to a board that remembers everything.

apps.name: IRON FURY
apps.short_description: Neon-noir beat 'em up for 1-2 players. Includes PART I: STREETS OF VENGEANCE, PART II: OVERCLOCK and SURVIVAL MODE: two full campaigns, couch co-op, combos, throws, support strikes and 13 boss fights, told in painted comic panels.

apps.name: Irradiant Skies
apps.short_description: Irradiant Skies is an arcade roguelite blending brick-breaking and bullet-parrying combat. Reflect enemy attacks, chain powerful upgrades, and master unique ships as you ascend through waves of enemies.

apps.name: iScoot
apps.short_description: Indie scooter game

apps.name: Isekai Truck: On My Usual Way to School, a Huge TRUCK Hit Me, When I Came To, I'd Been REBORN by a Goddess, While I Was Still Lost, the Archmage Who'd Apparently Summoned Me Said I'm the Chosen HERO, So I'm Off to the GUILD First, I Guess ~Hit by a Truck, I Woke Up in Another World~
apps.short_description: The title says it all. But if you insist: a first-person dungeon-crawling action RPG where you cast spells by drawing runes with your mouse. Gear up in town, descend floor by floor, defeat monsters and bosses, and make your way to the Demon King.

apps.name: Iz and Auggie: Escape from Dimension Q
apps.short_description: Bandmates Iz and her robot Auggie wrote a killer song. Cosmo LaRue stole it. Recover the song from Dimension Q in this animated point-and-click puzzle adventure from 1996: descramble codes, outrun the Q cops, crack a musical lock, and rescue missing secret agents.

apps.name: Janet DeMornay Is A Slumlord (and a witch)
apps.short_description: RENT MONEY IS DEAD MONEY and your landlord is expecting payment IN FULL. Puzzle your way out of a maze of DEPRAVED magical appliances and the UNHINGED diaries of a DEBAUCHED faded television celebrity.

apps.name: Jerry and Jaspers Jovial Journey
apps.short_description: Jerry and Jasper is a simple RPG experience involving traditional turn based combat, mission variations based on player choices, and various unique puzzles. Filled with dozens of impactful choices, every variation of Jerry and Jaspers Journey is bound to be unique.

apps.name: Junk Rocket Party
apps.short_description: Grab the junk, build a rocket, and launch! Scramble for scrap on a spinning table, build your own rocket from toilets, sofas and jet engines, then fire them all at once. Farthest flight wins! Ranked online quick match for 2-4, up to 8 with Steam friends, or solo against bots.

apps.name: Just a Simple Turn-Based RPG
apps.short_description: A short and straightforward turn-based RPG where every action matters. Explore, cast spells through quirky enchantments, help the townsfolk, and hunt for treasure, without endless grinding or overcomplicated stories.

apps.name: just volleyball
apps.short_description: just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with simple controls and deep player expression. take on others in anything from 1v1s & 2v2s to full team-based 6v6 matches. there's no right way to play, it's just volleyball!

apps.name: Kabebutt Royale
apps.short_description: Join the Kabebutt Show, a wild TV game show where you bring your girl best friend for a shot at ¥500,000! Five women’s butts are in front of you, and one belongs to your best friend. Play with each girl, examine them through four intense rounds, and make sure you don't pick your bestie early!

apps.name: Kasane
apps.short_description: Layer colors to recreate a target pattern exactly. Red, blue and yellow blend where they overlap, and the same color layered twice cancels out and vanishes. Every puzzle has exactly one solution, verified by an exhaustive count — 1000 of them, from three pieces on a 4x4 board to twelve on a 5x5.

apps.name: Keep an Eye
apps.short_description: Play as Tom, a robot private detective in a city full of secrets. Find suspects, tail them in disguise, record conversations, take photos, and hack systems in this single-player story adventure. Upgrade your investigative abilities and fight your way out when a case turns dangerous.

apps.name: Keep Crafting
apps.short_description: Keep Crafting is an asymetrical cooperative party game : One player must guide the other players using a manual to craft complex items !

apps.name: Kern
apps.short_description: It's a tower defence game with a skill tree. Play as the pilot that crash the spaceship in the unknown white space. Defend the spaceship from a horde of enemies through multiple stages while fixing the ship to escape from this place.

apps.name: Keyb Out
apps.short_description: Keyb Out is a roguelite wave defense game about defending your PC from viruses and hackers by using your keyboard as a weapon.

apps.name: Keyframes
apps.short_description: After chance meetings in your second year of college, decide how you want to spend the last two years of undergrad with your friends— both old and new— in this partially customizable amare visual novel.

apps.name: Keyword Disaster Arena
apps.short_description: Create your own disasters by combining keyword cards in a chaotic 4-player physics-based party survival game. Everyone's disasters happen at once. Dodge the danger, shove your rivals into trouble, and survive the chaos you helped create!

apps.name: Kidbash : Super Legend
apps.short_description: In this nostalgic 2D action-platformer roguelike, awaken in a world of forgotten game characters as a hero with no memory of his past. After failing to save a nearby village from destruction, can you rise, rebuild, and discover the true meaning of being a hero?

apps.name: Kill The Sun
apps.short_description: Alone or paired up, take part in a strange game show. Improvise with the tools you’re given. Collect objects. Create a sculpture out of them. Use it to kill the sun. Slip behind the scenes.

apps.name: Kill You Again
apps.short_description: A choice-driven psychological horror visual novel. Wake up as Haru, a streamer trapped in a beautiful fantasy world that resets with every death. Uncover hidden scenes, revisit familiar moments with new memories, and escape an endless death loop alongside the mysterious Elinia.

apps.name: Kingdom Fall
apps.short_description: A 4-player turn-based fantasy strategy game. Roll the dice to harvest resources from numbered hex tiles, build towns and cities, trade and cast spells, then deploy your armies into massive real-time auto-battles. Five factions, sieges, Survival mode and online play with friends.

apps.name: Kingdoms in Arms
apps.short_description: Kingdoms in Arms is a strategy game where you build and manage your kingdom. Build cities, outposts and military camps to conquer the whole island. Besiege your enemies castles and bring down their walls with your siege engines like catapults and trebuchets. Control your armies in real time.

apps.name: KINGS QUARTERS
apps.short_description: A turn-based strategy board game for 2 or 4 players, with online and local multiplayer. Command soldiers, towers, assassins, and kings to outmaneuver your opponent and capture their king or claim their corner.

apps.name: Kingslayers
apps.short_description: Kingslayers is a free-to-play Roguelite featuring both turn based and real time strategy elements. Select your team and choose your skills then jump into a run to see what broken builds you can create!

apps.name: Knee Deep!: In Love
apps.short_description:
You might’ve accidentally found out that your scary roommate, your childhood best friend, and your project partner are obsessed with you and are willing to kill for you.

A romance visual novel filled with yanderes with looks to die for.

apps.name: KNUCKLEBOUND
apps.short_description: KNUCKLEBOUND is a turn-based roguelite deckbuilder. Choose your fighter, build your deck, combine punches, kicks, bleed and poison, collect equipment, and fight your way through the streets to take down the Crime King.

apps.name: Kodama: Slumber of the Gods
apps.short_description: Kodama is a 2D hand-drawn action-adventure set in the world of Japanese folklore. Experience fast-paced platforming, fluid combat, and a mystical journey through a colorful, spirit-filled land.

apps.name: Kritsana
apps.short_description: A Thai anomaly-spotting horror game. In 1997, a man swore something was in his house. His psychiatrist said no. Now the case is yours. Go through his old CCTV tapes, report every anomaly, and figure out why this case never made sense.

apps.name: Kuaiban!! Magical Girl
apps.short_description: Your phone is the clapper — wave it, and the party starts. A motion party rhythm game: beat duels, photo-booth co-op, and a single-player story across China. Scan a QR code to play with friends — no app to download. Turn any screen into a party, magical-girl story and all.

apps.name: KUNIS
apps.short_description: Six months after the Meet & Greet went wrong, the Kunimoto Toy Mall is sealed and silent. You break in for a card no one has ever seen. The Kunis, the cats from the Kunimoto trading cards, are still here. So is Clat, a scared little clown cat who needs you as much as you need him.

apps.name: Kur - Endless Descent
apps.short_description: An auto-battler RPG in the Mesopotamian underworld. Build a party of heroes, gear and level them up, set their formation, then watch them fight on their own through seven Domains and an endless descent. Free to play, in a small window that fits around your day.

apps.name: Lab Rats
apps.short_description: Fall in love with a mad scientist who kidnaps you or will you try to escape his grasp?

apps.name: Lane Siege
apps.short_description:
> Sack eight castles or die trying. Build your keep on a grid between battles, then
> command the fight live — spending food to field archers, knights and siege engines down
> one brutal lane. Every castle you take pays plunder. Every one after is tougher.

apps.name: Largely Legal Monstrosity
apps.short_description: Summon then enslave all-consuming astral horrors for profit in this incremental bullet heaven. Craft your build in a race to disrupt ineffectual antiquated market leaders. Between rounds invest in infrastructure to power up and secure your place in the largest monster creation event in history!

apps.name: Laser Lode
apps.short_description: Slice through endless ore veins with a high‑energy laser, listen to the clear ring of rare minerals hitting the ground, and witness your wealth skyrocket from single digits to astronomical numbers. 10 minerals, 80 achievements – an incremental feast reserved solely for the laser.

apps.name: Last Vacation
apps.short_description: Last Vacation is a physics-based multiplayer party game where elderly vacationers fight for seats when the music stops. Grab and throw your rivals, tumble through ragdoll chaos, and dodge environmental hazards in a frantic scramble for a chair.

apps.name: Late Night Check-In
apps.short_description: A psychological horror game where you work the night shift as a hotel receptionist. Welcome uncanny guests, prepare delicious drinks to fulfill room-service requests, and watch your peaceful night job slowly turn into a living nightmare.

apps.name: Law Firm Simulator
apps.short_description: Law Firm Simulator is a business management sandbox where you build and run your own legal empire. Hire lawyers, take on clients, manage complex cases, expand your offices, and grow a small practice into the city’s most prestigious law firm.

apps.name: Leg Day
apps.short_description: Climb to the top of this very unforgiving work out routine.

apps.name: Legacy: The Card Game
apps.short_description: A free 1v1 card game with a twist: both players summon Foes onto one shared field, which either of you can kill for Legacy points. It's your Legend versus theirs to see who can leave behind the greatest Legacy. Use strategy to play cards that help you, hurt them, or add some chaos to the mix.

apps.name: Legends of Companion
apps.short_description:
Legends of Companion is a strategic auto-battling ARPG roguelite where every
choice is yours. Pick from 4 classes, build deep skill trees, forge loot, recruit
a battle pet, and chart paths across diverse worlds. Master skills, gear, and team
combos to turn one spark into an unstoppable legend.

apps.name: LEGRADA
apps.short_description: A turn-based duel on a 9×9 board. Lead your Lekamon to the far edge and block your rival with wooden walls. Every figure carries an element and a skill: fire burns a wall, ice freezes a turn. Play online against real players, PC and mobile together.

apps.name: Leif's Garden Tower
apps.short_description: Grow plants, tend the greenhouse, and fall in love with the customers of Leif's Garden Tower. Leif's Garden Tower is a cozy 2D tower-builder about a lonely leaf spirit rebuilding an abandoned greenhouse, help him restore the tower and learn its secrets.

apps.name: Lethe
apps.short_description: A stylish warp-action platformer. Master high-speed teleportation to bypass deadly hazards, strike enemy blind spots, and dominate the battlefield.

apps.name: Ligmanauts
apps.short_description: Classic platforming action brought kicking and screaming into the voice chat era. Roll, bounce, grab, and swing through physics-driven challenges that only work when someone's yelling at someone else. Online or couch, drop in anytime.

apps.name: Little Big Ghost Hunter
apps.short_description:
A wholesome horror game where you play as a kid hunting ghosts in the town park, using janky gadgets and a soul-snatching camera.
One week until Midsummer. One week to capture them all.

apps.name: Little Casualties
apps.short_description: Guide tiny named units through deadly terrain with bridges, launchers, and questionable engineering. A chaotic Lemmings-inspired puzzle game where most don’t survive, but new generations keep trying. Sorry, Gerald.

apps.name: Little Dao
apps.short_description: Little Dao is a 3D eastern fantasy MMORPG where players explore a floating mainland shaped by the rivalry between Ru and Mo, battle otherworldly monsters in real-time combat, complete quests, improve gear and skills, and build guild power with friends.

apps.name: Locator: The Search for Abigail Lidari
apps.short_description: A Geoguessr-inspired narrative detective puzzle game set on an alien planet. As the Cartographer, you must gather and examine clues to locate missing archaeologist Abigail Lidari and uncover the fate of an ancient alien civilization.

apps.name: Loopquarium
apps.short_description: Loopquarium is an aquarium roguelite where you assemble a school of fish with unique abilities to repel invading apex predators. Start with a group of guppies, grow your population, and balance predator and prey to discover insane combos every run.

apps.name: Lord of the Femboys
apps.short_description: Armed with a suspicious magic ring, save the kingdom of Femborn from an ancient evil draining its vigor. Recruit three impossibly pretty champions who’d rather tease you by the campfire than fight in this comedic, spicy medieval visual novel.

apps.name: Lord of the Tiles
apps.short_description: Gradually uncover the world, discover new cities, connect them with roads, and turn a humble settlement into a prosperous kingdom. Develop your economy, unlock new mechanics, and explore the map at your own pace — with no combat and no unnecessary stress.

apps.name: Lord of Undead
apps.short_description: Destroy the castle on the hill in this grim RPG where you play as the Dark Lord. Collect souls, summon an undead army, master dark abilities, craft powerful gear, build your base, and desecrate the lands of a vast open world.

apps.name: Lorenium Orbit
apps.short_description: Lorenium Orbit is a fast-paced 2D team-based space combat arena where players pilot specialized warships, customize loadouts, and battle in tactical 7v7 matches. Master momentum-based flight, precision aiming, and coordinated fleet strategy to dominate orbit.

apps.name: Lost Railway
apps.short_description: A co-op 2D quota horror game with cute animals and terrifying monsters. Assemble a team of up to 4 players and venture into the depths of the nightmare for valuable loot, tools and secrets. Because the train must always move forward!

apps.name: Lost With Mom
apps.short_description: A linear adult visual novel about a quiet 19-year-old living alone with his stepmother Rinko, an elegant model and cosmetics entrepreneur. She still treats him like her son. But the way she looks at him when the house is quiet says something else entirely.

apps.name: Low Effort Romance
apps.short_description:
Low Effort Romance is an otome visual novel about two tired adults who accidentally fall for each other between quarterly reports.
Can you juggle deadlines, nosy coworkers, group projects, and a romance that keeps almost happening on company property?

apps.name: Lowside
apps.short_description: Lowside is a low-poly motorcycle racer built around the one thing that matters: Speed.

apps.name: Lunar Strike
apps.short_description: A single-player hard sci-fi narrative adventure set on the Moon’s South Pole. Explore humanity’s final lunar colony, face the hostile reality of lunar survival, and decide what deserves to endure when collapse becomes inevitable.

apps.name: Lustflame Bonsai
apps.short_description: Adult xianxia farming RPG. Cast out of the Sword Sect, you inherit a ruined mountain gate and one spiritual field. Farm, craft pills, take commissions, delve into mystic realms, and pursue exclusive routes with five heroines. The sect is a bonsai; who shares your nights is up to you.

apps.name: Macrostate
apps.short_description: Expand across a shifting map, bank power for growth and defense, and commit the right share of your reserves to every frontier. Macrostate is a single-player real-time territory strategy game with seeded worlds, AI rivals, and cross-ocean attacks.

apps.name: MageQuit Dungeons
apps.short_description: Battle across islands of ever-changing creatures as you shape your own growth and attempt to prevent theirs in this co-op roguelike. Counter deadly enemy synergies, alter your abilities, and raise pets to survive while the procedural terrain collapses around you.

apps.name: Magic Awakening：Hero Saga
apps.short_description: A strategy roguelike blending bullet hell, inventory management & tower defense. Recruit heroes, merge & evolve, summon goddesses, upgrade your castle, and repel monster waves. 100+ stages, meta progression, low-spec friendly.

apps.name: Make Me Whole
apps.short_description: A letter with no sender, a photo of the doll you lost as a child, and an address: a shuttered doll workshop where the same room keeps repeating. Something off? Sewing machine. Nothing? Take the exit. First-person anomaly-spotting horror about finishing a doll, and what moves when you look away.

apps.name: Mancalero
apps.short_description: Mancalero turns the strategy game Mancala into a combo engine: sow fire, lightning, multiplying and black hole marbles, discover synergies, chain extra turns into massive scores, and break each opponent's Score Target before they beat you.

apps.name: Mansion of Oblivion
apps.short_description: Camera, action, a new birth. Nothing before, nothing after, only oblivion. A dirty basement, chains. No name, no past, just a Victorian mansion playing with your mind. But you're not afraid; no, you love to play too. Let the show begin!

apps.name: Marbles: Tidy Up
apps.short_description: Turn colorful chaos into satisfying order. Collect 1,800 marbles, sort them into matching jars, and unlock handy upgrades. A cozy little game to enjoy at your own pace...

apps.name: Mark My Spell
apps.short_description: Mark My Spell is a gesture-driven action roguelite about drawing glyphs, typing commands, and building wild spell synergies against a relentless ghost horde.

apps.name: Masada
apps.short_description: Masada is a open world RTS / RPG set in an isolated and exotic nebula.

apps.name: Massive Army Battle
apps.short_description: One battlefield. 2 Army! Place your troops, press START, and excitedly watch thousands of tiny warriors crash into each other in a chaos war. Free campaign with 43 levels. Unlock the Sandbox and God mode to go wild.

apps.name: MECHSQUAD
apps.short_description: Team up with friends, customize your mechs and battle for supremacy in this top-down indie shooter. Lumber into combat backed by swarms of  support units, capture strategic areas, and call in orbital fire. Up to 16 players in 2 to 4 teams experience fast-paced, LAN-ready strategic battles.

apps.name: Medieval Bust
apps.short_description: Assemble a party of powerful heroes, create devastating synergies, and battle through relentless hordes in this fast-paced auto-battler roguelite.

apps.name: Mega Hasan 2
apps.short_description: Mega Hasan is back! Last time he had to find his own wallet. This time he's here to find other people's crap! Run and jump through 56 levels across 7 worlds. Battle bosses, unlock characters and team up with a friend in local co-op!

apps.name: Mega Man: Dual Override
apps.short_description:
Mega Man returns in 2027 with a brand-new entry in the classic action platforming series!
Override challenges and blast down legions of robots while springboarding across a new array of futuristic frontiers!

apps.name: Meiji Oligarchy
apps.short_description: Meiji Oligarchy is a historical simulation game that models the political, economic, and military systems of Meiji-era Japan. It spans the period from the assassination of Ōkubo Toshimichi through the Katsura–Saionji era (1878–1912).

apps.name: MemeticBox
apps.short_description: A brutal voxel gore sandbox. Every body is built from blocks you can shoot, slice, burn and blow apart. Play God: hurl people, strike them with lightning, hang them or impale them on spikes. Or grab a gun for Police raids, zombie waves and fully destructible cities.

apps.name: Memory House
apps.short_description: A quiet home for thoughtful games, illustrated books, and your own memories. Enjoy seven games, from Jigsaw and Mahjong to turn-based strategy, discover collectibles, and keep a personal journal amid music, rain, and the warmth of a fireplace.

apps.name: MeowFactory
apps.short_description:
Welcome to the MEOWFACTORY!
Automate production lines and manage limited space to achieve perfection. Connect machines with conveyor lines and minimize hand (well, paw) labour!
In the near and depressing future, when the world is on the verge of destruction, ONLY MEOWORKERS can revive production!

apps.name: MEOWU ISLAND
apps.short_description: Meow Island is a management simulation game where you run an island with AI cats. Start from an undeveloped little island,meet cat companions with distinct personalities, farm, fish, gather resources, run a restaurant, attract more visitors, and grow your island into a lively, thriving seaside town.

apps.name: Merry Nightmares
apps.short_description: Merry Nightmares is a horror anthology featuring three chilling stories, all united by one theme: Christmas.

apps.name: MESHFALL
apps.short_description: An RTS where your units only take orders inside your radio network. Build relays to push the signal out and keep them alive, because the enemy goes for them first. Four maps, a hundred waves each.

apps.name: Mesozoic Protocol
apps.short_description: The dinosaurs evolve against whatever you over-build. Defend 30 outposts with eight defenses: seven buildable tower types and your HQ. Pilot a mech, then adapt as each wave pushes back. Single-player tower defense with Breach and Containment challenges.

apps.name: Midair 2
apps.short_description: Midair 2 is a fast-paced jetpack fps set in a futuristic sci-fi universe. Use movement and physics to your advantage, outwit your enemy from every angle, you'll never look at a shooter the same way again.

apps.name: Mighty Miners
apps.short_description: Mighty Miners is a ridiculously replayable incremental mining game. Go as deep as you can on every run. Mine more and more Mightium, discover weapons, unlock a mighty cast of characters, harvest resources, and complete tasks to become completely unstoppable.

apps.name: Mikey The Hero: MANIA
apps.short_description: Run through the stage as Mikey, John, Ralph, Rosever, and Sarah to stop Fred. find the Mystic Gems to determine your ending, and maybe along the way find out some lore of Rosever's past in this all new entry into the Mikey The Hero series.

apps.name: Milk Homestead
apps.short_description: Inherit a mysterious estate and its secret, high-profit barn operation. Manage milk extraction, upgrade tech, and navigate seven demanding women with dynamic schedules. Explore the estate in real time and unlock over dozens of fully animated 3D explicit scenes!

apps.name: Minato Shokudo: Mirage of the Great Clam
apps.short_description: A cozy Japanese cooking game where you play a ghost with a diner to run and no sense of taste. So you cook everything by the book. Then you row the food across the harbor while it's hot. All 50 dishes come with a real recipe to try at home. One foggy night, the lighthouse goes dark.

apps.name: Minatro
apps.short_description: Minatro is a roguelite deckbuilder where you open tiles to reach the target. Synergize items, Boss rounds, and cursed items.

apps.name: Ministry of Misery
apps.short_description:
Ministry of Misery (M.O.M.) is a satirical paper-pushing bureaucracy sim about power, corruption and keeping the country barely functional. 
Cause Misery. Maintain Order. Remain in Power.

apps.name: Mirage Rebellion
apps.short_description: The "Treasure" — source of countless mysteries and conflicts. Under royal orders, the protagonists continue to safeguard it. Why is it so important? What power does it hold? Each character’s story unfolds around the secret of the Treasure.

apps.name: Misanthropy
apps.short_description: Misanthropy is a dark, grounded tactical social deduction shooter with realistic gunplay. Set in a fictional world with different historical eras, you play as bystanders, responders, or attackers dropped into brutal, tragic events.

apps.name: Mist Of Time
apps.short_description: Embark on a thrilling, historically accurate medieval adventure in this point-and-click MMORPG! Enjoy a simple yet addicting experience with an old-school vibe, rich content, and realistic gameplay. Dive into a unique world where casual clicking leads to endless discoveries, battles, and rewards!

apps.name: MMORPG NPC Simulator
apps.short_description: Játssz NPC-ként egy élő MMORPG-világban! Vezesd a saját boltodat, kereskedj a játékosokkal, adj küldetéseket, és küldj csapatokat raidekre ritka lootért. Építsd a hírnevedet, oldj fel Game Master-képességeket, és vedd át a szerver irányítását – belülről!

apps.name: MOMENT
apps.short_description: Solve puzzles as you compose melodies. Place clockwork launchers, tune their timing and guide balls through colour-changing routes. Each collision plays a note, turning your solution into music. Explore 40 levels, experiment in Free Mode and share your own puzzles.

apps.name: Monquest
apps.short_description: Monsters hide under your bed, and tonight they fight back. Summon a horde of creepy creatures, defend your lair and push into the humans’ neighborhood in this lane-battle strategy game. Upgrade, collect and unleash your monster army, free to play.

apps.name: Mortal Caps
apps.short_description: A cozy incremental game about the collectible caps of the '90s: slam your stack, flip caps to earn coins, grow the pile to 108, open packs and collect 216 grotesque caps across eight series. Beat the champion of every district and become King of the Yard.

apps.name: Mortal Path: Mighty Senior Brother
apps.short_description: Backpack-like × strategy × bullet heaven xianxia Roguelike. Random artifacts, limited grid, fusion & evolution to build your ultimate setup. Meet junior sisters, upgrade your Dao Body, and defend the last pure land. Easy to play, hard to stop!

apps.name: MOTHERWARD
apps.short_description: MOTHERWARD is a single-player psychological horror anomaly game. You are searching for your mother in an abandoned hospital. To find her, you must remember everything, uncover what you see...or don't see, and make a choice. But remember, every choice has consequences.

apps.name: Mount Noire
apps.short_description:
Get cash, get meds, get home.

Survival horror set in a forgotten ski resort.

apps.name: Mourning House
apps.short_description: After a terrifying encounter on a lonely road, you awaken inside a mysterious house—and your wife is missing. Explore its dark rooms, solve disturbing puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and discover what happened before the nightmare consumes you.

apps.name: Mutant Hunter
apps.short_description:
As the numbers of combat ready soldiers in the ranks of the remaining army continue to dwindle, High command devised a plan to use convicts as manpower via mind control.
Now your task is to hunt mutants around the sector using this experimental technology.

apps.name: My Death as a Duchess
apps.short_description: My Death as a Duchess is a survival game where the player embodies a duchess taking control of a cursed duchy. This game combines both narrative intrigue and strategy, alternating phases of managing the duchess's schedule and the unfolding of her day in the form of a graphic novel.

apps.name: My Little Cafe
apps.short_description: Run your own cozy pixel-art café! Create drinks, discover hidden recipes, hire staff, and decorate your shop. Balance customer satisfaction and running costs as you expand your café and unlock terrace decorating. Your little café story starts with a single cup.

apps.name: My Little Ranch
apps.short_description: A cozy horse ranch that lives on your desktop while you work, or in full screen when you don't. Feed your horses, send them running together, race for coins, hire ranch helpers and grow your ranch.

apps.name: My Octopus Friend
apps.short_description: An underwater roguelite for all ages. Dive through nine voxel seas as a little octopus, ink silly sea critters, find 122 treasures to wear and befriend, face nine guardians, and bring the light home to a lagoon you can rebuild and grow.

apps.name: My Quiet Home
apps.short_description: In My Quiet Home, everyday life revolves around completing recurring tasks. But as time passes, something begins to feel wrong. Familiar routines become unsettling, and you can't shake the feeling that you're not alone. Is someone else here?

apps.name: Nell and the Tail Arena
apps.short_description: Nell and the Tail Arena is a fate-card-driven 2D roguelite action game. Trapped in the arena's prison, Nell must chart her escape: draw and deploy fate cards, defy reversed-tarot curses, and forge a style with four body talent lines and dual-wielded weapons to win every duel the Master arranges.

apps.name: Neon Chase
apps.short_description: A first-person arcade shooter with no brakes, far too much neon, and a city full of things that want you dead. Dodge, shoot, smash, and ride through 15 branching stages, earn bounties, upgrade your bike, and take out endless enemies on your way to some quite disagreeable bosses. Then do it again.

apps.name: Nested Moves
apps.short_description: A customizable chess variant where every capture triggers a mini-game. Test your knowledge with trivia, roll tactical d20 checks, and challenge friends or computer opponents in local and online matches.

apps.name: Next Station: The Moon
apps.short_description: Next Station: The Moon is a dark romance choice-based visual novel with horror elements about depression, disappointment, and two gods of death who fell in love with the one soul they were supposed to guide into oblivion.

apps.name: Night of the Idle Horde
apps.short_description: Eat the world in this idle, incremental homage to B-movie horror classics. Start as a lowly Shambler and grow into a massive horde. Recruit evil little critters to automate brain collection and buy upgrades for your army. Unleash a mini apocalypse with Desktop Companion Mode.

apps.name: NIPH
apps.short_description: NIPH is a stylish roguelite platformer with risky and intense combat. Slash, shoot, and learn and cast spells with more varied items as you explore a vast and diverse fantasy world!

apps.name: No Gasoline
apps.short_description: Carry an Atom Bomb for the Union! Build your vehicle and battle your way to the Mountain of Basil. Scavenge for parts, solve puzzles, and deliver the last hope of the labor bots!

apps.name: Nonet Concerto R
apps.short_description: Build your loadout from around 100 magic stones and battle monsters with a wide range of spells in this third-person, loot-driven 3D action game. Experiment with different builds across more than 50 stages, solo or in online co-op with up to four players.

apps.name: North Shore
apps.short_description: North Shore is a top down skating exploration game in which the player navigates a series of connected waterways. To do so, the player must learn to master the art of skating to effectively navigate through these spaces. As they progress they encounter scenes of natural beauty and danger.

apps.name: Not Musical Chairs
apps.short_description: Fight to survive across multiple game modes in a 1-10 player first person party brawler, where music, hidden objectives, scarce weapons, and shifting targets turn every round into a scramble.

apps.name: Notary Block
apps.short_description: The watchman is dead—the knife is still out. A 3–10 player co-op horror in a Hong Kong twin-tower estate. Residents finish tonight’s duties with estate tools, then walk out through the ground gate yourself. The killer uses the same tools to hunt everyone down. No team win—only your night report.

apps.name: Nova Star: Void Survival
apps.short_description: Fight endless waves of enemies in a fast-paced roguelite space survivor. Build devastating ship combinations, unlock powerful upgrades and survive the void.

apps.name: NOYAKI — CONTROLLED BURN
apps.short_description:
A casual puzzle game about controlled burning! 
Fire obeys the land and wind: racing uphill, fading downhill, stopping at cliffs and rivers. You choose only when and where to light it. Read the slopes, read the wind, cut firebreaks, move the livestock, and burn the grassland exactly as you meant to.

apps.name: NPUnrealSample
apps.short_description:
NPUnrealSample

Features
1. WebBrowser
- It provides common WebBrowser features like chrome and firefox.
Move pages, watch videos, download files.

2. Account Menu
- Provide account functions such as login, logout, user information inquiry, current platform inquiry, UUID inquiry, etc.

apps.name: NTR life Drawing? Cash for Obedience......!
apps.short_description: As a manga artist with 120 minutes and a limited budget, negotiate adult "sketching" sessions with your cold assistant, Mari. Manage expenses and physical interactions to break her defenses in this Live2D and ASMR interactive sim. 26 unique stats will trigger up to 10 different endings!

apps.name: NullGate
apps.short_description: A toon-style roguelite FPS where every arena is generated at runtime. Dash, slide and wall-kick through rooms that never repeat, weave through slow glowing bullets, and bank your kill-streak before something takes it from you. Die, upgrade at the Underdock, and dive again.

apps.name: Nyangdom : Dark Cat Defense
apps.short_description:
Deploy your cats to hold off endless waves of enemies.
A 2D random defense game where you utilize random draws, passive skills, and perfectly timed active skills.
There is no single meta. Maximize your luck and risk management to dominate the battlefield with your unique composition!

apps.name: Oar'some Adventures
apps.short_description: Paddles up, Hosers! OAR'SOME Adventures is a cozy/chaotic rafting and nature adventure for 1-8 players. Casually paddle your way down the river alone, or gather your friends for whitewater mischief and exploration in beautiful, yet dangerous, surroundings.

apps.name: Oathguard
apps.short_description: Defy hordes of undead as a paladin. Strike, dodge, and chain devastating abilities through cursed graveyards in this action roguelike. Evolve your Oath, collect ancient relics and unleash deadly combos every run.

apps.name: OBA DOBA
apps.short_description: OBA DOBA is a Roguelike RTS/Tower Defense that is fast, funny, and frantic. Defend your base with towers and fighters while managing your resources and upgrades. Build up your arsenal of structures, abilities, and passives to defeat the evils that await. Build, rebuild, and survive! (hopefully)

apps.name: Oda's Ordinary Lives
apps.short_description: Live a thousand lives, make choices, and discover their consequences. From childhood to old age, every encounter, every decision, and every twist of fate will shape a unique life.

apps.name: Odyssey Fight
apps.short_description: Runic Legends is a fast-paced 2D Free-for-All MOBA. Master ancient runes and fight in a ruthless arena against champions from 5 warring worlds. There are no teams here! Forge your own path, survive the chaos, and claim absolute supremacy for your dimension

apps.name: Office TD
apps.short_description: Office TD is a maze building tower-defense set within a highly dysfunctional office. Foil your co-worker's attempts to make you as useless as they are by arranging hapless teammates and ordinary office equipment in devious cubicle layouts to engineer the ultimate defense.

apps.name: Oil Rig Simulator
apps.short_description: Welcome aboard the oil rig, where daily challenges await around every corner. In this realistic simulation, you take on the role of an operator of one of the most technologically advanced structures in the world. This isn’t just a workplace – it’s your new life at sea.

apps.name: One Of You
apps.short_description: A group of people trying to escape a mansion. One of them is the Admin: looks like you, and can vanish whenever they want. Collect the paper scraps and crack the door code — or find them and sacrifice them to the Great Spirit.

apps.name: One Percent - A Game About Taxing Billionaires
apps.short_description: Comrade! Filthy billionaires are buying political influence again! Shoot their flying bribes from the sky in this fast incremental class struggle. Help the common people rise, don’t get corrupted, win the people’s votes, unlock powerful upgrades, and tax the billionaires out of power!

apps.name: Only Arms: Grab, Sometimes Fall
apps.short_description: Become a creature made of nothing but two arms, and climb the cliffs. Hook your fingers over rock edges, brace yourself on your palms, and haul your body up with your arms. You might fall. Sometimes.

apps.name: Oortbound
apps.short_description: A co-op space roguelite for 1 to 4 players. Command a fleet, gun down raiders and mine planets while the sun burns toward collapse. When it becomes a black hole, dive in to fight the boss or warp to a richer sector. Survive five sectors as one of five ship classes, each with its own ultimate.

apps.name: Out of Delivery
apps.short_description: Become a courier robot and take over the city! Race rivals, steal their packages and turn deliveries into multiplayer mayhem. Throw parcels, fight for loot and use unique effects to outsmart your opponents. Deliver, sabotage and rack up credits. Speed, skill and chaos rule the streets!

apps.name: Out Past the Horizon
apps.short_description: Escape to a sun-drenched tropical paradise in this 1-8 player life simulator. Build your dream island from scratch, cultivate vibrant farms, manage bustling local businesses, and unwind on the beach with friends. Your perfect island getaway awaits!

apps.name: Outcast Tales
apps.short_description: A challenging post-apocalyptic roguelite turn-based RPG about the psychological stresses of adventuring with complete idiots. Lead a crew of flawed heroes against the consequences of their own terrible decisions. Can you keep your heroes together when everyone thinks they're in charge?

apps.name: Paid Bloom
apps.short_description: Your desktop is a garden. Plant a seed, go back to work, and your flowers grow while you type. Look up hours later and the screen is in bloom. Every plant is one of a kind, rare colours are out there to hunt, and nothing ever dies.
developers: Beijing Star Halo Technology Co., Ltd.
publishers: Beijing Star Halo Technology Co., Ltd.

apps.name: Pancake! No break!
apps.short_description: An incremental cooking game where you wake up on mysterious cloud islands and have to cook pancakes to find a way out.

apps.name: Paperly: Paper Plane Adventure
apps.short_description: Go on an exciting paper plane flight adventure, learn different flight mechanics & explore different worlds. it's all about flying a paper plane, learning from previous mistakes, and heading toward a better flight in this physics-driven gameplay.

apps.name: Paradis
apps.short_description: An adult card roguelike where the art is the strategy. Every woman in your deck, futa included, scores by what she wears, how she poses and where she is. Chain them into huge combos, outplay the judges, and win the after-hours.

apps.name: Paranatural
apps.short_description: Welcome to The Unknown, Ghost Hunter! Hauntings are on the rise, and it's your chance to put a stop to them! Team up with fellow ghost hunters or go solo as you identify and exorcise a slew of highly intelligent and sinister entities. Can you survive the Paranatural?

apps.name: Parry Ping Pong
apps.short_description: One button. Every ball. No second chances. Parry Ping Pong is a one-button boss rush where you face monstrous foes across a ping pong table. Read the signs of curving, shifting, and phantom balls, and strike at the exact moment. Miss even once, and the fight is over.

apps.name: Pasture: The Livestock Simulator
apps.short_description: Do you have what it takes to be a cattle farmer?   Muster and manage thousands of cattle in the rugged Australian Outback, solo or with some mates. Combine the forces of man, animal and machine to get the cattle to where they need to be!

apps.name: Paws & Plates: Cozy Cat Cafe
apps.short_description: Build dream Paws & Plates: Cozy Cat Cafe! Cook delicious meals, serve adorable customers, and grow your tiny cafe into a thriving empire. Hire and train specialized staff, automate your kitchen, and unlock powerful upgrades to maximize earnings. Create the ultimate dining experience today!

apps.name: Payback GP
apps.short_description: Race your friends in Payback GP, an arcade roguelike racing game where every defeat makes you richer! Earn cash each round, buy power-ups, evolve them throughout the game, and use them to beat your opponents and climb up the scoreboard.

apps.name: Performance Review: Survivor
apps.short_description: AI is taking your job and capitalism is trying to kill you. Fight back. This office roguelite throws hordes of coworkers and AI managers at you — snowball office supplies into a screen-clearing build and outlast 30 brutal years of reviews, debt, and firings. Clock in. Get rich. Retire. Maybe.

apps.name: PERIHELIA
apps.short_description: One ring, one gap, and a wall closing in. You rotate a ship around the center and find the gap before the wall reaches you. Four modes, and in MUSIC every wall sits on a beat of the track. The longer you run clean, the higher the multiplier, and at x8 the whole plane tilts.

apps.name: Pfand Raiders
apps.short_description: Dash and ride through a rock festival in this absurd, music-driven co-op runner! Dodge obstacles to the beat, loot empty cans ("Pfand"), cash them in for beer and burp everything out of your way. Will you make it to The Butcher Sisters' show in time?

apps.name: PICK A BOO
apps.short_description: PICK A BOO is an online co-op action game where you use magnetic powers to stick furniture together and haul it out.

apps.name: Pigeon Ball
apps.short_description: Pigeon Ball is a fast-paced first-person/third-person multiplayer sports game where pigeons fly, peck, pass and battle for the ball. Master your movement, outplay your opponents and score spectacular goals in chaotic arena matches.

apps.name: Pigeon Gang
apps.short_description: Pigeon Gang is a physics-based co-op horror game for 1–6 players. Play as thieving pigeons, grab loot with your sticky tongue, explore dangerous locations, hide from monsters, and escape together. Stealing is easy. Surviving is not.

apps.name: Pigeon Idle : GuGuGuGu
apps.short_description: Catch pigeons and sell them as rotisserie chicken! Or set your hard-won catch free! Run a pigeon rotisserie on your desktop, and let your favorite pigeons play on top of your taskbar.

apps.name: PIGMENT LAB
apps.short_description: Chase the world’s colors with paint, not sliders. Scoop red, yellow, blue, black and white by eye, stir them together, and see how close you land. The color difference becomes your score. 66 studies take you from the atelier to world flags and landscapes, plus a sudden-death Scoop Challenge.

apps.name: Pinward
apps.short_description: Pinball with a roguelite twist. Spend your score on another ball or upgrades that change the table. Choose rewards, build towards bigger scores, and keep your run alive. Play with friends, or create and share your own tables with the included editor.

apps.name: PISTA Racing PC
apps.short_description:
Fire up the engine and hit the track! PISTA Racing is now available on PC. It’s a simple, accessible arcade racing game designed for pure enjoyment.
Pick your car, hit the track, and compete to win races or beat your own best times. Easy to learn, fast-paced, and—above all—fun.

apps.name: PixelGo
apps.short_description: Enjoy Go at your own pace in a warm pixel world. Play a relaxed game in single-player mode, solve a life-and-death puzzle, guess the next move in a master's game, or take a quiet moment to review your own. Even if you're new to Go, you can explore one stone at a time.

apps.name: PixelMania
apps.short_description: PixelMania is a multiplayer sandbox adventure where you can build worlds, collect and trade items, customize your character, and explore a growing universe created alongside other players.

apps.name: Plamo Kits
apps.short_description: Cut parts from sprues, paint them your way, apply decals, and assemble each kit. Pose your finished models, display them in your room, and take photos—all at your own pace in a relaxing model-building simulation.

apps.name: PlankTap
apps.short_description: There's a cartoon jellyfish living on your desktop. It floats above your windows, makes coins while you type, then trades underwater stocks and unlocks more skins. It won't interrupt your work. It's just there to be cute. That's it.

apps.name: Playable Archive
apps.short_description: Review with caution.

apps.name: Player 2 is a Femboy
apps.short_description: An old high school friend reconnects with you, and gaming night turns into something neither of you saw coming. Player 2 is a Femboy is a spicy visual novel about nostalgia, banter, and consequences that go further than you planned.

apps.name: Playfolk Hockey 27
apps.short_description: Run a hockey club in a league you design, then simulate, watch or play every game, from a top-down view or full 3D broadcast cameras. Set the lines and the rules, make trades, manage shifts and fatigue. Edit every league, team and player in-game, import your own or community rosters.

apps.name: Please Don’t Break My Dungeon
apps.short_description: Build a dungeon worth breaking—and a home worth protecting. Play as Nubi, a rag doll defending a tiny room: repair wreckage, revive monsters, place helpers and spring traps on treasure-hungry heroes. Send them fleeing and turn their dropped loot against the next party.

apps.name: Plinkdown
apps.short_description: It’s 1994 and Channel 9 is still on the air. Bounce orbs through peg boards, meet tonight’s quota, and spend what you earn at the Commissary between broadcasts. Every run goes deeper into a late-night show that should have stopped airing years ago.

apps.name: Pokart
apps.short_description: Play with friends in this poker-based kart racer- Get the best hand and cross the finish line before you lose it!

apps.name: POLYSTRIKE
apps.short_description: POLYSTRIKE is a competitive top-down tactical shooter where every angle, every utility and every decision can change the outcome of the round. Coordinate with your team, master tactical combat and outplay your opponents in intense 5v5 objective-based battles.

apps.name: Pong Live
apps.short_description:
A modern vertical reimagining of the classic arcade experience.

Compete in fast-paced online PvP matches with your Friends and soon against the whole World.

Become a master of precision paddle control! Precision, speed, and skill decide who wins in Pong Live.

apps.name: Pourhouse: Last Call Is Your Call
apps.short_description: Pourhouse: Last Call is Your Call is a fast, chaotic 2D pixel-art bar management game. Serve thirsty customers and cut them off before they get carried away. Play 40 levels across 4 different bars. Upgrade your bars and unlock power-ups to help you along the way!

apps.name: President Simulator
apps.short_description: Become President of the USA: sign absurd decrees and balance your policies to avoid being called a "sellout." Communicate to gain popularity, manage interviews, and face press conferences. Everything falling apart? Press the red button.

apps.name: Primateria: Reburn
apps.short_description: Primateria: Reburn is a magepunk card battler where you rise from cozy shop duels to world championships. Build decks, trade cards, explore arcane regions, and forge your legacy in a living TCG world.

apps.name: Prismhold
apps.short_description: A card-driven tower defense: draft towers from your deck every wave, merge three copies to evolve them without limit and mix 14 elements to survive endless waves, crowned bosses and flyers. Play solo, co-op on one map, or side by side with up to 6 players.

apps.name: Project Airline
apps.short_description: An airline management game played on a real globe. Base your aircraft, draw routes between real airports, fit the cabins and build the weekly timetable. Every departure is settled against fuel, crew, maintenance and fees, and what survives that decides how far the network can reach.

apps.name: Project Corruption
apps.short_description: Project Corruption throws you into the haunting walls of the I.B.I.S. space station as you respond to an S.O.S. signal in search of your wife. Uncover the stations dark secrets, confront monstrous horrors, and survive the aftermath of the failed experiments in immersive sci-fi horror experience.

apps.name: Project: Haste
apps.short_description: Break in. Tear it up. Get out before the cops show up. Wall run, slide, double jump and rocket-jump off your own shotgun across places you don't belong. Headshot your friends mid-air and chain eliminations in a lightning-fast 4-player arena shooter you can pick up in a single match.

apps.name: Pull the Lever
apps.short_description: Pull the lever, send a tiny train hauling cargo. Click storms and breakdowns mid-run to protect the take. Chase jackpots, hire staff to automate the dull runs, and grow a living model railroad. You won't know the payout until it arrives.

apps.name: Punk Dog Wars MOBA 2D
apps.short_description: A free three-way MOBA you play with one stick. Walk your punk dog through the streets of Véspera, plant your feet to shoot, and dodge every attack by stepping out of its mark. Defend your Core. Destroy the other two.

apps.name: PURGE://PROTOCOL
apps.short_description: A neon survivors-like set inside a living and growing electronic world. Meet the locals. Dive the deep fields. Absorb what you purge. Awaken to a world that was always there. And don't worry! S.A.G.E., your helpful companion...who is certainly telling you everything...will help you along the way.

apps.name: Push a Block
apps.short_description: A simple but challenging 3D puzzle game.

apps.name: Put Your Toys Away Together!
apps.short_description: A cozy co-op game about turning the toy store of your dreams into a perfectly organized world. Sort all 20,000 toys, find the right home for every doll, dinosaur and train, and watch the shelves spring back to life – on your own or with up to 4 friends.

apps.name: Puzzle Realms
apps.short_description: Puzzle Realms is a indie 3d first person puzzle game with huge maps. Players must engage their minds to decipher intricate puzzles and unlock the portal to the next mysterious world. Prepare for a journey of logic, discovery, and wonder as you progress through each beautifully crafted realm.

apps.name: Puzzlogue
apps.short_description: A roguelike match-3 puzzle game where you continuously swap gems to build combos and use relic effects to boost your score. Create a different build each run and clear each stage.

apps.name: QUIET
apps.short_description: Your ship crashed, your crew is stranded, and this house is somehow your best chance of survival. Search for ship parts while every movement and real-world sound risks alerting whatever lurks nearby. Stay QUIET, keep your flock together, and try not to quack under pressure.

apps.name: Quiet Lands
apps.short_description: Survive in the Iron Age north, among endless forests, misty lakes and harsh winters! Hunt, fish, build a shelter and keep your fire burning. Turn your small camp into a thriving village, protect your people, and trade with neighboring villages or fight for your land.

apps.name: QuilomboZ: Palmares
apps.short_description: Lead elite warriors like Zumbi and Dandara in a real-time tactics game to defend the legendary "Quilombo dos Palmares". Use stealth, terrain, and coordinated abilities to outsmart Portuguese forces and mercenaries. Channel Orisha powers through the Axé system to overcome overwhelming challenges.

apps.name: Raccoocket
apps.short_description: Raccoocket is a cheerful, ridiculous rocket-building flight game. Stack cola and Mentos, bottle rockets, old toilets and scrapped missiles into a rocket that looks impossible but pushes like crazy, and launch Xiao Huan the raccoon. Get it right: the Moon. Get it wrong: a short, loud fireworks show.

apps.name: Radia Island
apps.short_description: Radia Island is a civilization-building survival game. Lead your people to a new land, establish your first town, gather resources, research technologies, advance into the industrial age, and ultimately complete the space program.

apps.name: Rails of Revival: China 1889
apps.short_description: China, 1889–1937. Lay track tile by tile to link mines, mills, ports and cities, and run a supply-and-demand map that breathes. Found your own industries, borrow wisely, ride out wars and revolutions — a railway tycoon where a route is a capacity, not a train to babysit.

apps.name: Rainbow Billy: The Book of Fears
apps.short_description:
Billy is back for an investigative adventure in Summer camp.
Unravel mysterious events in this colorful journey as campers’ worries manifest as Fearlings. Explore the camp, investigate its secrets, and confront those fears through clever puzzles.

apps.name: Rally Racing VR: Xtreme Speed Challenge
apps.short_description: Rally Racing VR: Xtreme Speed Challenge delivers immersive first-person PCVR rally racing with responsive steering, physics-based handling, customizable cars, Ghost AI competition, dynamic weather, day-night conditions, and varied off-road tracks across forests, mountains, canyons, snow, and jungle.

apps.name: Rally: Village Defense
apps.short_description: A cozy yet brainy Backpack-like Roguelike bullet heaven village defense. Recruit villager heroes, manage grid slots, merge orange Super Heroes, and stop the demolition crew! 50 chapters, 12 heroes, 11 Super Heroes.

apps.name: Random Poker Defence
apps.short_description: A Straight across. A Flush down. Stack their power where they meet. Random Poker Defense is a poker-powered defense game where you summon, rearrange, and combine hands to hold back incoming enemies. Just one more card could complete your perfect setup… but the enemies won’t wait.

apps.name: Randventure
apps.short_description: Randventure is a 1-bit, turn-based roguelite played in a single swipe: slide your heroes left or right to make your choices. Build your team of three heroes, journey through three acts, evolve them along the way, and overcome every obstacle on your road.

apps.name: RatSpiderFrog
apps.short_description: A cursed auto-battler where you take control of a bunch of rats to fend off enemy attacks. Crossbreed them. Grill them. Feed them. Make them POWERFUL!

apps.name: RE:COPY
apps.short_description: Control a robot, push boxes, and copy sections of the grid in this Sokoban-style puzzle game. Plan what to copy, where to put it, and how to move the boxes beforehand. Work out the steps to match the arrangement of patterns on the boxes and walls to the target pattern.

apps.name: REBOOT: Retro Game Store Simulator
apps.short_description: Run your dream retro video game store! Buy, sell, and trade games and consoles, uncover rare collectibles, repair classic hardware, and customize your shop. From bargain-bin finds to priceless treasures, turn your love of gaming into a thriving business!

apps.name: Red Rising
apps.short_description: Fight for dominance with up to 6 players in the official digital adaptation of the award-winning board game. Assemble a hand of followers, chain together powerful combos, and lead your house to victory in this clash of cards set in the dystopian world of Red Rising.

apps.name: Redline County
apps.short_description: Redline County is a driving sim built on its own soft-body physics. Every tyre, spring and bushing is simulated, so a clipped kerb can bend a tie rod. Start in the Volta Hatch on the test track; the county, the career and more cars arrive in updates.

apps.name: Refund Me TD 2
apps.short_description: A build-your-own-maze tower defence with one dare: clear all 50 levels before your 2-hour refund window closes. Dig a maze into a floating island, draft eight towers, hold off raiders, sappers and balloons. Then lightning, a walking giant and the War Tortoise wreck it. Win, and it asks: refund?

apps.name: RESIDUUM
apps.short_description: RESIDUUM is a first-person psychological horror game set in a decaying research facility. Armed with only a dwindling flashlight and a faulty heartbeat sensor, manage your power, uncover the truth, and escape what hides in the dark.

apps.name: Resonant
apps.short_description: Transcend bodies, time, and worlds. In this narrative hybrid of Point & Click Adventure and 2D Platformer, you are a formless Traveler. Shift between post-apocalyptic ruins and neon cyberpunk cities. Solve puzzles, master platforming challenges, and unravel the nature of consciousness.

apps.name: Restless Path
apps.short_description: A voxel-art soulslike about a lone wolf who sets out to cleanse a dying world of evil. Master precise, stamina-driven combat, forge bonds with those you choose to help, and carry your growing legend through a string of dangerous, half-open realms.

apps.name: Restless Rites
apps.short_description: Take care of a cursed chapel located in a forgotten corner of a small town. Maintain your daily routine, improvise with limited tools, and complete your tasks before nightfall in a surreal horror experience marked by maintenance and decay.

apps.name: Restoraether
apps.short_description: Restoraether is a cozy magical survival crafting game where you explore the isles of magic, mysteriously abandoned by their powerful Mage inhabitants, and restore the balance of aethers to bring magic back to the world.

apps.name: Return of the Lich
apps.short_description: Return of the Lich is an active tower defence, where you rapidly reposition towers on the fly, spread rot to reclaim your kingdom and race the clock for total domination!!!!

apps.name: Revving: Engine Simulator
apps.short_description: Start, rev and shift 19 engines, from a Harley V-twin to a Formula 1 H16, each turning in 3D in front of you. Every sound is computed live from the simulated physics of the engine. Clutch, gas and an H-pattern on keyboard, mouse or gamepad.

apps.name: Ripe for the Picking☆Summer Beach
