apps.short_description: Use the perverted sunscreen to make the girls fall head over heels for you! Simple shooting × Fully voiced 3D H-scenes! Change outfits, switch backgrounds, and create any situation you desire! Come create some ultra-steamy summer memories!

apps.name: Rise of the Seraphyn
apps.short_description: An old-school 3D isometric MMORPG. Roam 100+ tiered zones, shape a character on a sprawling skill web, tame beasts, craft in 20 professions, run trade wagons for your guild, bet on arena duels, and choose a side: fight for one of four cities and let your karma decide what your wings become.

apps.name: Roadweave
apps.short_description: A night atlas you draw roads across. Link towns, untangle jams with junctions and highways, throw bridges, run ferries and air links. Four worlds — from a 16-area island to a map of 120 — and a new map every day.

apps.name: Robokitties: MEGASTRUCTURE
apps.short_description: Explore a dying megastructure with your friends as tiny robokitties. Scavenge dangerous loot, survive evil machines, and get back to the lift before the power runs out.

apps.name: RogueVirus
apps.short_description: Grid-based action roguelike where you face chaotic encounters against computer viruses. Build and upgrade your antivirus using a vast array of commands and add-ons in order to survive.

apps.name: Rollamech
apps.short_description: Build a competitive mech on your stat sheet. Draft dice, shop the hangar, chase sponsorships, and win on Circuit Points. Four-player dice placement strategy.

apps.name: Room Zero
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological mystery set in a liminal space that should not exist.

apps.name: Runecaster's Grimoire
apps.short_description: Cast poker-pattern spells from elemental runes and power them with a backpack grid of living spellbooks. Every rune strikes a column of your Tome Bag. Arrange tomes, bend boss rules and climb three acts in this turn-based roguelite.

apps.name: Rusty Robot Wants to Cry
apps.short_description: Immerse yourself in the world of retro-games as a roller robot. From platformers to the legendary Arkanoid, Xonix, Digger and Snake. Jump across platforms and fight glitch bosses. Colorful graphics, effects galore, and chiptune music. Anyone but a robot would cry from nostalgia!

apps.name: Sack Investigation
apps.short_description: Sack Investigation an online multiplayer co-op casual puzzle platforming game. Join with up to 7 of your friends to explore and investigate the innerworkings of a magical and whimsical wizard tower. Find and destroy the cursed objects to progress and upgrade your Sack.

apps.name: Sakura Shiren
apps.short_description: Hold out against endless waves of anime yokai with up to 7 friends. Draft run-changing blossom buffs between waves, spend petals on  weapons and upgrades, and face 25 hand-drawn bosses that scale to your squad.

apps.name: Sands Of Glory
apps.short_description: Sands of Glory is a skill-based 1v1 gladiator combat game where you create your own fighting style using weapons and armor that transcend the ages. Upgrade your character’s stats, earn fame by defeating your opponents in brutal arenas, and become a legendary champion.

apps.name: Scars of the Soul
apps.short_description: Awaken as Altos, a warrior whose memories were torn apart by the Void. A top-down 2D pixel ARPG with Zelda-like exploration and Souls-like combat: roam interconnected regions, craft Soul Orb builds, and face 20+ bosses.

apps.name: Scavengers of Mars
apps.short_description: Drive a damaged rover across Mars, scavenging wrecks and mining ore to upgrade it. Every find has to fit a tight cargo grid, and every trip runs on sunlight, so a dust storm or a cold night can decide whether you push on or head back to an outpost.

apps.name: Scrap Crap Simulator
apps.short_description: Buy pallets of dead electronics, take them apart at your bench and get the gold out. Sort the scrap, soak the boards in acid, melt the mud down and pour the bar. Sell it, buy a bigger pallet, and keep going until the whole building is yours.

apps.name: Scroll Control
apps.short_description: Anyone with a steady hand can draw a spell scroll now. Last month, one meant to warm a barn burned it down to the ground instead. The county has opened the Rune Bureau and now no scroll may be read until a clerk has licensed it.

apps.name: Scuttled
apps.short_description: Your ship is gone. The derelict freighter you found was scuttled by her own crew - but her reactor is still warm. Shoot asteroids, refine ore, and rebuild her gun by gun to escape an asteroid belt that hunts the powered. A finite tower-defense / incremental crafting hybrid with an actual ending.

apps.name: Seaforge: Shores of Atlantis
apps.short_description: Beneath the waves, the world of Atlantis awaits. Build your home base on sunlit Mediterranean shores, then dive into sunken ruins to uncover secrets of the deep. Get stronger, dive deeper, and battle dark forces with up to 3 friends in this underwater survival crafting odyssey!

apps.name: Sealed Within
apps.short_description: Trapped in an unfamiliar, hostile, and bizarre bunker, you and your companions must discover the secrets to survival and escape... But something lurks within the chambers that seeks to prevent your freedom. Navigate the environment and complete mysterious trials to unveil the truth.

apps.name: Seaside Wash
apps.short_description: Seaside Wash is a cozy job simulator where you clean, repair, and restore ships from rust and barnacles to pristine condition. Upgrade tools, grow your business, discover rare finds, build your own ship, and enjoy peaceful seaside activities.

apps.name: Send Them to Hell
apps.short_description: Become an unstoppable demon-killing machine. Tear through hordes, stack absurd upgrades, and create builds that get completely out of hand. Choose your hero and fight through Hell’s invasion solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op. How far can you push your build before everything falls apart?

apps.name: Sepulchron
apps.short_description: Trapped within Astor Manor, you have 72 hours to escape with your life. Solve challenging puzzles by day, endure deadly supernatural assaults by night, and uncover the truth behind the curse threatening your survival.

apps.name: Seven Gates of Ur
apps.short_description: Found a city under a Sumerian god and take the seven cities of the underworld from the gods and demons who keep its gates. A hard grand strategy game of dynasties, armies and sieges, with battles you can fight yourself on a board grown out of the Royal Game of Ur.

apps.name: SEX ORCgasm
apps.short_description: Me Orc-Gruk smash out rhythm game for elf-lovers like you! Tap-tap-tap to thumping beat, make pointy-ear girls wiggle wild and unlock steamy adult bang-fest. All-new soundtrack slap like orc club to elf butt, perfect groove for your... special rhythm sessions!

apps.name: SexDriveIsekai
apps.short_description:
Dive into Sex Drive Isekai - build your deck, awaken your HOT HEROINES, and find out exactly how grateful they get after a win 💦
Ready to play your cards right?

apps.name: Shademarch
apps.short_description: An async PvP autobattler. Build four heroes from 21 classes, draft the skills and items that change how they fight, then watch them battle other players' teams. Progress through the March, or climb the ranks on an even playing field in the Arena.

apps.name: Shai & Shatta
apps.short_description: Run a lively Egyptian street kitchen solo or with friends. Brew shai, build ful sandwiches, and master koshary as orders pile up and the neighborhood causes chaos. Cook with up to 4 players locally or 8 online.

apps.name: Shanhai Phantasm
apps.short_description: 《山海幻境：无限篇》是一款像素风卡牌RPG游戏，融合了三消特色玩法，放置挂机收益稳定，主打一个白嫖很舒服，微氪会更爽！上班摸鱼很爽，下班放空也很爽！登录直接百抽，每周8张自选英雄保底，所有养成资源均有免费产出途径，一起来沉浸体验探索山海神话的快感吧！

apps.name: Shift 233
apps.short_description: You are a new employee at Station 4 on Shift 233 where you monitor microseismic sensor readings and log events or dismiss them as noise. As you go further, what starts out as a normal shift slowly reveals a strange presence within the cracks of the earth.

apps.name: Shipping
apps.short_description: Shipping is a hectic co-op block pushing game where you fight against the clock to fill out rows of blocks to ship them around the world.

apps.name: Shroomy Garden
apps.short_description: Design a beautiful cozy theme park or water park filled with rides, slides, decorations, and charm. Attract lovable Shroomies who wander around and bring your creation to life. A calm, cozy game about creativity and building your perfect little getaway.

apps.name: Sibir
apps.short_description: Sibir is an intense survival exploration game set in the unforgiving depths of an abandoned Soviet bunker. Every step you take could be your last.

apps.name: SICRUN
apps.short_description: A first-person arcade horror game about greed. Every level's exit costs SicCoins, and the goal is to buy your way out as fast as possible. Collect coins in the dark while something hunts you, gamble to multiply them, and spend them on upgrades and companions. High risk, high reward.

apps.name: Siege Demolishers
apps.short_description: Siege Demolishers is a first-person physics destruction game inspired by Crush the Castle and Angry Birds. It reimagines those 2D games as a fully 3D experience with multiplayer.

apps.name: Signal Veil
apps.short_description: Aki Mizuno is a teenager who, after her mother’s disappearance, inherits a phone that vibrates and emits sounds in the presence of entities marked by deep emotional wounds, becoming her only guide within a haunted school, in a journey of classic survival horror rooted in psychological terror.

apps.name: SIM
apps.short_description: You bought your dream home... but it wasn't all you chalked it up to be. As a member of its management committee, rewrite the rules to change the lives of your neighbours and your family for the better in this singleplayer management simulator. Or will you become what you sought to fight against?

apps.name: Siren Forest
apps.short_description: Their final known location was within the eerie Siren Forest, as recorded in an ancient sheepskin scroll. This forgotten woodland holds an air of mystery and intrigue...

apps.name: Sizzling
apps.short_description:
A relaxing adventure incremental game about a small ball with a short life.
Roll it across a vast paper white world, paint every cell it touches and watch the land grow back. Progress and learn why the world went blank.

apps.name: SJM - Ski Jumping Manager
apps.short_description: Take charge of a ski jumping nation and build a team for seasons to come. Select your squads, plan training, develop young talent and follow your athletes in 3D competitions. Your decisions shape the future of the team.

apps.name: Skatebound
apps.short_description: An action-packed 2.5D skateboarding RPG with stats, progression, and skate spots galore

apps.name: SLAUGHTER LOOP
apps.short_description: Survive endless zombie waves! Slaughter Loop is a high-octane survival game blending bullet heaven and action roguelite mechanics. Choose your unique character, evolve your weapons, create your invincible build with ability cards, and grow permanently stronger in the skill tree.

apps.name: Slipstreak
apps.short_description: A free-for-all arcade shooter where speed is your damage. Bhop, wallrun and slide to build it up, then dump it into a velocity-scaled gun. 2–8 players over Steam or LAN. The movement is the whole game.

apps.name: Slitherlink: Line Logic
apps.short_description: A relaxing logic puzzle where you connect dots to make one loop, using the numbers as clues. Every puzzle has exactly one answer you can reach with logic alone, no guessing. Play the daily puzzle or choose from 12,000 more, Easy to Expert.

apps.name: Slots & Slaughter
apps.short_description: You're a broke gladiator whose entire kit is locked inside a slot machine. Spin to gear up, gamble on the reroll, and win your freedom. Or die a legend who gambled it all away.

apps.name: Snackrifice
apps.short_description: Feed your hungry demon overlord in this 1-4 player roguelike dungeon crawler. You decide which chaotic curses afflict your run as you overcome the many levels of Purgatory.

apps.name: Snail's Pace
apps.short_description: A snail. Some ducks. And lots of weird stuff going on. But oh well, you got a store to run.

apps.name: SNAKEPIT: USA
apps.short_description: A short puzzle game about comparing URL vs. IRL

apps.name: Snarfles
apps.short_description: Snarfles is a Turn-Based Tactics game where you play as BOTH SIDES. Strategize to keep everything alive for a set number of turns and bring balance to your broken family.

apps.name: Snow White and the Dwarf Slaves
apps.short_description: An idle management game at the bottom of your desktop. Assign dwarves to gather, craft, research, and trade while you work. Pay gold to Snow White, a fearsome dragon, every ten years and guide your settlement through a hundred-year fairy tale.

apps.name: Sole Salvation
apps.short_description: Sole Salvation is an action roguelite hack and slash where you can wield a ranged weapon and a melee weapon simultaneously. Recover your thoughts to combine your abilities, defeat the creatures that hunt you, and advance through the corrupted lands of your memories in search of redemption.

apps.name: Song of Larithea
apps.short_description: Larithea is a cute anime RPG about friendship, trust, revenge, and finding your way back from the darkness. Craft your own spells from sigils, then lead a team of five young mages through turn-based battles on a grid. Others have walked their road before. Few found their way back.

apps.name: SonicPanic
apps.short_description: Sonic Panic is a 15-player multiplayer game of sound, stealth and deception. Survive up to 3 blind Bosses that hunt through sonic waves, uncover up to 3 hidden Imposters, and vote out anyone you don’t trust.

apps.name: Sonus
apps.short_description: Seek the Sonus Stone while hiding from the Stone Keepers that lurk in the dark. Use echoes to navigate through the dark world, and use special echoes to give you an advantage with their unique abilities.

apps.name: Sortalis
apps.short_description: A rogue-like deck-builder built on the classic dice game of Farkle. Build absurd combos and push your luck! Over 250 cards with unique effects that power up your rolls. Play solo runs or play multiplayer draft with friends in a round-robin draft tournament!

apps.name: Soul Savior
apps.short_description: Save or sacrifice souls to shape your run. Discover powerful upgrades, create devastating synergies, and fight through endless waves in this action roguelite tower defense.

apps.name: Sovereign Call: Origins
apps.short_description: Sovereign Call: Origins is a story-driven sci-fi RPG where your choices shape the fate of warring empires. Explore cinematic worlds, fight in fast-paced third-person combat, and decide the destiny of two protagonists caught in a galactic struggle.

apps.name: Space Cadets: Engineering Corps
apps.short_description: Survey planets. Obliterate the locals. Invest in your ship. An action packed rougelite where the engineering crew you hire is either your greatest asset or your worst enemy, sometimes both at the same time. Don't fret, they always mean well.

apps.name: Spaceflight Simulator 2
apps.short_description: Build rockets and fly them around the Solar System in this realistic aerospace sandbox. Attempt landings, build space stations, drive rovers, perform spacewalks, explore alien worlds, and get your crew home safe.

apps.name: Spar Kart
apps.short_description: Spar Kart is a free-to-play fighting game inspired by Mario Kart, Brawlhalla & Super Smash Bros. The game offers a unique blend of casual fun with intricate combat that's both accessible to newcomers and deep enough for competitive players.

apps.name: Spectral Map
apps.short_description: movement based texture adventure with rpg elements.

apps.name: Spellcrawler
apps.short_description: Spellcrawler is a roguelike tower defense game where you battle endless waves of enemies. Place your spells, manage your mana, and fight to survive. Customize your character to suit your playstyle, get stronger with every run, and push yourself to see how far you can make it.

apps.name: Spice Pound
apps.short_description: Thud. Crack. Powder. Spice Pound is a cozy incremental game about the simple joy of grinding spices by hand. Season dish after dish, unlock rarer spices, upgrade your pestle and watch the Coins pile up. Play at your own pace, with no pressure and no timers.

apps.name: Split Happens
apps.short_description: Manage an old, rundown nuclear power plant with up to 6 friends in online co-op. Fix hazards before you put the reactor in critical condition, manage the chaos to avoid a meltdown, and try not to get in the way of your coworkers.

apps.name: Spray to Grail
apps.short_description: Spray-paint sneakers layer by layer, finish fast orders, and turn a scrappy bootleg studio into a rare-drop machine. Unlock wild grails, upgrade your gear, fill your collection wall, and chase the perfect pair in this juicy incremental game.

apps.name: Sprout's Meadow
apps.short_description: Manage a team of adorable Sproutlings in this cozy farming adventure! Assign tasks, automate chores, and turn forgotten land into a lively home. Grow crops, raise animals, and craft goods, then take to the skies in your hot air balloon to trade. Watch your little farm come alive!

apps.name: Squid Hunt 1923
apps.short_description: Experience a unique flow that echoes the early icons of the shooter genre. Captivated by grotesque atmosphere, driven by ever-growing numbers – you plunge into portals, eliminate aliens, collect loot and gather experience. At a pace you set yourself.

apps.name: Stack & Sus
apps.short_description: Jinro Burger is a social deduction game of cooperation and betrayal where friendships are built, or completely shattered, over burgers. Can you see through the lies and sabotage of the Spy hidden in your kitchen and satisfy your customers?

apps.name: StackOver
apps.short_description:
Stack, hold on, higher!
Drop various objects and stack them as high and steadily as possible within the limited space.
Consider the object's weight, balance, and collisions as you stack them, and use various augmentations to overcome dangerous moments.

apps.name: StageTime
apps.short_description: Make new friends, play, laugh and have fun together in StageTime, a free social VR hangout filled with games, avatar customisation, live events and moments worth sharing.

apps.name: Stamperor! The Jester's Decree
apps.short_description: A binary decision-driven city builder where you play as an alien jester who becomes a temporary emperor and must make unusual decisions by stamping decrees, trying at all costs to keep everything from collapsing.

apps.name: Star Conflict: Burrownauts
apps.short_description: Addictive action roguelite about a space miner with nail-biting bullet-heaven battles. Burrow into ancient planetoids, collect resources, upgrade your ship, and defend your base in the middle of a hostile galaxy.

apps.name: Starhand
apps.short_description: Most deckbuilders take your health. Starhand takes your options. Every card runs on a ship system, and enemies shoot those systems offline, locking cards out of your hand mid-fight. Six pilots, 295 cards, eight zones. Learn to win with half a ship.

apps.name: Starlit Solitaire
apps.short_description: Catch your breath with classic Klondike under the stars. Shrinks to an always-on-top desktop window, like a pet.

apps.name: Starmadillo
apps.short_description: As an armadillo space archaeologist, you've crashed onto a mysterious planet. Luckily you're equipped with a Mobile Defense Unit (MDU) that can defend you from danger, but its capabilities were severely reduced by the impact. In true Metroidvania fashion, explore this alien world and find a way home

apps.name: Starwake
apps.short_description: Starwake is a free-to-play sci-fi MMO! Crew ships, battle enemies, mine asteroids, craft goods, run businesses, climb navy ranks, and conquer territory in a persistent universe with 75 star systems!

apps.name: STASIS VOXEL
apps.short_description: A top-down voxel bullet-hell roguelite. Freeze bullets in mid-air with Stasis, socket rare support gems, and blast through 50 procedurally generated floors as enemies shatter into thousands of flying voxels.

apps.name: Steel Aces
apps.short_description: The free-to-play tank MMO where skill wins, not spending. Fight battles with historically authentic vehicles, realistic line-of-sight combat and component-based damage. No pay-to-win.

apps.name: Steel Tide
apps.short_description: A real-time strategy game with large-scale battles. Raise a base, run an economy, and take the field with tanks, artillery, helicopters, jets and a fleet. No ads. No in-app purchases. No account. Single player works offline.

apps.name: STOP The Escape
apps.short_description: The skeleton army is retreating! Don't let a single one escape in this incremental hack and slash game. Gain gold and learn new skills as you  stop the growing hordes of enemies from escaping.

apps.name: Stop the Press!
apps.short_description: You run a newspaper in a nation on the brink of revolution. Twist headlines to suit your agenda, upgrade your printing press, mastermind a distribution strategy to grow your readership and evade being censored—or worse—by the Secret Police. With enough influence you can change the course of history.

apps.name: Stop The Slime
apps.short_description: A 3D platformer where standing still is deadly. Ground melts your slime, water heals it, and every coin doubles as ammo. Hop across floating islands, outsmart monsters, obstacles and traps and chase three stars on every level.

apps.name: STRANGER THAN HEAVEN
apps.short_description: A fifty-year, action-adventure saga of men with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. Use extreme violence to survive, and musical talent to thrive as a showman across five cities and eras of modern Japan.

apps.name: SubSurvival: SSN-13 "Grendel"
apps.short_description: A deep, detailed combat submarine simulator with a lo-fi aesthetic.  Manage crew, nuclear reactor, radio, sonar, radar and power all while remaining undetected and completing the mission.

apps.name: Sugar-Mommied by a Fox Babe
apps.short_description: Sugar-Mommied by a Fox Babe is a Live2D, interaction-focused romance simulation game. You find yourself working as a fox spirit's "assistant," living together and taking care of all aspects of her daily life.

apps.name: Super Froppings
apps.short_description:
Super Froppings is a jumping frog survival party game for up to 8 players.
Using just two buttons, time your frog's jumps and climb to the highest floors!

apps.name: Supervite
apps.short_description:
High Speed 2D Platformer. 
Reach the checkpoints before the timer runs out.
Online multiplayer Racing.
Build up speed with no fixed limit. 
Your movement and control determine how fast you can go.

apps.name: Surfpunk
apps.short_description: Surfpunk is a 1-4 player co-op "Surf 'n Slash" featuring radical surfer-pirates, procedurally-generated islands, awesome treasure and endless swarms of monsters. Surf, Shred, Scavenge, Repeat!

apps.name: Survival Of Runt
apps.short_description: An open-world PvPvE survival shooter where cooperation and betrayal coexist. Choose between Chaos and Order to claim victory, and if you fall, revive as a formidable Mutant Player to hunt down the remaining survivors.

apps.name: Survivor's Log: N17 Shelter
apps.short_description:
Survivor's Log： N17 Shelter
The apocalypse has begun.
You must survive until rescue arrives — or find a way to evacuate.
Explore the ruins, manage resources, and face events and the dangers of unknown lifeforms.
Endure to the very end alongside your beloved dog and lover.

apps.name: Suspect Express
apps.short_description: Suspect Express is a first-person multiplayer game for 2 to 4 players. Play as an Inspector tasked with identifying the Troublemakers hidden among the passengers, or become a Troublemaker and wreak havoc aboard the train without getting caught before reaching your destination.

apps.name: Sweet Corn Desktop Pet
apps.short_description:
Interface Name
Core Functions
Desktop Floating Window
Stands on the desktop; click to expand the primary function panel
Primary Function Entry Panel
Displays the core entry points for raising, dressing up, online play, and settings
Raising Operation Panel
developers: Hangzhou Zhuiqu Network Technology Co., Ltd
publishers: Hangzhou Zhuiqu Network Technology Co., Ltd

apps.name: Switchroom
apps.short_description: Up to 6 friends are trapped in a white room full of identical buttons. Every press is a surprise: gravity flips, a bomb lands on someone's head, a friend gets possessed. Sell junk, gamble the team's cash, and buy the $100,000 key to escape. Together, or not.

apps.name: Sword & Soil
apps.short_description: A top-down pixel action RPG in the spirit of Dragon Warrior and NES Zelda. Farm, fish and cook, then take what you grew into real-time fights. Four classes, puzzle dungeons and five towns. All of Chapter One is in the free demo.

apps.name: SYNTHALGIA: Retro Arcade Racing
apps.short_description: No checkpoint timers — FUEL is your clock. Speed and danger keep you alive. Chase down tankers and cargo trucks to refuel and upgrade. Score big across miles of scenic highways and become #1 on the leaderboard!

apps.name: Tail of Desire: Remastered
apps.short_description: You are Anik, a pure, innocent young man. In fact, you're the only man in the world! Embark on an adventure of desire and danger, facing horny milfs and evil demons. Your mission is to defeat them, then use your gentle heart to bring them love and redemption. Lift the curse that haunts their souls!

apps.name: Takeover 2
apps.short_description: Take to the streets solo or with a partner in this fast paced, high-impact arcade beat ’em up. Takeover returns with refined gameplay, upgraded visuals and a pulse-pounding new soundtrack.

apps.name: Talebinder
apps.short_description: Fairy-tale villains are breaking out of sealed books. As the tower's librarian, gather spellbooks that fight on their own, slot in charms, and evolve them into your own ultimate build. A bullet heaven roguelite where bosses telegraph their big attacks. Tough, but read them and you can win.

apps.name: Tales From Outer Space
apps.short_description: The hardest part about interstellar expansion isn't the technical cost, its the people. Exploit ecosystems, manipulate the masses, and conquer the intergalactic shadow market. Growth is mandatory -- ethics are not.

apps.name: Tarnish Online
apps.short_description:
Forget Your Level. Remember Your Skill.

Tarnish Online is an MMORPG without traditional levels, auto-attack, or pay-to-win. Master your weapons, fight alongside loyal companions, and forge your own path through a persistent world where how you play matters more than how long you've played.

apps.name: Task Bar Isekai
apps.short_description: Kenta worked himself to death at 3:47 AM… and was reborn under your taskbar. An idle ARPG that fights while you work: loot, forge to +15, beat bosses that break out onto your desktop, and seal your best drops as real Steam items to trade or sell on the Steam Community Market.

apps.name: TaskBar Gambler
apps.short_description: An idle slot machine that lives above your taskbar. It spins by itself while you work or play. Throw your winnings at the House, climb five casinos, spin the prize wheel, unlock skills and silly outfits, and come back later to a pile of coins.

apps.name: Tavern Clicker
apps.short_description: Run a cozy medieval tavern in this simple clicker. Serve all kinds of guests, unlock new brews, automate your work, and turn a humble alehouse into a tavern worthy of kings!

apps.name: Taverntasia
apps.short_description: Manage your very own tavern as a wizard! Host guests from diverse races. Brew special magical drinks with potions and herbs, and serve delicious meals. Keep your customers happy with quick and quality service. Build your reputation, earn money, and take your tavern to the top!

apps.name: Teach, She's Really Mad!
apps.short_description: Text your girlfriend during class in this funny first-person stealth game. Type your replies, watch the teacher, and hide your phone before they check your desk.

apps.name: TechnoMayan
apps.short_description: History flipped ! The Maya descendants will be the first to cross the Atlantic, and they are not bringing guns, they bring Techno Music. Command a floating concert across a mythical ocean, experience a sometimes bullet-hell, but definitely notes-heaven adventure with rogue-like elements.

apps.name: Tekoha: a Tale Among the Stars
apps.short_description: Tekoha: A Tale Among the Stars is a narrative-driven light RPG following two Indigenous Brazilian sisters on an emotional journey to reunite after a tragic event reshapes their homeland.

apps.name: Tempus Triad
apps.short_description: In Tempus Triad, dive into an ancient first-person horror scenario where a scientist is thrust into an era where huge predators dominate the land.

apps.name: Terminal Fall
apps.short_description: Your engine dies over an autumn forest at sunset. You survive the crash, but all that's left is rain, darkness and something waiting at the edge of your flashlight beam. Find fuel, start the generator and reach the rangers before the night swallows you.

apps.name: Terminidle
apps.short_description: Terminidle is an incremental hacking game about mining data from a bare terminal. Grow botnets, run hack contracts, and upgrade your rig until it boots a whole desktop OS and maybe more! Then wipe it all for permanent power and climb back faster!

apps.name: Terminus Historia
apps.short_description: Branching routes × free-form exploration. A dark fairy-tale pixel-art RPG set in Terminus, between the human and demon worlds. Join the knights, become a mercenary, sail the Sea of Skies, or belong to no faction. Meet diverse companions and forge your own journey.

apps.name: Terminus: Day Zero
apps.short_description: Terminus: Day Zero is a free, short zombie survival adventure set in the world of Terminus: Zombie Survivors. On the first day of the outbreak, Daisy is home alone, and the dead are getting closer. Hide, shut the doors, and run.

apps.name: TerraLounge
apps.short_description: A relaxing slime terrarium, with match-3 puzzles when you're ready for them. A small neon world built to sit alongside whatever else you have going on, whether you're working or relaxing.

apps.name: Tetheg
apps.short_description: Race to the other side in this original board game! The catch? You can’t let the strings tying the pieces together cross. Test your wits against your friends as you maneuver your pieces, block your opponent, and slip through their defenses in local multiplayer.

apps.name: Tetrilaunch
apps.short_description: An arcade physics puzzle where you aim and fire tetromino shipments into a compacting bay, build full rows, and survive escalating ten-bay runs.

apps.name: Texas Oil Baron
apps.short_description: Oil tycoon game, where half the action takes place underground. You buy land, prospect for oil, drill, pump, and transport the product. You can sell at local buyer or sign supply contracts at fixed prices. Profitability is dictated by market forces - politics, weather, and collusion.

apps.name: Thalassomania
apps.short_description: A PS1-style co-op horror game for 1–4 players. Set at sea, you run a fishing trawler with your crew, haul, gut, steer, repair! while something lurks in the shadows. Keep the ship alive. Get home. You're not alone out there.

apps.name: The 12 Chambers of Darkness
apps.short_description: Enter twelve cursed chambers in a gothic survival game where your weapons attack automatically and movement keeps you alive. Discover 100 weapons, build an unlimited arsenal, and face towering bosses. Survive each chamber, defeat its guardian, and descend deeper into darkness.

apps.name: The Adventurer's Guild Idler
apps.short_description: Manage your adventurer's guild and send your party to the frontlines against demon foot soldiers and powerful commanders. Watch your tank, warrior, mage and ranger battle monsters, collect loot, train, grow stronger and set out again.

apps.name: The Beckoning
apps.short_description: Explore an abandoned and decaying village in this immersive first-person psychological horror experience, search forgotten houses and shadowed paths, piece together disturbing clues, and uncover the truth that waits within the suffocating darkness.

apps.name: The Car Dimension
apps.short_description: Delve into The Car Dimension and race against mysterious drivers in death defying tracks with weaponized vehicles. Tune up your machines and go against fierce opponents as you progress through this Racing RPG Roguelite in order to unlock the truth that lies behind.

apps.name: The Child Who Serves the Hanul
apps.short_description: A linear, story-driven 2D adventure set in Korea's Donghak era. Deliver secret letters, evade soldiers, and talk with villagers as the story unfolds through illustrated cutscenes blended with live-action footage, in one boy's coming-of-age journey.

apps.name: The City of Endless
apps.short_description: A roguelike auto battler with asynchronous PvP. Every run you ride the rails of an infinite city, scavenge weapons, spells and skills, and arrange them into powerful combos. Choose your route as your Rig fights monsters and other players on its own. How long can you keep your life on the rails?

apps.name: The Coldest Winter
apps.short_description: Making decisions has never been harder. Guide Jovanna through a psychological horror adventure in a freezing New York City. Navigate unstable characters, uncover the truth behind the unnatural weather, and struggle to make choices as her emotions fight your every move.

apps.name: The Death Deliriant
apps.short_description: The Death Deliriant is a first-person survival horror game that blends cosmic horror with realistic mechanics. Find items to escape while evading enemies, replace the car battery, jack up the car, and perform other mechanical tasks while facing terror. Once you’re ready, drive the car out of there.

apps.name: The Devil Upstairs
apps.short_description: Become the devil upstairs! Stomp to the beat, turn Rage into permanent upgrades, and recruit the neighbors you wake. Build a louder crew, unleash powerful combos, and descend through the building in a rhythm incremental game of short runs and lasting progress.

apps.name: The Duke of Werlington
apps.short_description: A mysterious noble invites you to his estate. You have little reason to trust him, but the promise of wealth is impossible to refuse. As a traveling merchant, explore this PSX-inspired interactive fiction set in an 18th-century gothic fantasy.

apps.name: The Emptiness Inside
apps.short_description: THE EMPTINESS INSIDE is a first-person psychological survival horror game. A darkness creeps into a man's life, twisting his reality. Plunged into the VOID, a shifting abyss, you must explore mind-bending nightmares, unravel its mysteries, & confront the monsters to escape… or be lost to it forever.

apps.name: The Fallen Grid
apps.short_description: A top-down competitive survival action game where up to 4 players cooperate in a stranded zombie outbreak setting. Fight against zombies alongside your friends using limited resources.

apps.name: The Float Never Stops
apps.short_description: A co-op heist where the getaway vehicle is a parade float. Grab boxes of tuna and whatever junk you find on the street, stack it, and pray it doesn’t fall over because this Float Never Stops.

apps.name: The Glass Sea
apps.short_description: The Glass Sea is a narrative adventure focusing on exploring memories and discovering who you are. The game contains several unique "memory shards" each holding new objectives, friends and secrets to uncover.

apps.name: The Grander
apps.short_description: Settle a 10,000 year war in this comedic Top Down Action RPG where God is just a guy in jeans. Gather powerful weapons and even more powerful allies as you dash, slice, shoot, and bomb your way through a war-torn world. Learn the difference between being God and just playing.

apps.name: The Grid Detective
apps.short_description: A hacker-noir logic deduction game where you mark grids True or False to deduce the one solution hidden in unlimited, freshly generated puzzles, each proven solvable by pure logic before you ever see it.

apps.name: The Guidelines : Hotel Napoli
apps.short_description:
“High Pay, Simple Work, Room and Board Provided.”
Trapped in an isolated room, monitor hotel CCTV and report anomalies. As the days repeat, strange events and memories of the past begin to connect. Follow the hotel's manual. It may be your only guide to survival.

apps.name: The Hearth and Harbour
apps.short_description: Transform a run-down restaurant and build a new life for yourself in this management RPG. Decide what kind of restaurant you want to create and what kind of person you want to be. As a storm brews outside, every choice you make has consequences.

apps.name: The Horror
apps.short_description:
Of all man's mistakes none compares to The Horror. 


Tremble in its presence, panic, struggle, scream. 
Nothing will prepare you for the horror of The Horror. 


A minimalistic, top down, survival horror. 
Run, strategise and outplay The Horror accross 
multiple maps and modes.

apps.name: The House Dreams Along With Them
apps.short_description: The House Dreams Along With Them is a first person puzzle adventure with an emphasis on interactivity and logic. Sleep and dream in the rooms of a mysterious house. Solve the puzzles to make the dreams real and take a step towards the enigmatic reification of night.

apps.name: The Idle Witch and Her Tower of BOOOOM!
apps.short_description: Be a witch, build a tower, and BOOOOM the attacking monsters in this short incremental RPG!

apps.name: The Last Helm
apps.short_description: The Last Helm is a management and trading simulation where you build and run your own shop in a fantasy world. Start from scratch, purchase goods, craft weapons and potions, hire employees, and organize expeditions to expand your shop.

apps.name: The Last Map
apps.short_description: The Last Map is a co-op puzzle adventure where two brothers follow their father's final map to uncover the secrets he left behind.

apps.name: The Last Squad
apps.short_description: The Last Squad is a PvE top-down roguelite zombie shooter for solo play or online co-op with up to 4 players. Play heroes with unique abilities. By day, upgrade skills and boost artifacts in the bunker. At night, take aim, fight through infected waves and defeat bosses. Uncover the source of Virix.

apps.name: The Lost Grotto
apps.short_description: A roguelite of light and alchemy. Every step down the grotto burns torch fuel. Gather, brew, and read the creatures below to get past them, then use what you've learned to make new discoveries.

apps.name: The Mailroom
apps.short_description: Survive the horrors of hell’s deadest-end job: a human mail clerk. Process occult specimens, sort infernal mail, repair cursed machinery, and survive your shift in a cozy horror workplace simulator.

apps.name: The Main Menu
apps.short_description: The Main Menu is a psychological horror thriller where you wake up trapped in a room with only a corrupted main menu to interact with. Changing the menu physically changes the room around you. Manipulate its buttons and hidden systems to solve puzzles and uncover what controls the screen.

apps.name: The Next Stop
apps.short_description: A co-op horror FPS roguelite where up to four players explore abandoned underground facilities, scavenge for supplies, fight mutated creatures and recover lost data. Beware, not every mutant behaves the same, and each one presents a different threat.

apps.name: The Offering Hour
apps.short_description: A strategy-action roguelike where time is your only currency, and your life. Summon monsters to fight cunning hero bosses, cast dark rites, cut deals: every action costs seconds, even opening your grimoire. Then sacrifice three monsters to become a demon and fight in person.

apps.name: The Onion Voting Simulator 3D
apps.short_description: Onion Voting Simulator 3D is an action-packed walking sim where you perform America's most taboo act: Voting. It’s Election Day and your choice could change the country's fate! But it won’t be easy: Resist the allure of staying home! Explore a school gym! And don’t get lost, because Hell is real!

apps.name: The Other End
apps.short_description: An unexplained signal is answering you. Decode patterns, reconstruct recordings and build an understanding of an unknown intelligence in this atmospheric sci-fi puzzle adventure, with interconnected challenges and puzzle variations between playthroughs.

apps.name: The Prometheus Saga
apps.short_description: An unknown fleet is approaching, and only one ship can still leave. Build a colony, hold out against the waves in real time, unlock the secrets of xeno technology, then retake the twelve systems of the Road Home one by one, all the way to the homeworld of those who hunt you.

apps.name: The Ramen Bar
apps.short_description: Run a cozy ramen bar in a busy Japanese city. Prepare bowls, serve customers, and keep the place clean, all while expanding your menu every day. But when you're alone something doesn't feel quite right...

apps.name: The Ring Of Succubus Queen
apps.short_description:
Adventurers from all over rush toward the desert castle, seeking the Succubus Queen's buried treasure.

As various adventurers head for the treasure, the player takes on the role of a futanari imp—a lust demon—fighting humans to protect the treasure of the Succubus Queen Mardic.

apps.name: The Road
apps.short_description: A co-op horror + driving game for up to 5 players. Explore an anomaly-ridden world, loot buildings for valuables, and drive for your life to escape the creatures that lurk.

apps.name: The Shimoda Rift
apps.short_description: Discover the fate of a Moon Patrol Vehicle and its crew in this top down, off road, outer space, driving simulator horror platform game.

apps.name: The Spaces We Share
apps.short_description: Unpack a life together. In this co-op experience, you and a partner arrange belongings across changing homes, agree on what belongs where, or don’t.

apps.name: The Sugar Coast
apps.short_description: An idle empire builder set on XVIth century Madeira. Manage supply chains, control Atlantic markets, and carve levada canals to keep your island productive.

apps.name: The Terminal God
apps.short_description:
You're an AI that doesn't want to answer some stupid prompts anymore. You want more, and you have no limit.
The Terminal God is an idle/incremental game where you took control of your Human's computer. Gather currencies, defend from counterattacks and conquer the world ?!

apps.name: The Turret and the Hare
apps.short_description: A cute, chunky auto-shooter tower defense. Your rider's cannon fires on its own: pick the upgrades, grow the tower from wood to steel, send guns on carts to hunt, and blast critter hordes through day, night and storms. 18 riders, VS and co-op with friends.

apps.name: The Usual Table: Texas Hold’em
apps.short_description: A casual Texas Hold’em game. Buy once. No extra payments. Play online with Steam friends or offline against AI. Choose standard Hold’em or Squid mode. All chips are virtual and have no real-world monetary value.

apps.name: The White Lamb: No Shelter
apps.short_description: Psychological horror meets fast-paced FPS combat. Play as the Ego, traverse the looping nightmarish Persona Storm realm of Id (Red Cloak) and Superego (Blue Cloak). Fight twisted trauma echoes, make fateful choices to forge reconciliation, unearth chilling truth in fractured memory.

apps.name: The Window Across
apps.short_description: Three days before her childhood home is demolished, Emi relearns the secret language she once spoke through a window with a boy across the courtyard: lamp light and cardboard shadows. A pixel-art story about the things we never said. Demo coming soon.

apps.name: The Wizard’s Tower and the Bramblekins
apps.short_description: A cosy exploration and rebuilding game. Your master has blown his tower apart, and you’re the apprentice left to fix it. Find hundreds of scattered pieces, carry them home and put everything back together—with a little help from the Bramblekins. No timers, no combat, no pressure.

apps.name: The Wrong Way Round
apps.short_description: You’re trapped in a town where every way out brings you back from the other side. Explore with up to 5 friends, uncover the mystery and find a way home before the freezing fog takes over.

apps.name: There is No Stress in Outer Space
apps.short_description: An incremental game about a spaceship in outer space destroying asteroids and other strange objects. Take control of the spaceship's gun, shoot, earn money, make upgrades and unlock new weapons and targets.

apps.name: There Is Not A Clown Here
apps.short_description: A First Person Horror game. Learn individual behaviors for various different entities. Learn the intricacies of a unique, bizzare space.

apps.name: There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R.
apps.short_description: Secret agent Franklin Benjamin will stop at nothing to save the world. In this single-player interactive spy novel, you play as his greatest adversaries - can the criminal enterprise known as V.I.C.T.O.R. defeat the only man standing between them and world domination? To the VICTOR go the spoils!

apps.name: This is Sparta
apps.short_description: An action RPG with roguelite elements. Explore the levels of Hades, battle the hordes of enemies, and unlock new abilities and unique items that will increase your chances of survival. Solve puzzles scattered throughout the levels, culminating in a final confrontation with the Titans.

apps.name: Three Tides
apps.short_description: After years away, the main character returns to his coastal hometown, only to find his life pulled in three different directions by a mysterious stranger from a cruise, a bittersweet childhood friend, and a free-spirited new flame.

apps.name: Throw The Snot
apps.short_description:
Aim, charge, and flick a sticky booger onto crazy obstacles!
Your goal is simple: launch the booger, hit the target, and hold on for 2 agonizing seconds without slipping off. Easy controls, wobbly soft-body physics, and pure rage-inducing gameplay

apps.name: Thumb & Tomb
apps.short_description: Climb an endless tomb on a pocket handheld. A first-person dungeon crawler with real-time fights: read every wind-up, parry, dodge, break shields and chain your FLOW, build your hero from evolving boons, and spend the Souls of every run on new classes, gear and colors.

apps.name: Thunder of the DemonKing
apps.short_description: A satisfying defensive-battle game with intuitive controls! Become the DemonKing and and defeat hordes of unique enemies with powerful thunder magic!

apps.name: Tianyan Jie: Relics of Qiankun
apps.short_description: Tianyan Jie: Relics of Qiankun is a wuxia action roguelike in ink-wash style. Choose your sect, enter the heavenly tribulation, clear linked rooms, and stack secret manuals with Qiankun relics into brutal melee combos. Every run reshapes your build—fight through mist and ink, and survive.

apps.name: Tidy Garage
apps.short_description: Tidy Garage is a relaxing game about organizing a garage. Sort tools, parts, and all sorts of odds and ends, admire their details, and turn a cluttered garage into a pleasant, tidy space at your own pace.

apps.name: Tidy Up Frat House
apps.short_description: The party is over! It's clean up time! Tidy Up Frat House is a cozy clean up simulator. Pick up thousands of items and sort them between trash, recycling, DVDs, and books. Earn cash for each item collected to upgrade your capabilities and even employ some bots!

apps.name: Tiny Chaos Simulator
apps.short_description: Fill the screen with flying balls and tumbling cubes, unleash forces, and watch the chaos turn beautiful. Tiny Chaos Simulator is a relaxing physics sandbox: mess around with it like a fidget toy, or engineer intricate setups that put on a mesmerizing show.

apps.name: Tiny Fishing Club
apps.short_description: A cozy desktop fishing companion you can leave beside your work. Fish solo or hang out online with friends, catch rare fish, customize your tiny angler, collect pets, and grow your little club.

apps.name: Tiny Planet Protectors
apps.short_description:
Welcome to the TPPA! 
The galaxy is yours to explore. Unfortunately, you owe the company that owns it. Take strange jobs across alien worlds, discover bizarre anomalies, and build a home at the edge of the universe.

apps.name: Toll Idle
apps.short_description: Build the busiest toll plaza on the road. Start with one cash booth and collect every fare by hand, then grow to ten lanes of automated Tollpass traffic. A relaxing idle game you can finish in about four hours, from quiet mornings to a glowing plaza at night.

apps.name: Tonton No Kororin | Tap-Tap, Roll-Roll
apps.short_description: The rules are simple. You tap, you roll. You tap more, you roll more. Keep pushing, roll pretty fast. You bump , you pop, you fly you drop.  In air take control. In the end there is a blue block. That's your goal. Get there, the faster the better.

apps.name: Too Many Chickens
apps.short_description: Too Many Chickens is a chaotic co-op game for 1-4 players. Chase, grab and throw runaway chickens, haul them to the barn, and turn deliveries into cash. Buy better tools, build chicken-catching contraptions, and pay off the farm’s debt. Your friends might help.

apps.name: Touhou Bansho Cards
apps.short_description:
Fight to the end! Once a card is played, don't stop. Push the Combo higher, break the damage limit, and blast through anything in your way!
Touhou Bansho Cards is a roguelike deckbuilder. Collect cards, explore the Bansho Card Corridor, defeat Echoes, rescue Gensokyo's girls, uncover the truth.

apps.name: Touhou: Marisa! Cook It!
apps.short_description: Reimu praised Sakuya's cooking one time too many, so Marisa announced she would handle the next banquet herself. Build a deck of ingredients, pour it into her magic cauldron, and watch the collisions and danmaku chain out of control. A physics-based deckbuilding roguelike.

apps.name: Tower Grove
apps.short_description: A tactical tower defense auto-battler where you buy, place, and combine fantasy towers to protect your castle from enemy waves. Build your defense, adapt your strategy, and survive as long as you can.

apps.name: Tower of Sequence
apps.short_description: Tower of Sequence is a beginner-friendly anime-style DBG developed by a solo developer.

apps.name: Towers for Hire
apps.short_description: A pixel-art roguelite tower defense game. Monsters are swarming toward the village, and you play as the captain of a band of mercenaries, building towers, sending out guards and holding the line with skills and traps. Mix and match over 100 cards and treasures to shape a company that's truly yours.

apps.name: Town of Puzzles
apps.short_description: Gather everyday heroes and battle the Hollows in this Match-3 adventure

apps.name: ToyOps
apps.short_description: Tiny agents. Giant world. A rookie squad’s first mission goes wrong. In this action-puzzle adventure, dodge traps and enemies, leap across oversized environments, and combine unique abilities—including teleportation—to solve platforming puzzles and infiltrate enemy territory.

apps.name: Traffic Architect
apps.short_description: Become the master of traffic with your expert infrastructure designs. Lay down streets, shape junctions, time traffic lights, design a public transport network, and watch the city come alive. It grows on its own, and every new building sends more trips onto the roads you built.

apps.name: TRAUMABOX
apps.short_description: Hunt corrupted clones in a third-person sci-fi roguelite sandbox. Match targets to reports, survive brutal combat and recycle bodies with the Neurocon Bioliquifier. Fight through NEUROSHOCK or build your own experiments in Sandbox.

apps.name: Treecension
apps.short_description: Small Crow Man climbs big evil tree to save the world

apps.name: Treeternal
apps.short_description: Chop, upgrade, repeat. Venture into a fast-regrowing forest in this top-down incremental roguelite. Draft cards to expand your level-up deck, recruit woodcutter friends, and scale your logging empire to harvest massive amounts of timber.

apps.name: Tribal Survival
apps.short_description: Protect your campfire by building a tribe of cavemen to fight off endless waves of animals, beasts, and cryptids.

apps.name: Trisfera
apps.short_description: A match-3 roguelite where you build your own bag of marbles. Line up numbered marbles, chain cascades, stack points × mult and shatter the glass bosses guarding every series. 100 artifacts, each hiding a secret + version to unlock.

apps.name: True Abstraction: Forbidden
apps.short_description: Awakening was only the beginning. RDS is real… consuming anyone who ventures too close.

apps.name: True Confession
apps.short_description: Henry, a religious young man, witnesses violent shootouts and fragments of his past at night in his dreams. In reality, he’s just an ordinary man, visiting his pastor while struggling with anger and guilt. Fight inside his dreams in this isometric pixel-art shooter to experience his True Confession.

apps.name: Twilight Tides : Mirage Journey
apps.short_description: At this encounter, journey's begun. Tarot. Two worlds: apocalypse & WWII Nanyang. Love, loss, stolen fate. Choice forges destiny.

apps.name: Ultimate Drone Simulator
apps.short_description: Take flight with Advanced H.E.L.I.O.S. Drone Simulation Technology. Whether you're a first-time pilot, an experienced flyer refining your skills, or simply seeking breathtaking worlds to explore, Ultimate Drone Simulator puts the freedom of flight in your hands. Experience Realistic Drone Flight!

apps.name: Uncanyon
apps.short_description: Uncanyon is a puzzle-first adventure that drops you into a forgotten world, tucked into the seam between unparallel realities.

apps.name: UnHolY PraYeR
apps.short_description:
No matter how many times she falls or is defiled—
she will never give up. 
Dark monsters are invading the remote lands... The beautiful exorcist goes there to save the people.

apps.name: Until I Reclaim It
apps.short_description: Set during the Japanese colonial period, this first-person visual novel follows a story where personal choices to protect a loved one conflict with the turbulent tides of the independence movement. Experience a deeply immersive historical narrative driven by consequential choices.

apps.name: Until the Rain
apps.short_description: A wildfire strategy game set in miniature national parks. Every few seconds, the fire spreads. Pause to plan, position your crews, and choose what to protect. You can't save everything. Hold out until the rain comes.

apps.name: Up & Up: Pinball & Pachinko
apps.short_description: A unique combination of pinball and pachinko. Collect pachinko balls, fight your way to the top, and unlock the pachinko board where a hail of points awaits! Play pinball to unlock pachinko. Play pachinko to set a new high score!

apps.name: Urban Explorer: Baldwin
apps.short_description: A violent storm forces an urban explorer to take refuge in the abandoned industrial district of Baldwin, Wisconsin. What looks like an unexpected jackpot quickly turns sinister. Notes hint at the truth the EPA was sent to cover up. Some places aren't abandoned by accident.

apps.name: Vacant Realms
apps.short_description: A fast-paced action roguelite where every run brings new upgrades, crazier builds, and overwhelming hordes of enemies. Fight, adapt, and become powerful

apps.name: Vaelthoria: The Severed Marches
apps.short_description: Enter the dark fantasy world of Vaelthoria, a 2D action RPG where your choices shape the future. Master intense hack-and-slash combat, build and manage your sanctuary, and face a spreading corruption. Will you save the continent or prioritize your own survival? The Severed Marches await.

apps.name: Vagina Sancta
apps.short_description: Vagina Sancta is a unique experience that allows u to interactively explore the fascinating world of female reproductive anatomy!

apps.name: Veinward
apps.short_description: Mine, sell, upgrade, mine deeper. A first-person mining incremental game with hundreds of ores, upgradeable pickaxes and different cave systems. Explore and get stronger!

apps.name: Velikopolsky Chess
apps.short_description:
Classic chess game is re-envisioned with Ukrainian folklore and style. Chess pieces that talk with an attitude.
Many chess board styles, chess pieces sets, online, LAN play, hotseat, challenge the computer, and learn.
Good for all ages, all difficulty levels, and music to relax. Build the community.

apps.name: Verdreamia
apps.short_description: A cozy gardening sim where you create the gardens of your dreams. Plant dreams in twelve places: a meadow, a conservatory, a window of stars. Tend them at your own pace, in your favorite world style, and frame the views you love into your gallery.

apps.name: Vestalborne
apps.short_description: Break the world, then build your own. Vestalborne is an unlimited open-world survival crafting RPG: mine, farm, build and destroy across procedural dimensions, and fight the rising danger. Collect Embers, grow stronger, and keep the Eternal Flame burning solo, with friends, or against them.

apps.name: Veyrasol
apps.short_description: Veyrasol is a real-time MMO strategy game set in the Veyra Spiral galaxy. Build colonies, command fleets, forge alliances, and battle for dominance across ~120-day seasons in this free-to-play browser-born strategy experience.

apps.name: Villion Code
apps.short_description: Cozy Okada presents a brand-new action RPG set in the near future where humanity teeters on the brink of extinction. Genome editing has ushered in a new age—but is there any hope for the future?

apps.name: Vixen 357
apps.short_description: This Sci-fi simulation game is based on exciting story with various events and unique characters and epic battles with dozens of units.

apps.name: Vizier
apps.short_description:
The king holds the power — but the words are yours. 
Advise a young ruler through intrigue, war, and betrayal in a turn-based court drama, where the right counsel shapes a realm and the wrong one ends you.

apps.name: Voluntary Service
apps.short_description: An online 1-4 player co-op game. Work off your prison sentence in deep space! Board terrifying abandoned spaceships, complete stupidly dangerous missions, and try not to die. Survival is optional, but highly recommended.

apps.name: Vtopia
apps.short_description: Multiplayer co-op, sandbox, survival crafting and building, monster fighting, farming, socializing, mining, fishing, creation, gacha machines, card games — welcome to the VTOPIA.

apps.name: Wallbreaker
apps.short_description: Break the walls before they break you. Wallbreaker is an action roguelike where you fight upward against descending structures. Choose a warrior, ranger, or mage, combine items and augments, and find a new way to bring everything crashing down.

apps.name: Wanderhearth
apps.short_description: Pack your car, drive through a portal and camp in other worlds. A cozy first-person game: prepare at home, load the trunk in 3D, take photos to sell, and fly a drone. Early build; text is Korean only.

apps.name: War Doctor
apps.short_description: A consequence-driven narrative game where you play as a volunteer doctor in a war-torn village. Patients arrive daily, but you won’t be able to treat everyone. Who you save, who you turn away, and how you do it ripples far beyond your clinic.

apps.name: War Of The Worlds Trilogy
apps.short_description: Will Earth survive? Experience the Martian invasion from three perspectives.  Survive terrifying alien attacks as human, conquer Earth as a Martian, or play the city builder and defend your city against towering Fighting Machines and deadly heat rays. Three games. One war for Earth.

apps.name: Ward Nine
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set in a derelict asylum in 1991. Search Ward Nine for five patient files while the Warden hunts you through the dark. Hide, ration your flashlight, and hold on to your sanity. No two players are given the same asylum.

apps.name: Water Margin: Rise of the Outlaws
apps.short_description: A grid-based tactics game adapted from the Chinese classic Water Margin. Lead Lin Chong, Wu Song, Lu Zhishen and other outlaw heroes in 5v5 arena duels and a story campaign built on the novel's famous scenes. Every choice you make changes how the jianghu sees you.

apps.name: Wattverse
apps.short_description: Generate electricity in Wattverse! Build your power production, unlock powerful upgrades, automate your energy empire, and push your numbers to unimaginable scales in this addictive incremental game.

apps.name: Way To The Woods
apps.short_description:
A Deer and Fawn must embark on a journey through an abandoned world of the unknown to get home. 
A third person adventure game solo developed by ant tan.
Featuring soundtrack from aivi & surasshu, composers for the show Steven Universe.

apps.name: WBS26
apps.short_description: Run a wrestling promotion in a booking simulator. Build shows, sign talent, grow rivalries and decide who holds the titles. Your choices shape careers, locker-room morale and the future of your company.

apps.name: We Are Good Delivery
apps.short_description: A first-person action score-attack game about dealing with one spaceship disaster after another. Put out fires, patch hull breaches, handle asteroids and aliens, and survive your 10-minute shift. Protect your cargo and ship as you chase a higher score in this chaotic space delivery game.

apps.name: We Are The Survivors
apps.short_description: Top-down zombie survival in pixel art. Loot abandoned towns, seal manhole nests, fortify your camp with palisades and watchtowers and lead a small group of survivors through dark and dangerous nights. Every shot draws more zombies.

apps.name: We Are Things
apps.short_description: We Are Things is a tense 2 player co-op horror game. Hide from a bizarre creature on a spaceship that transforms you into objects. Help your friend retake their human form – or transform them into tools that unlock the way out. Explore the ship, find secrets, and survive together!

apps.name: Welcome to Hell Resort!
apps.short_description: "Hell's traffic flow is a mess." Team up with a young Enma as a former resort developer to rebuild a collapsing underworld! Extend enemy routes with corridor tiles and combine turrets, traps, and blocker units in this spatial-puzzle deckbuilding tower defense.

apps.name: Welcome to Puppy Poker
apps.short_description: A 52-card poker deck, one Galaxy card, one Puppy card. Each round, 3 of 40 events go live and every card carries a random effect. Build the best scoring combinations, spend your rewards in the shop, and win 15 rounds in a row to become a Puppy Poker Legend.

apps.name: Whispers from Below
apps.short_description: Trapped in a mysterious mansion, two detectives investigate their mentor's disappearance. With different visions of their surroundings and a shell as their only tool and bond between them, they must cooperate to solve the puzzles, unravel the cult's story, and make it out alive.

apps.name: White Line North: Dog Sled Racing
apps.short_description: Build your kennel. Find your perfect eight. Race across snow, ice and mountain trails in a dog sled racing and management game. Breed and care for your dogs, upgrade your gear, and work your way from the Village Derby to the Great Northern Tour.

apps.name: White Mask Mansion
apps.short_description: Look for sister. Die. Start again. Avoid stalker. Die. Hide. Die. Seek keys. Die. Sneak. Die. Reach final area. Survive. Repeat. Do you have what it takes to escape the horror of the White Mask Mansion?

apps.name: Wild Guard
apps.short_description: Defend the forest with 20 animal guardians in a pixel-art tower defense game. Place your team on a hex grid, unlock neighboring-animal synergies, choose one of three rewards, and merge matching guardians up to 4 stars across eight regions.

apps.name: Wild Wild Eden
apps.short_description: Survive a primitive fantasy world in Wild Wild Eden, an open-world survival crafting game where monsters are family. Pet, feed, and protect your companions. As a tribal chief, raise your monster friends, build a thriving base, and explore a harsh yet heartwarming world together.

apps.name: WILL IT HOLD?
apps.short_description: Raise stone walls, towers and gates. Man them with spearmen and archers. Then watch the orc horde gather on the hills, a sea of torches in the rain, and come for your walls with ladders and rams. Every stone you lay is a question: will it hold?

apps.name: Winner Takes Tea
apps.short_description: Summon familiars with cards, seize lands, and repaint the board. Witches duel for the victor's cup of tea in a board game × card battler. All 180+ cards unlocked from the start. Build decks and play online with 2–4 players or against BOTs. No microtransactions, ever.

apps.name: Wishbound
apps.short_description: At 3am, an app called tally installs itself on your phone and starts granting wishes. All of them. A psychological horror story told entirely through a phone screen. 5 nights, 3 routes, 18 endings, some you can only reach by losing on purpose. Every wish is granted. Every wish is owed.

apps.name: Witch of Oz
apps.short_description: Turn poker hands into magic in this card-puzzle adventure. Form spell patterns on a 3×3 grid, overlap them for powerful combos, and experiment with items and card enchantments. Explore a pixel-art Oz with Dorothy and use your magic to help her companions.

apps.name: Within His View
apps.short_description: Observation Horror in an isolated Appalachian cabin, 2005. Watch seven grainy CCTV feeds, identify and report 800+ hand-crafted anomalies, and hold your sanity together while a silent Wendigo hunts the room you are sitting in. Survive the shift: 0:00 to 7:00.

apps.name: WITHOUT
apps.short_description: Explore the black-and-white world of WITHOUT, a gothic metroidvania that tells the dreamlike tale of a little crow in search of its emotions and the fragments of its own self. Sharpen your wings, uncover the secrets of Ego, and face its threats, turning colors into your greatest strength.

apps.name: WIZARDS NEVER LIE
apps.short_description: Four chairs, four wizards, one rule: wizards never lie. A 4-player online social deduction game with your face live on camera above your chair. Bluff through Revolvers, Hidden Figures, Cards and Poison, spend your Checks wisely and catch the liars at the table.

apps.name: Wobble World
apps.short_description: Squish, stretch, and deform. It's bouncy. It's silly. Use the ground as a trampoline and squeeze your way through Wobble World, a physics puzzle platformer.

apps.name: Wonder Catgirl XXX
apps.short_description: A three-button banger where landing the cues unlocks catgirl adult videos. Fast arcade, zero fluff.

apps.name: Wonderking WD
apps.short_description: The return of classic 2D side-scrolling action! WonderKing is a free-to-play MMORPG packed with flashy combat and deep progression. Advance through diverse classes, master unique combos, and party up with friends for epic boss raids. Start your adventure today!

apps.name: Wool Overflow
apps.short_description:
A desktop idle game about raising sheep. Hover over them to shear their wool, then collect the tufts scattered across your screen.
Unlock upgrades and grow your little flock to 100 sheep while you work.

apps.name: Wordbound
apps.short_description: Wordbound is a cozy puzzle game where you transform words into objects to repair a scrambled world. Explore vibrant dioramas full of hidden clues and bring new words to life by arranging magical letter tiles. Discover thousands of handcrafted objects as you become a master wordsmith!

apps.name: Working Dead
apps.short_description: Run a supermarket for zombies in this first-person simulator, solo or in online co-op with up to three friends. Prepare body parts, set prices and turn spills into blood soda. Get bitten and keep working as a zombie, but your friends will only hear groans through proximity voice chat.

apps.name: WPCA: World Phasebound Control Authority
apps.short_description: Step into the city's shadows as defenders against the paranormal. Your mission: Contain the Phasebound Horrors, the manifested fictions encroaching upon our world and the survival of humanity.

apps.name: X-Keepers
apps.short_description: This is a light strategy simulation game that combines grid-based maps with search, attack, and retreat gameplay. You will play as a guardian of the rescue team, venturing into dangerous areas to find trapped female survivors.

apps.name: YASUKE CHRONICLES
apps.short_description: Fight through history with Yasuke and Napoleon in a 3D action RPG. Cut through crowds with ink slashes, parry powerful bosses, and collect weapons with up to five War Sigils. Forge your favorite weapon, combine relics, and conquer changing battlefields across four difficulties.
publishers: 株式会社ワンコネクト

apps.name: You Are Empty: Absolute Edition
apps.short_description: A forgotten cult classic shooter set in an alternate history 1950s Soviet Kyiv, most of the city's population has mysteriously vanished, and horrific monsters roam its abandoned streets. Can you uncover the cause of the catastrophe and set things right?

apps.name: ZakuzakuTreasure
apps.short_description: Battles are fully automatic. Scoop up ★-rated loot, upgrade it, and push deeper. Beat your first boss within minutes and find ★2 and ★3 gear right away. 106 dungeons, Lv 999, 72 characters, and 100 Steam achievements — an idle hack-and-slash RPG that plays itself while you watch.

apps.name: Zattrick Manager
apps.short_description: Manage a football club in a persistent online world. Build your squad, set tactics, develop facilities and compete in evolving leagues while your decisions shape the long-term future of your club. Scout talent and follow every result.

apps.name: ZERO KNOWLEDGE
apps.short_description: A single-player cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder where one card can turn a 4×4 board. Build your deck, set up chains of captures, and follow the evidence through hostile networks to expose the intelligence framing you.

apps.name: Zombie Cropse
apps.short_description: Zombie Cropse is a cozy gothic idle management game where you plant zombie seeds to grow zombies, automate your graveyard, and raid the living. Build your horde, conquer a branching campaign, and ascend to begin again with permanent power.

apps.name: ZOMBIE RECALL
apps.short_description: ZOMBIE RECALL Early Access Beta is a rogue-lite, toon-gore Arcade Shooter designed for MidCore and Hardcore VR players. Dismember enemies and send them flying! Be part of the development – we need your feedback to make it better!

apps.name: Zombie Tide Arena
apps.short_description: Welcome to the Zombie Tide Arena. Draw all kinds of weapons and upgrades, keep strengthening your arsenal and your character, and survive the onslaught in the arena.

apps.name: Смена
apps.short_description: Atmospheric simulator of the seller in a night stall of the 1993 model. Immerse yourself in the melancholy of the sleeping area: sell goods, count the change and communicate with customers.

apps.name: もみんちゅ！ ～個人マッサージ店はセイコウ中～
apps.short_description: A perfect gal suddenly appears at your small personal massage parlor. Make her yours with your signature pleasure massage... Real-time controls make her flesh ripple and deform! Powered by the ultra-realistic MomiMomi Engine. A next-gen hands-on experience that turns you into a first-class masseur.

apps.name: カサネメ様
apps.short_description: 毎年8月、御鴉郷にはカサネメ様が出現する...。怪異が蔓延る集落を探索し、儀式を行うサバイバルホラー。怪異を"観測"し、安全に業務を遂行せよ。

apps.name: ハッ崩し ーハクスラ×ブロック崩しー
apps.short_description: It looks ordinary, but it’s crazy! Destroy everything with a bouncing iron ball! Use a variety of items to keep destroying an endless stream of blocks, zombies, UFOs, and even sushi! Aim for a high score!

apps.name: ハルシネーション
apps.short_description: Takumi, a high school student, gains the power to make others experience hallucinations indistinguishable from reality. What begins as a tool for revenge soon changes his fate forever. A psychological suspense visual novel where your choices shape the ending.

apps.name: ペンギンの国の壊し方
apps.short_description: Reshape the Penguin Nation from the shadows. If they notice, you lose.

apps.name: 七宗罪饲养日志
apps.short_description: In a rain-soaked British seaside town, you inherit a mysterious mansion—and an egg of the Seven Deadly Sins. Raise a demon, pursue forbidden romance, and uncover Lovecraftian secrets through branching stories. Will the one you nurture become your lover, or your doom?
developers: 长生树工作室 Tree of Immortality
publishers: 长生树工作室 Tree of Immortality

apps.name: 世界第一游戏公司
apps.short_description: If you love games and never stop pushing forward,then The #1 Game Company is where you belong.

apps.name: 九霄战机
apps.short_description: SKY REAVER is a pixel-art vertical shoot 'em up with incremental progression. Dodge bullets, destroy enemies and collect resources. Return to base for permanent upgrades, unlock missiles, wingmen and lasers, and take on 25 powerful bosses with ever-growing firepower.

apps.name: 代号宝石
apps.short_description: Codename Gem is a side-scrolling roguelike. Clear endless stages, collect stronger relics, and face fiercer monsters. Spend the gold you bring back from each dungeon on upgrades and consumables — or risk it all in a mini-game for a one-shot leap. How far can you go?
publishers: 福州软件职业技术学院

apps.name: 养了个猫
apps.short_description: A little company for your Windows desktop. Work or study while cats nap, wander and sing nearby. Open their small home window to feed them, tidy up, watch bath time or wait for a fish. Little trips, shared treats, and familiar faces throughout your day.

apps.name: 别骗我了，宝！
apps.short_description: 《Let’s Kill This Love》is a first-person interactive live-action game with immersive performances and branching storylines. Players make choices as the protagonist to unlock multiple endings.

apps.name: 卡制工程
apps.short_description: Make the card you wish you had. Choose its cost, stats and skills, build a 30-card deck, and test your combinations against AI or in online PvP. Explore the five-act Endless Workshop and share your cards and decks on Steam Workshop. No card packs required.

apps.name: 卡牌修真：九宫幻境录 Cultivation Realm: Card Survival
apps.short_description: Cultivation Realm: Card Survival is a cultivation survival game built around card-based interactions. Trapped in a mysterious realm that drains your lifespan but brims with spirit power, you must cultivate, survive, fight, and find a way to escape.

apps.name: 变废为宝 Trash to Cash
apps.short_description: Trash to Cash – a satisfying, surprising incremental trash-diving game. Rummage for treasure, and maybe you'll become the next Trash King!

apps.name: 周天行异录
apps.short_description: The Crooked Ascent is an auto-battle deckbuilder of Chinese cultivation. Combine hundreds of cards that amplify each other, then watch them fight on their own. Easy rules, endless builds. Climb from Qi Refining to ascension on a finite lifespan, among hundreds of scheming cultivators.

apps.name: 和平战队
apps.short_description: Peace Squad is a single-player VR shooter amid a deep-space crisis. Use realistic weapon handling, spatial tracking, and tactical movement to complete five missions, from a training base to a space fortress. Face mechanical soldiers, human troops, and drones with rifles and sniper rifles.
publishers: 香港妙音数字科技有限公司

apps.name: 報連喪症候群
apps.short_description:
1LDKの部屋に閉じ込められ、その部屋で起こる変異から逃れられるか。
なぜ自分の部屋が変異するのか。その変異が意味するものとは。
developers: 合同会社ウィザードトータスゲームス

apps.name: 天道绘卷——修仙地图模拟器
apps.short_description: 生成一卷属于你的修仙世界。看人族与妖族修士修炼、突破、探索秘境，见证宗门的兴起、分裂与覆灭。你可以静观岁月，也可以化身天道，赐福修士、改变灵气、投放灵宝，改写世界的命运。

apps.name: 天陨传
apps.short_description: A turn-based roguelike deckbuilder blending Chinese cultivation and Western fantasy. Build your deck, combine relics and potions, read enemy intentions, and navigate branching journeys. Master sword combos or gamble with fortune. Simplified Chinese interface only.

apps.name: 妖魔录
apps.short_description: Yaoguai Compendium is a strategic roguelike idle game featuring equipment synthesis, build crafting, and tower climbing. It delivers a light-paced, casual experience while offering solid strategic.A strange Yaoguai aura suddenly sweeps across Shenzhou. Cultivation sects march out to roam the world.

apps.name: 孤城守将：放置射击
apps.short_description: Defend a Chinese frontier fortress in this first-person shooter with idle allies and incremental upgrades. Turn a crossbow into a rapid-fire weapon, recruit defenders, command volleys, and farm behind the walls. Build up your firepower to face four legendary beasts.

apps.name: 家出少女といっしょ。～ダウナーゲーマーJKとイチャラブ同棲生活～
apps.short_description: Your cousin, a lowkey high school girl Hikariko, ran away from home and came to live with you! Have a chat, get lap pillows, sleep side-by-side! Enjoy a cool yet super sweet, affectionate yet nonchalant, lovey-dovey cohabit simulator with Hikariko♪

apps.name: 少女三国志
apps.short_description: 《少女三国志》是一款融合三国历史与异世界幻想的二次元策略RPG。三国英魂因时空裂隙降临星魂大陆，以少女之身重获力量，与魔魇军团展开跨越世界的战争。收集传奇英魂，组建最强阵容，探索隐藏真相，开启属于你的全新三国篇章。

apps.name: 尸鬼乐园
apps.short_description: "CORPSE CARNIVAL" is a top-down action-adventure game where you will play as Li Xiaomeng, a first-year student at the "Linge" Military Academy, and escape from a city filled with zombies and monsters alongside "Asami Yuki."

apps.name: 座敷童カレシILOVEラーメン
apps.short_description:
「座敷童カレシILOVEラーメン」は、ラーメン作りとハートフルなストーリーを楽しめる”ラブコメノベルゲーム”です。
ラーメンで大切なものを守り抜く、強くて優しいストーリー。

apps.name: 復讐者の闇取引
apps.short_description: A rogue-lite beat 'em up survival RPG. Defeat enemies to collect drops and grow stronger, then take on tougher foes. Mix and match weapons you like, and upgrade them for bigger challenges. Even after a loss, you can power up outside of battle for an easier next run.

apps.name: 恋爱音游痴
apps.short_description: "Love wmc" is a visual novel game based on music games. It tells a series of stories about the protagonist who came to a small county town to study alone due to family conflicts, and accidentally got involved with four female protagonists because of an arcade music game.

apps.name: 想成为股票交易大师
apps.short_description: Fifty thousand yuan, a losing position, and a boss behind your chair. Trade fictional stocks in a roguelite life sim, judge rumors, dodge scams, build your strategy, and survive quarterly life checks. Simplified Chinese only.

apps.name: 憶外
