apps.short_description: 《憶外》 is a short visual novel blending school romance with a mystery surrounding memory. Notice unsettling details in everyday conversations, mark moments that matter, and revisit the past. When a familiar scene unfolds again, will you give the same answer?

apps.name: 打工环游记
apps.short_description: Work, travel and build a life across five seaside cities. Take on jobs, explore neighborhoods, meet locals and enjoy an anime-style 3D life simulation as you search for an old friend.
developers: 打工环游记 制作组
publishers: 打工环游记 制作组

apps.name: 挂机传奇
apps.short_description: idle ARPG. Auto-battle through treacherous dungeons for endless loot! Mix warrior, mage, and taoist skills, craft mythic gear in ancient forges, climb demon towers, and explore mythical mazes. Enjoy full offline gains—your hero never stops fighting!

apps.name: 无常三国：乱世幸存者
apps.short_description: Wuchang: Three Kingdoms Survivors is a dark Three Kingdoms roguelite survivor game. Customize your background and destiny talents, ally with deities and summon reincarnated stellar generals. Build unique builds with randomized affix gear & divine bonds, fight through endless enemy hordes.

apps.name: 日本麻将
apps.short_description: Play four-player Riichi Mahjong in a clean pixel-art style. Practice against computer opponents, share a room code with friends, and learn the rules through illustrated lessons. Customize your tiles and enjoy a game at your own pace.

apps.name: 星夜茶会
apps.short_description: Starry Night Tea Party is an asymmetric pursuit game. Play as a Guest, search for clues, brew useful items, and escape the Dream; or take the role of the Demon, draw from a deck of unique cards, hunt the Guests, and harvest their Fear. Multiplayer is in development.

apps.name: 星守のティルクラウン
apps.short_description: A fantasy tower defense game featuring 30 collectible heroines, strategic eight-character teams, real-time battles, powerful bosses, and 30 challenging stages. Build your ultimate defense and protect the world beneath the stars!

apps.name: 昭幽：阴阳渡
apps.short_description: A tower defense game with team building and online co-op. Recruit heroes, combine synergies, forge equipment and choose Heavenly Gifts. Manage resources between waves, counter invisible and flying enemies, and defend the crossing between two realms, solo or with friends.

apps.name: 棋匠
apps.short_description: A more strategic chess for two players!Seize strategic resources,deploy troops on terrain, command battles on boards of any size and attempt to strike unexpectedly in the fog of war!As the host,you can even create your own unique rules,unlocking endless new gameplay and excitement with your friend

apps.name: 概率工坊
apps.short_description: A lottery tycoon simulator. You are the house — design lottery rules, tune payout rates, allocate public benefit funds. Watch NPCs transform from curious passersby into people who can't stop. Behind every number, a virtual life rises or falls. You are not the gambler. You are the house.

apps.name: 水族派對
apps.short_description: Aquarium Party is a heartwarming underwater simulation and collection game featuring a soothing, healing art style. Step into the role of an aquarium curator, manage your daily life on a cute fish island, and collect over 1,000 types of fantastical, adorable fish.

apps.name: 江湖大镖客
apps.short_description: Jianghu Bounty Hunter is a solo open-world wuxia management game. Restore your ruined escort bureau with the ancient Mechanism Boat. Manage resources, trade, and fight with tower defense auto-battler gameplay. Seize territories and choose to be either a righteous hero or a ruthless jianghu overlord.

apps.name: 深渊奇境
apps.short_description: In the city of Cynthia, the young girl Eucaly, in order to find her lost past, steps into the abyss at the edge of the city. Along the way, she will experience complex and treacherous emotions, encounter various strange creatures, and finally uncover the deepest secrets of the Abyss.

apps.name: 漂漂纣王模拟器
apps.short_description: 《漂漂纣王模拟器》是爱好者为喜爱原作的玩家制作的非官方同人二创游戏，仅供娱乐与交流。原作相关权利归库洛所有。我们尊重原作与版权方，本作改编不代表原作设定或官方立场。

apps.name: 灰色视症 - Greyed-out
apps.short_description: Protagonist Shen Mo is trapped in a bizarre reality: the girlfriend who verbally destroys him at dawn becomes impossibly tender by night... Is it really that simple? A story of hallucinations, memory, consciousness, thought, action, madness, dissociation, and survival begins...

apps.name: 猫隐珠舍 A String of Purrs
apps.short_description: Run a cozy bead shop with a cat companion and a little magic. Sort, shape and string bracelets by hand, choose colorful accents, and pack them with leaves, wool balls and a wax seal. Read your neighbors' letters and photo updates, or craft a bracelet just for yourself.

apps.name: 盛夏的我们
apps.short_description: Summer nears. A campus photo job brings you to caring beauty Liu Shilin, aloof yet warm artist Li Feier, mischievous model Xia Wei, and childhood friend Le Tong. Together, you plan graduation shoots, each lending your talents, as your own summer romance with four unique girls quietly begins.

apps.name: 真假千金观察手册The record Manual
apps.short_description: A narrative-driven game about growth, choice and documentation, in which players take on the role of a system, choose their host and help her break free from… to forge a brand-new future

apps.name: 神谕之窗.exe
apps.short_description: A civilization-building simulation presented through an interface inspired by desktop operating systems. Become the divine steward of an ancient civilization, manipulate windows and resources, raise magnificent wonders, and guide your people through the rise and fall of an age.

apps.name: 竞技场鸟事多 (SuperBird)
apps.short_description: SuperBird is a roguelike deckbuilder starring birds and bugs. our cards crawl, grow, and even devour one another. Learn each bug’s quirks, build around them with powerful trinkets, and time your plays to perfection under the arena spotlight. Climb your way to the top and claim the crown!

apps.name: 策马三国志
apps.short_description: Uncover the fog of war across sprawling maps, explore uncharted territories, recruit troops and build your army, and seize cities. Make tense strategic decisions within turns limited by action points.

apps.name: 英雄变美
apps.short_description:
Glow up Hero: a card roguelike where beauty = power. Recruit real-world heroes, field 4. Each: 3 standard + 2 ultimate cards (once per battle). 3 energy/turn, unused cards discarded. Glow Up transforms & upgrades all cards. Real origins.

Beauty is justice? No—beauty is power.

apps.name: 藍儂與路卡
apps.short_description: Find healing from a mundane life by decorating the old house, all while playing personal babysitter for the 'little imp' in the mirror, helping him pass his boring days. In a sliver of frozen, misplaced time, you must find your own happiness.

apps.name: 虚之翔
apps.short_description: One light. One step. A flight without words. Into the void — do not look back.

apps.name: 记忆岛
apps.short_description: High amid the stars float shining crystals, holding memories of old worlds. In order, they blaze, guiding the lost. When chaos comes, they dim, luster fading. You, Wanderer, called to rekindle these fallen stars. Step into a strange world and seek the right way to bring back the light.

apps.name: 谋定三国：卡牌单机版
apps.short_description: Stratagem of the Three Kingdoms: Card Single-Player Edition is a card-builder set in the Three Kingdoms era. Marshal 300 generals and 100+ strategists, read your enemy's units and each campaign, forge the best formation, and land the biggest War Merit. The realm is divided in three; take your seat.

apps.name: 赌狗牌
apps.short_description: A Texas Hold'em hand-builder meets tactical card battling. Luck makes you smile, decisions make you win — burst enemies with overflow damage, or duel AI, friends, and players worldwide!

apps.name: 轮回之塔
apps.short_description: A gothic pixel-art roguelite survivor. Weapons fire automatically—dodge, weave, and mow down endless undead hordes. Pick 1 of 3 upgrades every run; talents persist through death, so you only get stronger. 6 difficulty tiers, 3 chapters, heroes and companions by your side.

apps.name: 迷家 mygohome
apps.short_description: Spend not-so-cute nights in a cute hand-drawn world. Control the character to guard the room yourself and find a way to survive among monsters, doors, windows, and a constantly decreasing SAN value. Every night brings new dangers, and after dawn, more secrets await.

apps.name: 重走西游路
apps.short_description:
A turn-based strategy roguelite inspired by Journey to the West. 
Pick routes, recruit Guardians, swap scriptures, and command every turn by hand. 
Each wipe burns a life lamp; lose them all and the run ends — but your merit survives into the next reincarnation.

apps.name: 铜风旅团
apps.short_description: Drive tanks, pilot vintage aircraft, and build your own brigade in a single-player war RPG with real-time combat and tactical pause. Join Haiyan, a self-proclaimed princess, recruit companions through the story, collect vehicles, and craft upgrades on the road to liberating the kingdom.

apps.name: 雀神·喵喵麻将
apps.short_description: This world’s mahjong is actually a medium for summoning ultra-powerful familiars?! A mahjong spirit who crossed over from another world, together with a beckoning lucky cat, will set you on your path to becoming the Avian Deity!

apps.name: 麦田幸存者
apps.short_description: Harvest Havoc is an auto-fire action roguelike. Move and dodge as swarms sweep across wheat fields, frost, lava, deserts, and the endless void. Choose weapons and passives every level-up, evolve your build, craft companions, and paint your own map to battle on.

apps.name: 黄泉姫ー喰の赫焉ー
apps.short_description: “Then, give me your fingers.” There is only one condition for returning from the underworld alive: collect the fingers packed inside a cursed little box. What seems like a simple bargain draws the protagonist into a nightmare with no way back. Can I uncover the horrifying truth and escape alive?

apps.name: 黄莓C HuangmeiC
apps.short_description: 《HuangmeiC》: a cute, laid-back modern daily visual novel. Play as a new grad, enjoying funny daily life in another world—a light, silly romance! Stress-free job, little to do, great coworkers. No dark stuff or bad endings; just love, growth! Worldview not real—don’t use 3D logic!

apps.name: 龙之传奇
apps.short_description: Dragon Legend is a fun strategy match-and-clear game. The evil dragon keeps advancing along the path toward the princess. You need to manipulate colored blocks marked with directional arrows, plan your clearing order and fire projectiles to block the dragon and protect the princess.

apps.name: 까마귀슬레이어
apps.short_description: A game where you survive for 20 minutes by using skills and defeating crows.

apps.name: 던전에 가는건 계약서에 없었는데요?
apps.short_description:
Dive into cursed grimoires in this isometric hack-and-slash roguelike. 
Chain devastating skill builds, fight through shifting dungeons, and recruit rescued mythic characters to expand your library.

apps.name: 모야이게임
apps.short_description: Dodge enemy fire and challenge the bosses in this quirky arcade shoot 'em up. Collect Power, hold Shift for precise movement, and use Spell and Lightning to escape danger. Tackle four stages and a final boss, then chase your best local score.

 From the main theme of TOKOYO Building, an indoor amusement park on the verge of closing in 1999, to themes for its shady staff, enjoy nostalgic yet subtly unsettling music that evokes the era.
